> **15028 (SQLSTATE: 42000): user default index tablespace dropped**

<a id="be5e48554f8ac2b4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15029 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): limit(%d) on the number of package instance exceeded**

<a id="2289ce21db9ff2ad"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>session 에 생성한 package instance 의 개수가 최대치를 초과하였다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>MAXIMUM_PACKAGE_INSTANCE_COUNT 프로퍼티의 값을 변경한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15030 (SQLSTATE: 42000): session default role dropped**

<a id="8030843c23681658"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">SET ROLE 로 session 에 설정한 role 이 drop 되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; create role role1;<br><br>Role created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; set role role1;<br><br>Session set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; drop role role1;<br><br>Role dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; select * from dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(15030): session default role dropped</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다시 접속한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15031 (SQLSTATE: 39000): limit(%d) on the number of loaded library exceeded**

<a id="7c3f4a80edcdce8c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>process 가 loading 한 user library 의 개수가 최대치를 초과하였다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>MAXIMUM_LOADED_LIBRARY_COUNT 프로퍼티의 값을 변경한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15032 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unmatched bracket in regular expression**

<a id="996b8293fff6a95d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">정규표현식 [ ]에 대한 표현이 올바르지 않다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_COUNT( 'abc123', '[abc' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15032): unmatched bracket in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_COUNT( 'abc123', '[abc' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">'[', 문자리스트 이후에는 ] 가 기술되어 [ ] operator가 완성되어야 한다.<br>참조:<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/11-sql-elements.md#9085d17c2eb9fcb1">Regular Expression Operators</a></td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15033 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unmatched parentheses in regular expression**

<a id="c11b0ac515bca356"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">정규표현식 ( )에 대한 표현이 올바르지 않다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_COUNT( 'abc123', '(abc' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15033): unmatched parentheses in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_COUNT( 'abc123', '(abc' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">괄호의 쌍이 일치해야 한다.<br>참조:<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/11-sql-elements.md#9085d17c2eb9fcb1">Regular Expression Operators</a></td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15034 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid interval value in regular expression**

<a id="8c5e68ae82112967"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">정규표현식의 반복 횟수 범위지정이 올바르지 않다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'aaaabc', 'a{5,1}' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15034): invalid interval value in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'aaaabc', 'a{5,1}' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">반복 횟수 범위지정은 {최소, 최대}의 형식으로 기술한다. 예: a{1,5}</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15035 (SQLSTATE: 42000): maximum repetition count in regular expression exceeded**

<a id="7d41a36b67337cf0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">정규표현식의 최대 반복 횟수를 초과하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'x', 'a{1,2147483648}' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15035): maximum repetition count in regular expression exceeded :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'x', 'a{1,2147483648}' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">최대 반복 횟수는 2147483647 까지 지정할 수 있다. 예: a{1,2147483647}</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15036 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid repetition operand in regular expression**

<a id="07e586c42542777b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">반복연산자의 표현이 잘못되었다.<br>반복연산자만 단독으로 기술할 수 없다. 예: '?'<br>반복연산자를 연이어 기술할 수 없다. 예: 'a+{1,3}<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'a', 'a+{1,3}' ) from dual;<br>ERR-42000(15036): invalid repetition operand in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'a', 'a+{1,3}' ) from dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">반복연산자 이전에 expression 이 표현되도록 기술한다.<br>예: 'a?', '(a+){1,3}'</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15037 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid character class in regular expression**

<a id="b7b8a62e796c7434"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">정규표현식에 정의되지 않은 character class 를 기술하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'abc123', '[[:alphanumeric:]]' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15037): invalid character class in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'abc123', '[[:alphanumeric:]]' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">정의된 character class 를 사용한다.<br>참조:<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/11-sql-elements.md#9085d17c2eb9fcb1">Regular Expression Operators</a></td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15038 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid character range in regular expression**

<a id="553659701b892b38"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">정규표현식의 범위지정이 올바르지 않다.<br>[minvalue-maxvalue] 의 형식으로 범위를 기술해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'x', '[z-a]' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15038): invalid character range in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'x', '[z-a]' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">[minvalue-maxvalue] 의 형식으로 범위를 지정한다. 예) [a-z]</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15039 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid escape sequence in regular expression**

<a id="0352fdb0310b3bff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">\ (escape character) 문자의 표현이 잘못되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( '\', '\' ) from dual;<br>ERR-42000(15039): invalid escape sequence in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( '\', '\' ) from dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">\ (escape character) 뒤에 표현하고자 하는 문자를 기술한다.<br>예: REGEXP_SUBSTR( '\', '\\' )</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15040 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid back reference number in regular expression**

<a id="2f5d7c884bcba939"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">정규표현식에 부적합한 back reference 가 기술되었다.<br>back reference는 앞서 기술된 subexpression 을 참조할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'abcabc', '(abc)\3' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15040): invalid back reference number in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'abcabc', '(abc)\3' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">back reference 는 앞서 기술된 subexpression 을 참조할 수 있다.<br>예: '(ab)(cd)\1\2'<br>참조:<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/11-sql-elements.md#9085d17c2eb9fcb1">Regular Expression Operators</a></td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15041 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid regular expression match param %s**

<a id="e1bcd544bdf7d791"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">정규표현식에서 정의된 matching option 을 기술하지 않았다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'abc', '.+', 1, 1, 'I' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15041): invalid regular expression match param I :<br><br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'abc', '.+', 1, 1, 'I' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">정규표현식에서 정의된 matching option인 i, c, n, m, x 를 목적에 맞게 기술한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15042 (SQLSTATE: 42000): regular expression too long**

<a id="dea636998d662cc0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>정규표현식이 지원하는 최대 길이 512 byte 를 초과하였다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>정규표현식을 허용하는 최대 길이인 512 byte 내외로 기술한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15043 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid regular expression return_opt %ld**

<a id="11d62923248236b0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">관련함수 인자인 return_opt 에 0 과 1 이 아닌 값이 기술되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_INSTR( 'abc123가나다', '[[:digit:]]{3}', 1, 1, -1 ) from dual;<br>ERR-42000(15043): invalid regular expression return_opt -1 :<br>SELECT REGEXP_INSTR( 'abc123가나다', '[[:digit:]]{3}', 1, 1, -1 ) from dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">관련함수 인자인 return_opt 의 목적에 맞게 0 또는 1 을 지정한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15044 (SQLSTATE: 42000): string literal too long**

<a id="b3cca16503d882df"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">연산의 결과로 관련 타입의 최대크기를 초과하는 string 이 생성되거나 정의되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE ( varchar_col, 'a', 'bb' ) AS rep_col FROM t1;<br>ERR-42000(15044): string literal too long :<br>SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE ( varchar_col,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">허용되는 타입의 크기에 맞게 조정하거나,<br>연산의 결과를 수용할 수 있는 타입으로 타입변환을 할 수 있다.<br>예: REGEXP_REPLACE ( cast( varchar_col as long varchar ), 'a', 'bb' ) AS rep_col</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15045 (SQLSTATE: 42000): argument '%ld' is out of range**

<a id="03c802be450fbb21"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">관련함수의 인자에 허용하는 범위를 넘어선 값이 기술되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_INSTR( 'abc', '\w', -1 ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15045): argument '-1' is out of range :<br>SELECT REGEXP_INSTR( 'abc', '\w', -1 ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">관련함수의 인자에 허용하는 범위의 값을 기술한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15046 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the '%s' value must be a number between %ld and %ld**

<a id="0d61e370760a53df"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">관련 함수의 인자에 허용 범위를 벗어난 값이 기술되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TABLE_PHYSICAL_STATS( T1, 1000 ) FROM DUAL;<br>ERR-42000(15046): the 'sampling ratio' value must be a number between 1 and 100 :<br>SELECT TABLE_PHYSICAL_STATS( T1, 1000 ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">관련 함수의 인자에는 허용 범위 내의 값을 기술한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="e088671419e67054"></a>
## SQL 구문 처리 관련 에러

> **16000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to initialize sql processor layer**

<a id="4605287bd4dae88f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16001 (SQLSTATE: HYC00): not implemented feature, in a function %s**

<a id="06db85e2b4b7e7b2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SQL 표준에는 존재하나 미구현 기능이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>ALTER TABLE child ADD CONSTRAINT child_fk<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOREIGN KEY( c_fk ) REFERENCES parent( p_pk ) MATCH PARTIAL;<br>ERR-HYC00(16001): not implemented feature, in a function qlrValidateForeignKeyMatchType() :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOREIGN KEY( c_fk ) REFERENCES parent( p_pk ) MATCH PARTIAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 기능은 사용할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid function sequence of sql processor layer**

<a id="7f97447ba02d3b5e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16003 (SQLSTATE: 42000): identifier is too long**

<a id="ff94f87fe27a5b57"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>컬럼의 이름이 최대 길이를 초과하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T1 ( c234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890 INTEGER&nbsp;&nbsp;);<br><br>ERR-42000(16003): identifier is too long :<br>CREATE TABLE T1 ( c234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890 INTEGER&nbsp;&nbsp;)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>식별자 이름은 128 bytes 보다 작아야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T1 ( c234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567 INTEGER&nbsp;&nbsp;);<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16004 (SQLSTATE: 28000): invalid username/password; logon denied**

<a id="0c346edc8889f889"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>사용자 이름 또는 비밀번호가 잘못되었다.<br><br>% gsql invalid invalid<br><br>ERR-28000(16004): invalid username/password; logon denied</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>올바른 사용자 이름과 비밀번호로 접속한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16005 (SQLSTATE: 42000): name '%s.%s' is already used by an existing object**

<a id="f96b1c809995e1b3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 이름을 갖는 객체가 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-42000(16005): name 'PUBLIC.T1' is already used by an existing object :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>생성하고자 하는 객체의 이름을 확인한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16006 (SQLSTATE: 42000): schema '%s' does not exist**

<a id="4b505e7f4b9c76d0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>해당 스키마가 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE invalid.t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-42000(16006): schema 'INVALID' does not exist :<br>CREATE TABLE invalid.t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>스키마 이름을 확인한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16007 (SQLSTATE: 42000): schema '%s' is not writable**

<a id="0797c403e0a5ab23"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시스템 스키마에 객체를 생성할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE definition_schema.t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-42000(16007): schema 'DEFINITION_SCHEMA' is not writable :<br>CREATE TABLE definition_schema.t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>사용 가능한 스키마를 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE public.t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16008 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace '%s' does not exist**

<a id="7f2800110286c685"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>테이블스페이스가 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE invalid;<br><br>ERR-42000(16008): tablespace 'INVALID' does not exist :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE invalid<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>사용 가능한 테이블스페이스를 명시한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16009 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace '%s' is not writable**

<a id="2cb23035ed226894"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시스템 테이블스페이스에는 사용자 객체를 생성할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE dictionary_tbs;<br><br>ERR-42000(16009): tablespace 'DICTIONARY_TBS' is not writable :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE dictionary_tbs<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>사용 가능한 테이블스페이스를 명시한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16010 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid value for PCTFREE or PCTUSED**

<a id="f570ba1fc04902a0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>유효하지 않은 PCTFREE 값을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) PCTFREE 100;<br><br>ERR-42000(16010): invalid value for PCTFREE or PCTUSED :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) PCTFREE 100<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 유효한 범위 (0~99)의 PCTFREE 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) PCTFREE 10;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16011 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid INITRANS option value**

<a id="d5d05587d7324743"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>유효하지 않은 INITRANS 값을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 INITRANS 100;<br><br>ERR-42000(16011): invalid INITRANS option value :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 INITRANS 100<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 유효한 범위 (1~32)의 INITRANS 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 INITRANS 4;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16012 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate column name**

<a id="49d7ab6610437705"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 컬럼이 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-42000(16012): duplicate column name :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>컬럼 이름을 다르게 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16013 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid value is prevented in validation step**

<a id="b0a32512794afe31"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16014 (SQLSTATE: 22023): INCREMENT must be a non-zero integer**

<a id="75e0e7d0e7f7bc7c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시퀀스의 증가값으로 0 을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 INCREMENT BY 0;<br><br>ERR-22023(16014): INCREMENT must be a non-zero integer :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 INCREMENT BY 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>시퀀스의 증가값으로 0 이 아닌 정수값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 INCREMENT BY 1;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16015 (SQLSTATE: 22023): START WITH cannot be less than MINVALUE**

<a id="7c5b48d3f3ce71e8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시퀀스의 MINVALUE 보다 작은 시작값을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 10 MINVALUE 20;<br><br>ERR-22023(16015): START WITH cannot be less than MINVALUE :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 10 MINVALUE 20<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>시퀀스의 시작값으로 MINVALUE 보다 크거나 같은 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 20 MINVALUE 20;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16016 (SQLSTATE: 22023): START WITH cannot be more than MAXVALUE**

<a id="448804a362dd5359"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시퀀스의 MAXVALUE 보다 큰 시작값을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 40 MAXVALUE 30;<br><br>ERR-22023(16016): START WITH cannot be more than MAXVALUE :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 40 MAXVALUE 30<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>시퀀스의 시작값으로 MAXVALUE 보다 작거나 같은 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 1 MAXVALUE 30;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16017 (SQLSTATE: 22023): the number of values to CACHE must be greater than 1**

<a id="dd9de3f883f1f0c1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시퀀스의 CACHE 값은 1보다 커야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 CACHE 1;<br><br>ERR-22023(16017): the number of values to CACHE must be greater than 1 :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 CACHE 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>시퀀스의 CACHE 값으로 1보다 큰 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 CACHE 20;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16018 (SQLSTATE: 22023): number to CACHE must be less than one cycle**

<a id="5862f9e4f9b35293"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">시퀀스의 CACHE 크기는 한 cycle (아래의 예는 100) 값보다 작아야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 100 CACHE 1000 CYCLE;<br><br>ERR-22023(16018): number to CACHE must be less than one cycle :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 100 CACHE 1000 CYCLE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">시퀀스의 CACHE 값으로 한 cycle (100) 보다 작은 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 100 CACHE 20 CYCLE;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16019 (SQLSTATE: 22023): MINVALUE must be less than MAXVALUE**

<a id="3a9c00ba2ed4586a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시퀀스의 MINVALUE 가 MAXVALUE 보다 크다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 100 MAXVALUE 10;<br><br>ERR-22023(16019): MINVALUE must be less than MAXVALUE :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 100 MAXVALUE 10<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>시퀀스의 MINVALUE 는 MAXVALUE 보다 작아야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 10 MAXVALUE 100;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16020 (SQLSTATE: 22023): INCREMENT must be less than MAXVALUE minus MINVALUE**

<a id="7cfc0fc809a93eaf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시퀀스의 INCREMENT BY 값이 (MAXVALUE - MINVALUE) 값보다 크다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 INCREMENT BY 10 MINVALUE 10 MAXVALUE 15;<br><br>ERR-22023(16020): INCREMENT must be less than MAXVALUE minus MINVALUE :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 INCREMENT BY 10 MINVALUE 10 MAXVALUE 15<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>시퀀스의 INCREMENT BY 값이 (MAXVALUE - MINVALUE) 값보다 작아야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 10 MAXVALUE 15;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16021 (SQLSTATE: 22023): descending sequences that CYCLE must specify MINVALUE**

<a id="a4148c6bd216eda4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16022 (SQLSTATE: 22023): ascending sequences that CYCLE must specify MAXVALUE**

<a id="623efab5c1175fec"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="c80494bbcdee07d3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16024 (SQLSTATE: 42000): numeric precision specifier is out of range( %d to %d )**

<a id="ad79c023e97a8359"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>NUMERIC 타입의 precision 값이 범위를 벗어났다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMERIC(100) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16024): numeric precision specifier is out of range( 1 to 38 ) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMERIC(100) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>NUMERIC 타입의 precision 의 유효값은 1 ~ 38 이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMERIC(38) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16025 (SQLSTATE: 42000): numeric scale specifier is out of range( %d to %d )**

<a id="83b595f6c30c4753"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>NUMERIC 타입의 scale 값이 범위를 벗어났다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMERIC(38,200) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16025): numeric scale specifier is out of range( -84 to 127 ) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMERIC(38,200) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>NUMERIC 타입의 scale 의 유효값은 -84 ~ 127 이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMERIC(38,0) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16026 (SQLSTATE: 42000): character length specifier is out of range( 1 to %d )**

<a id="71b5adf227519084"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>CHAR 타입의 length 값이 범위를 벗어났다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 CHAR(2001) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16026): character length specifier is out of range( 1 to 2000 ) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 CHAR(2001) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>CHAR 타입의 length 값은 1 ~ 2000 이어야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 CHAR(2000) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16027 (SQLSTATE: 42000): character varying length specifier is out of range( 1 to %d )**

<a id="cc5d9bc59c6e5d64"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>VARCHAR 타입의 length 값이 범위를 벗어났다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARCHAR(4001) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16027): character varying length specifier is out of range( 1 to 4000 ) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARCHAR(4001) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>VARCHAR 타입의 length 값은 1 ~ 4000 이어야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARCHAR(4000) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="573d7e1d61482fa3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>BINARY 타입의 length 값이 범위를 벗어났다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 BINARY(2001) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16028): binary length specifier is out of range( 1 to 2000 ) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 BINARY(2001) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>BINARY 타입의 length 값은 1 ~ 2000 이어야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 BINARY(2000) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16029 (SQLSTATE: 42000): binary varying length specifier is out of range( 1 to %d )**

<a id="cd392d102be4171f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>VARBINARY 타입의 length 값이 범위를 벗어났다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARBINARY(4001) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16029): binary varying length specifier is out of range( 1 to 4000 ) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARBINARY(4001) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>VARBINARY 타입의 length 값은 1 ~ 4000 이어야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARBINARY(4000) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16030 (SQLSTATE: 42000): name already used by an existing constraint**

<a id="02658d2e8c1518f7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 constraint 이름이 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_same_const NOT NULL,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_same_const NOT NULL );<br><br>ERR-42000(16030): name already used by an existing constraint :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_same_const NOT NULL )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 서로 다른 constraint 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_c1_const NOT NULL,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_c2_const NOT NULL );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16031 (SQLSTATE: 42000): auto-generated name already used by an existing constraint, specify unique constraint name**

<a id="fb513c634b8f2a6f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>자동 생성한 constraint 이름이 이미 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_not_null_c2 NOT NULL, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c2 SET NOT NULL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16031): auto-generated name already used by an existing constraint, specify unique constraint name</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 새로운 constraint 이름을 직접 기술한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c2 SET CONSTRAINT t1_c2_not_null NOT NULL;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16032 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table can have only one primary key**

<a id="f1bd1871e86b9a3c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>하나의 테이블에는 하나의 PRIMARY KEY 만 생성할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c2 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br><br>ERR-42000(16032): table can have only one primary key :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c2 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 하나의 PRIMARY KEY 만 생성하거나, 여러 컬럼의 조합으로 PRIMARY KEY 를 생성한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(c1,c2) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16033 (SQLSTATE: 42000): such unique or primary key already exists in the table**

<a id="86d32a57c3762ba7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>이미 동일한 unique 제약 조건이 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD CONSTRAINT t1_unique UNIQUE(c1);<br><br>ERR-42000(16033): such unique or primary key already exists in the table :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ADD CONSTRAINT t1_unique UNIQUE(c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>테이블의 unique 제약 조건 정보를 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \desc t1<br><br>COLUMN_NAME TYPE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS_NULLABLE<br>----------- ------------ -----------<br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) TRUE<br>C2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) TRUE<br><br>INDEX_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TABLESPACE_NAME INDEX_TYPE IS_UNIQUE COLUMNS<br>------------------ --------------- ---------- --------- -------<br>T1_UNIQUE_C1_INDEX MEM_TEMP_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BTREE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br><br>CONSTRAINT_NAME CONSTRAINT_TYPE ASSOCIATED_INDEX&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COLUMNS<br>--------------- --------------- ------------------ -------<br>T1_UNIQUE_C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNIQUE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;T1_UNIQUE_C1_INDEX C1</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16034 (SQLSTATE: 42000): name already used by an existing index**

<a id="51446620e618c0db"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>이름이 동일한 인덱스가 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE INDEX idx1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16034): name already used by an existing index :<br>CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE INDEX idx1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>존재하지 않는 인덱스 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE INDEX idx2 );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16035 (SQLSTATE: 42000): auto-generated name already used by an existing index, specify non-duplicate index name**

> **16038 (SQLSTATE: 23000): integrity constraint violation**

<a id="97ec8c2371868732"></a>

<a id="9c3df79342b5de1c"></a>

> **16074 (SQLSTATE: 42000): sequence number not allowed here**

<a id="e1713cbc688493a6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SEQUENCE 를 WHERE 절에 기술할 수 없다.<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1;<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = seq1.NEXTVAL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16074): sequence number not allowed here :<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = seq1.NEXTVAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SEQUENCE 는 아래와 같이 최종 결과로만 사용할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT seq1.NEXTVAL FROM dual;<br><br>NEXTVAL<br>-------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( seq1.NEXTVAL );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t1 SET c1 = seq1.NEXTVAL WHERE c1 = 2;<br><br>1 row updated.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="4ce13cb837b31abf"></a>

> **16089 (SQLSTATE: 28000): built-in authorization(user or role) '%s' is not modifiable**

<a id="52f7466628e6328c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>built-in user 를 제거하려고 시도하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP USER SYS;<br><br>ERR-28000(16089): built-in authorization(user or role) 'SYS' is not modifiable :<br>DROP USER SYS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>built-in user 는 제거할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16090 (SQLSTATE: 42000): built-in tablespace '%s' is not modifiable**

<a id="d5ca5eb1c46c5b4b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>built-in tablespace 의 comment 를 변경하려고 시도하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMENT ON TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs IS 'test comment';<br><br>ERR-42000(16090): built-in tablespace 'MEM_DATA_TBS' is not modifiable :<br>COMMENT ON TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs IS 'test comment'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>built-in tablespace 의 comment 를 변경할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16091 (SQLSTATE: 42000): built-in schema '%s' is not modifiable**

<a id="144299659db434cb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>built-in schema 를 제거하려고 시도하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP SCHEMA dictionary_schema;<br><br>ERR-42000(16091): built-in schema 'DICTIONARY_SCHEMA' is not modifiable :<br>DROP SCHEMA dictionary_schema<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>built-in schema 는 제거할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16092 (SQLSTATE: 42000): built-in table or view '%s' is not modifiable**

<a id="5b51276c037fcb6b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>built-in table 을 제거하려고 시도하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE x$tables;<br><br>ERR-42000(16092): built-in table or view 'X$TABLES' is not modifiable :<br>DROP TABLE x$tables<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>built-in table 은 제거할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16093 (SQLSTATE: 42000): built-in index '%s' is not modifiable**

<a id="0292e2237565cfff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>built-in index 를 제거하려고 시도하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP INDEX tables_index_table_id;<br><br>ERR-42000(16093): built-in index 'TABLES_INDEX_TABLE_ID' is not modifiable :<br>DROP INDEX tables_index_table_id<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>built-in index 는 제거할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16094 (SQLSTATE: 42000): built-in constraint '%s' is not modifiable**

<a id="64a149bd5aad302d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>built-in constraint 를 변경하려고 시도하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMENT ON CONSTRAINT DEFINITION_SCHEMA.TABLES_NOT_NULL_OWNER_ID<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS 'test constraint comment';<br><br>ERR-42000(16094): built-in constraint 'TABLES_NOT_NULL_OWNER_ID' is not modifiable :<br>COMMENT ON CONSTRAINT DEFINITION_SCHEMA.TABLES_NOT_NULL_OWNER_ID<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>built-in constraint 는 변경할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16095 (SQLSTATE: 42000): built-in sequence '%s' is not modifiable**

<a id="faf91461d7c08af1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16096 (SQLSTATE: 28000): authorization(user or role) '%s' does not exist**

<a id="43f304b1a3ab0984"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>User 나 Role 이 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT DBA TO invalid_user;<br><br>ERR-28000(16096): authorization(user or role) 'INVALID_USER' does not exist :<br>GRANT DBA TO invalid_user<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>해당 authorization(user or role) 이 존재하는지 확인한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16097 (SQLSTATE: 42000): constraint '%s' does not exist**

<a id="5ed9a37e5af4a8fd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>존재하지 않는 제약조건이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINT invalid_constraint IMMEDIATE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16097): constraint 'INVALID_CONSTRAINT' does not exist :<br>SET CONSTRAINT invalid_constraint IMMEDIATE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>해당 제약조건이 존재하는지 확인한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16098 (SQLSTATE: 07006): bind type mismatch of parameter number (%d)**

<a id="056b4e858d1564c4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SQL 문과 Bind Type 이 일치하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set serveroutput on<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 0;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 INTEGER := 0;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT c1, c2 INTO ?, ? FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1' USING IN v1, IN v2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'v1 = ' || v1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'v2 = ' || v2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-07006(16098): bind type mismatch of parameter number (1) :<br>SELECT c1, c2 INTO ?, ? FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT c1, c2 INTO ?, ? FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1' USING IN v1, IN v2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SQL 문 SELECT INTO ?, ? 는 아래와 같이 OUT binding 이 필요하다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 0;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 INTEGER := 0;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT c1, c2 INTO ?, ? FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1' USING OUT v1, OUT v2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'v1 = ' || v1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'v2 = ' || v2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>v1 = 1<br>v2 = 100<br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16099 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the number of elements in the INTO list is mismatch**

<a id="02ce8d367e31cb2c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SELECT 결과 컬럼 수와 INTO 의 개수가 다르다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; \var v2 INTEGER<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, c2 INTO :v1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16099): the number of elements in the INTO list is mismatch :<br>SELECT c1, c2 INTO :v1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SELECT 결과 컬럼 수와 INTO 의 개수를 동일하게 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, c2 INTO :v1, :v2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>V1&nbsp;&nbsp;V2<br>-- ---<br>&nbsp;1 100<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16100 (SQLSTATE: HY000): single-row subquery returns more than one row**

<a id="f20b82431167289c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>subquery 의 결과 건수가 1건보다 많다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE t1.c1 = ( SELECT t2.c1 FROM t2 );<br><br>ERR-HY000(16100): single-row subquery returns more than one row :<br>SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE t1.c1 = ( SELECT t2.c1 FROM t2 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 하나의 결과를 만들 수 있는 subquery 를 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE t1.c1 = ( SELECT MAX(t2.c1) FROM t2 );<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;C2<br>-- ---<br>&nbsp;1 100<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16101 (SQLSTATE: 42000): parallel factor is out of range( 0 to %d )**

<a id="26fe6dbbed60e01f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>PARALLEL 값이 범위를 벗어났다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1(c1) PARALLEL 100;<br><br>ERR-42000(16101): parallel factor is out of range( 0 to 64 ) :<br>CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1(c1) PARALLEL 100<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 PARALLEL 의 유효한 범위값 ( 0 ~ 64 ) 을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1(c1) PARALLEL 8;<br>Index created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16102 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid MEMORY clause for alter of %s %s TABLESPACE**

<a id="56bfc99113c82ec1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MEMORY DATA TABLESPACE 에 대해 ADD MEMORY 절을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD MEMORY 'test_memory' SIZE 10M;<br><br>ERR-42000(16102): invalid MEMORY clause for alter of MEMORY DATA TABLESPACE :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD MEMORY 'test_memory' SIZE 10M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 MEMORY DATA TABLESPACE 는 ADD DATAFILE 절을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'test_file' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16103 (SQLSTATE: 3C000): cursor '%s' is already declared**

<a id="43139a1bd4ee1731"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 cursor 이름을 선언하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c1 FROM t2 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>ERR-3C000(16103): cursor 'CUR1' is already declared :<br>DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c1 FROM t2 WHERE c1 = 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 서로 다른 cursor 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur2 CURSOR FOR SELECT c1 FROM t2 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>Cursor declared.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16104 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid cursor query: '%s'**

<a id="4cc2da4188b4d47b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DELETE 는 cursor query 로 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16104): invalid cursor query: 'DELETE FROM' :<br>DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 DELETE RETURN query 를 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1 RETURN c2;<br><br>Cursor declared.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16105 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid cursor property**

<a id="b7b83a85515201e3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DML query 는 holdable cursor 로 선언할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR WITH HOLD FOR DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 0 RETURN c2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16105): invalid cursor property : holdable cursor should be read only cursor</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>holdable cursor 는 SELECT 구문만 사용가능하다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR WITH HOLD FOR SELECT c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 0;<br><br>Cursor declared.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16106 (SQLSTATE: 34000): cursor '%s' does not exist**

<a id="5e4ef88949661541"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>선언하지 않은 cursor 이름을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN invalid_cursor;<br><br>ERR-34000(16106): cursor 'INVALID_CURSOR' does not exist :<br>OPEN invalid_cursor<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>선언한 cursor 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16107 (SQLSTATE: 34000): cursor '%s' is already open**

<a id="d57f12b0fdc8ba0a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>cursor 가 이미 OPEN 되어 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>ERR-34000(16107): cursor 'CUR1' is already open :<br>OPEN cur1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>cursor 를 CLOSE 하고 다시 OPEN 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CLOSE cur1;<br><br>Cursor closed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16108 (SQLSTATE: 34000): cursor '%s' is not open**

<a id="9585454436e7b20b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>cursor 가 OPEN 되어 있지 않다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>ERR-34000(16108): cursor 'CUR1' is not open</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>cursor 를 OPEN 후에 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>&nbsp;V1<br>---<br>100<br><br>1 row fetched.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16109 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid use: cursor '%s' is not a declared cursor**

<a id="9a2228af5cd7dcd4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">ODBC의 SQLSetCursorName() 함수 또는 JDBC ResultSet.getCursorName() 을 이용하여<br>설정한 cursor 이름은 OPEN, FETCH, CLOSE cursor 구문과 함께 사용할 수 없다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">SQL 구문 DECLARE CURSOR 로 선언한 cursor 만이 OPEN, FETCH, CLOSE cursor 구문을 사용할 수 있다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16110 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid use: cursor '%s' is not an ODBC/JDBC cursor**

<a id="2b99a8267cc75cb4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SQL 구문인 DECLARE CURSOR 구문으로 선언한 cursor 는 ODBC 함수인 SQLSetCursorName() 함수로 cursor 이름을 변경할 수 없다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SQL 구문으로 선언한 cursor 이름과 ODBC/ JDBC API 를 이용한 cursor 이름을 혼용하여 사용하지 않는다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16111 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cursor '%s' is not scrollable**

<a id="a6d0b186aab67e75"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>FETCH FIRST/LAST/PRIOR/CURRENT 등의 구문은 scrollable cursor 에서 사용 가능하다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c1 FROM t1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH LAST FROM cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16111): cursor 'CUR1' is not scrollable :<br>FETCH LAST FROM cur1 INTO :v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 scrollable cursor 를 선언하여 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 SCROLL CURSOR FOR SELECT c1 FROM t1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH LAST FROM cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;5<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; FETCH PRIOR FROM cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;4<br><br>1 row fetched.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16112 (SQLSTATE: 42000): query expression is not updatable**

<a id="b9b41bce96e900be"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>update 할 수 없는 질의이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(c1) FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 3 FOR UPDATE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16112): query expression is not updatable</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 질의 결과가 각 row 를 식별할 수 있는 query 여야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 3 FOR UPDATE;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;4<br>&nbsp;5<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16113 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid phase(%s): executable phase of '%s' is between %s and %s**

<a id="433a8f5c741d53fa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MOUNT 단계에서 실행할 수 없는 SQL 문이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE my_table ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-42000(16113): invalid phase(MOUNT): executable phase of 'CREATE TABLE' is between OPEN and OPEN</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>OPEN 단계로 변경 후 실행하여야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE my_table ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16114 (SQLSTATE: 42000): database is already mounted**

<a id="334f175f90509db8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>이미 MOUNT 단계이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM MOUNT DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16114): database is already mounted</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>현재 상태를 확인하고 원하는 start-up 단계로 변경한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT status FROM x$instance;<br><br>STATUS<br>-------<br>MOUNTED<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16115 (SQLSTATE: 42000): database is already local opened**

<a id="1e70e0e2ff22d73a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>cluster database 가 이미 LOCAL OPEN 단계이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN LOCAL DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16115): database is already local opened</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>현재 상태를 확인하고 원하는 start-up 단계로 변경한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT status FROM x$instance@LOCAL;<br><br>STATUS<br>----------<br>LOCAL OPEN<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN GLOBAL DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16116 (SQLSTATE: 42000): transaction is READ ONLY**

<a id="3437bce6b7951484"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>READ ONLY 트랜잭션 상태이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY;<br><br>Transaction set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(18003): Transaction is READ ONLY</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 READ WRITE 로 변경하고 실행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET TRANSACTION READ WRITE;<br><br>Transaction set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16117 (SQLSTATE: 42000): database not mounted**

<a id="69407e539c5765b2"></a>

> **16123 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot select ROWID from not writable table**

<a id="fa119b44738f8bcd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ROWID 가 존재할 수 없는 fixed table 이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT ROWID FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(16123): cannot select ROWID from not writable table :<br>SELECT ROWID FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>ROWID pseudo column 을 가지는 base table 에 대해 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT ROWID FROM t1 LIMIT 2;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ROWID<br>-----------------------<br>AAAAAAAAYf2AACAAAAEiAAA<br>AAAAAAAAYf2AACAAAAEiAAB<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16124 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table can have only one identity column**

<a id="8fd1dd88c9157370"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>하나의 테이블은 하나의 identity column 만을 가질 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, c2 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY );<br><br>ERR-42000(16124): table can have only one identity column :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, c2 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 한 column 만 identity column 으로 정의한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16125 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column being added already exists in table**

<a id="a5599bd0ce43ca71"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>이미 존재하는 컬럼이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN c1 VARCHAR(32);<br><br>ERR-42000(16125): column being added already exists in table :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN c1 VARCHAR(32)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>컬럼 이름이 중복되지 않도록 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN new_column VARCHAR(32);<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16126 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table must be empty to add mandatory (%s) column ('%s')**

<a id="28bea8cc8c7ceb6e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>data 가 존재하는 테이블에 대해 NOT NULL 제약조건을 가진 컬럼을 추가할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN c2 INTEGER NOT NULL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16126): table must be empty to add mandatory (NOT NULL) column ('C2')</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 DEFAULT 값을 주어 컬럼을 추가한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN c2 INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16127 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot modify INITIAL storage option**

<a id="46d2824711007a05"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>INITIAL storage option 은 변경할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 STORAGE ( INITIAL 10M );<br><br>ERR-42000(16127): cannot modify INITIAL storage option :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 STORAGE ( INITIAL 10M )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>테이블 생성 시점에 설정한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) STORAGE ( INITIAL 10M );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16128 (SQLSTATE: 42000): name '%s' is already used by an existing tablespace**

<a id="718eef4897b86ca9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>tablespace 가 이미 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs DATAFILE 'test_file' SIZE 100M;<br><br>ERR-42000(16128): name 'MEM_DATA_TBS' is already used by an existing tablespace :<br>CREATE TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs DATAFILE 'test_file' SIZE 100M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>새로운 테이블스페이스 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLESPACE new_data_tbs DATAFILE 'test_file' SIZE 100M;<br><br>Tablespace created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16129 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate datafile name**

<a id="d645166779a35653"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>중복된 filename 을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'file1.dbf' SIZE 10M,<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'file2.dbf' SIZE 10M,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'file1.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>ERR-42000(16129): duplicate datafile name :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'file1.dbf' SIZE 10M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>서로 다른 filename 을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'file1.dbf' SIZE 10M,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'file2.dbf' SIZE 10M,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'file3.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16130 (SQLSTATE: 42000): File already exists - '%s'**

<a id="bba2d025ca66b0a8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>datafile 이 이미 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'test_file' SIZE 100M;<br><br>ERR-42000(16130): file already exists - '/xxx/xxx/db/test_file' :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'test_file' SIZE 100M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>새로운 filename 을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'new_test_file' SIZE 100M;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16131 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot rename the built-in tablespace**

<a id="fe35adb9ac15ac52"></a>

<a id="43ad9b0554e4e97c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>해당 UNIQUE 제약 조건이 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 DROP UNIQUE(c1);<br><br>ERR-42000(16136): cannot drop constraint - nonexistent unique key :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 DROP UNIQUE(c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>table 의 UNIQUE 제약 조건을 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \desc t1<br><br>COLUMN_NAME TYPE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS_NULLABLE<br>----------- ------------ -----------<br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) TRUE<br>C2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) TRUE<br><br>INDEX_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TABLESPACE_NAME INDEX_TYPE IS_UNIQUE COLUMNS<br>------------------ --------------- ---------- --------- -------<br>T1_UNIQUE_C2_INDEX MEM_TEMP_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BTREE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C2<br><br>CONSTRAINT_NAME CONSTRAINT_TYPE ASSOCIATED_INDEX&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COLUMNS<br>--------------- --------------- ------------------ -------<br>T1_UNIQUE_C2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNIQUE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;T1_UNIQUE_C2_INDEX C2<br><br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 DROP UNIQUE(c2);<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>
