> **16232 (SQLSTATE: 28000): cannot REVOKE privileges you did not grant to '%s'**

<a id="030373be4af3c2c3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>자신이 GRANT 하지 않은 권한은 REVOKE 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; REVOKE SELECT ON u1.t1 FROM u3;<br><br>ERR-28000(16232): cannot REVOKE privileges you did not grant to 'U3' :<br>REVOKE SELECT ON u1.t1 FROM u3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>해당 권한을 GRANT 한 사용자가 REVOKE 할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br>gSQL&gt; REVOKE SELECT ON u1.t1 FROM u3;<br><br>Revoke succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16233 (SQLSTATE: HY000): OFFLINE IMMEDIATE disallowed; noarchivelog mode**

<a id="91e72ff6d6a9ef29"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16234 (SQLSTATE: HY000): OFFLINE IMMEDIATE disallowed; no logging tablespace**

<a id="0e00ae4c92a15a9c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16235 (SQLSTATE: 2B000): dependent privilege descriptors still exist**

<a id="b3835fcb9c70d512"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>의존 관계가 존재하는 privilege 가 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT ON u1.t1 TO u2 WITH GRANT OPTION;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u2 u2<br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT ON u1.t1 TO u3 WITH GRANT OPTION;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br>gSQL&gt; REVOKE SELECT ON u1.t1 FROM u2 RESTRICT;<br><br>ERR-2B000(16235): dependent privilege descriptors still exist</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>REVOKE 시 RESTRICT 옵션을 사용하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; REVOKE SELECT ON u1.t1 FROM u2;<br><br>Revoke succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16236 (SQLSTATE: 0A000): not supported query%s**

<a id="dcf6b5650beb3047"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>지원하지 않는 query 유형이다.<br><br>SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t2 USING(c1);<br><br>ERR-0A000(16236): not supported query (outer join including using clause) :<br>SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t2 USING(c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>LEFT OUTER JOIN 은 ON 절을 이용하여 join 조건을 기술한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2 null<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16237 (SQLSTATE: 42000): a subquery block has incorrect number of result columns**

<a id="12eae4bb26b9dfce"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>결과 컬럼의 개수가 서로 다르다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1<br>UNION ALL<br>SELECT * FROM t2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16237): a subquery block has incorrect number of result columns :<br>SELECT * FROM t2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 결과 컬럼의 개수를 동일하게 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1<br>UNION ALL<br>SELECT c1 FROM t2;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>3 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16238 (SQLSTATE: 42000): ORDER BY item must be the number of a SELECT-list expression**

<a id="9408885331ceda8b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ORDER BY 의 위치값이 결과 컬럼의 개수보다 크다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, c2 FROM t2 ORDER BY 3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16157): ORDER BY item must be the number of a SELECT-list expression :<br>SELECT c1, c2 FROM t2 ORDER BY 3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 결과 컬럼의 위치를 지정할 수 있는 숫자를 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, c2 FROM t2 ORDER BY 1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C2<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1 null<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16239 (SQLSTATE: 42000): expression must have same datatype as corresponding expression**

<a id="834bb129a41f2147"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16240 (SQLSTATE: 42000): subquery expressions not allowed here**

<a id="9e7913fa1acfd9c1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DEFAULT 값으로 subquery 를 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t3 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 ) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16240): subquery expressions not allowed here :<br>CREATE TABLE t3 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 ) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 상수값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t3 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT 0 );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16241 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid number of column names specified**

<a id="54ec7647077563ed"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>결과 컬럼 수와 뷰의 컬럼 수가 다르다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1(a1) AS SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16241): invalid number of column names specified :<br>CREATE VIEW v1(a1) AS SELECT * FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 뷰의 컬럼 수와 결과 컬럼 수를 동일하게 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1(a1) AS SELECT c1 FROM t1;<br><br>View created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16242 (SQLSTATE: 42000): must name this expression with a column alias**

<a id="c8df3f70d14dc796"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>뷰 컬럼의 이름을 부여해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1 + 1, c2 FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16242): must name this expression with a column alias :<br>CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1 + 1, c2 FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 컬럼의 이름을 지정해 준다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1(a1, a2) AS SELECT c1 + 1, c2 FROM t1;<br><br>View created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1 + 1 AS a1, c2 FROM t1;<br><br>View created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16243 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: View definition has compilation errors**

<a id="62b2c708b3101367"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>뷰가 compile error 가 존재하는 상태로 생성되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE FORCE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1, c2 FROM future_table;<br><br>ERR-01000(16243): Warning: View definition has compilation errors<br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>CREATE FORCE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1, c2 FROM future_table<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>View created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>뷰는 생성되었으나 조회할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM v1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16245): view "PUBLIC.V1" has errors :<br>SELECT * FROM v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>SELECT c1, c2 FROM future_table<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>뷰의 compile error 를 해소하면 해당 뷰를 정상적으로 사용할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE future_table( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM v1;<br><br>no rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16244 (SQLSTATE: 42000): bind variables not allowed for data definition operations**

<a id="6b2c68aa305ad810"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DDL 에는 호스트 변수를 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; :v1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16244): bind variables not allowed for data definition operations</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>호스트 변수가 없는 CREATE VIEW 구문을 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 1;<br><br>View created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16245 (SQLSTATE: 42000): view "%s.%s" has errors**

<a id="b7e3e1d712fa9bd2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>뷰에 compile error 가 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1;<br><br>View created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE t1;<br><br>Table dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM v1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16245): view "PUBLIC.V1" has errors :<br>SELECT * FROM v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>뷰의 compile error 를 해소하면 뷰를 조회할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM v1;<br><br>no rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16246 (SQLSTATE: 42000): illegal use of %s data type**

<a id="dfe735dbcb31b640"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>인덱스 키로 LONG VARCHAR 컬럼을 지정할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER, c3 LONG VARCHAR );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1(c3);<br><br>ERR-42000(16246): illegal use of LONG VARCHAR data type :<br>CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1(c3)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>LONG VARCHAR 등의 컬럼은 키로 사용할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16247 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot BACKUP; noarchivelog mode**

<a id="31df08d34aafa27e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>noarchivelog mode에서는 database 및 tablespace의 backup을 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE BEGIN BACKUP;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16247): cannot BACKUP; noarchivelog mode<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE DISK_DATA_TBS BEGIN BACKUP;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16247): cannot BACKUP; noarchivelog mode</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>backup 기능을 위해서는 database를 archivelog mode (<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#4f26758a283bbab9">ARCHIVELOG_MODE</a>)로 전환 후 재시작한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16248 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot RECOVER TABLESPACE; tablespace is in use**

<a id="2ba98671a01335f8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>사용 중인 tablespace(online)에 대해서 recover를 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16248): cannot RECOVER TABLESPACE; tablespace is in use :<br>ALTER DATABASE RECOVER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>tablespace를 offline 상태로 변경 후 recover를 수행할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS OFFLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16249 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot SHUTDOWN; backup in progress**

<a id="c7ae4aa0c12a9b83"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16250 (SQLSTATE: HY000): RECOVER UNTIL CANCEL can be issued by directly attached session only - deprecated**

<a id="2216d88bf3112dac"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16251 (SQLSTATE: 42000): single-row subquery returns more than one row**

<a id="cda6b221a7451e19"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16252 (SQLSTATE: 42000): circular view definition encountered**

<a id="301a9ffa8eb3ceef"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>상호 참조하는 뷰가 생성되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE FORCE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1 FROM v2;<br><br>ERR-01000(16243): Warning: View definition has compilation errors<br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>CREATE FORCE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1 FROM v2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>View created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE FORCE VIEW v2 AS SELECT c1 FROM v1;<br><br>ERR-01000(16243): Warning: View definition has compilation errors<br>ERR-42000(16245): view "PUBLIC.V1" has errors :<br>CREATE FORCE VIEW v2 AS SELECT c1 FROM v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>SELECT c1 FROM v2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-01000(16243): Warning: View definition has compilation errors<br>View created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM v1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16245): view "PUBLIC.V1" has errors :<br>SELECT * FROM v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-42000(16252): circular view definition encountered :<br>SELECT c1 FROM v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>뷰 생성시 상호 참조하지 않도록 한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16253 (SQLSTATE: 42000): only base table columns are allowed to GRANT/REVOKE**

<a id="5f017c74cf7e3806"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>컬럼 권한 제어는 base table 에 대해서만 가능하다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT(c1) ON v1 TO u1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16253): only base table columns are allowed to GRANT/REVOKE :<br>GRANT SELECT(c1) ON v1 TO u1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>뷰에 대한 권한 제어는 아래와 같이 컬럼을 기술하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT ON v1 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>테이블에 대한 컬럼 권한 제어는 가능하다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT(c1) ON t1 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16254 (SQLSTATE: 42000): lacks privilege (%s ON TABLE "%s"."%s")**

<a id="c5503784ca3deedd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>해당 테이블에 대해 SELECT 를 수행할 권한이 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT current_user FROM dual;<br><br>CURRENT_USER<br>------------<br>U1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM public.t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16254): lacks privilege (SELECT ON TABLE "PUBLIC"."T1")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>객체 소유자가 권한을 부여하면 관련 구문을 실행할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT ON public.t1 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM public.t1;<br><br>no rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16255 (SQLSTATE: 42000): lacks privilege (USAGE ON SEQUENCE "%s"."%s")**

<a id="0656616063ab0fc4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>해당 시퀀스를 사용할 권한이 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT public.seq1.NEXTVAL FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(16255): lacks privilege (USAGE ON SEQUENCE "PUBLIC"."SEQ1") :<br>SELECT public.seq1.NEXTVAL FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>객체 소유자가 권한을 부여하면 시퀀스를 사용할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT USAGE ON SEQUENCE public.seq1 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; connect u1 u1<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT public.seq1.NEXTVAL FROM dual;<br><br>NEXTVAL<br>-------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16256 (SQLSTATE: 07001): wrong number of parameters**

<a id="1a5bba9f808a9564"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SQL 구문에 사용된 호스트 변수의 개수와 Application 에서 사용한 호스트 변수의 개수가 다르다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Application 의 bind parameter 사용을 확인한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16257 (SQLSTATE: HY000): argument of CASE/WHEN must be type boolean**

<a id="35b6f17f9872debb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>CASE/WHEN 의 인자는 boolean 타입이어야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT CASE WHEN ( c1 ) THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'BAD' END AS result FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16075): inconsistent datatypes : expected BOOLEAN :<br>SELECT CASE WHEN ( c1 ) THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'BAD' END AS result FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>CASE/WHEN 에는 조건식을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT CASE WHEN ( c1 = 1 ) THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'BAD' END AS result FROM t1;<br><br>RESULT<br>------<br>GOOD<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16258 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the XID does not exist**

<a id="7380d3ee5be87c97"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시스템에 존재하지 않는 xa transaction을 in-doubt commit/rollback 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16258): the XID does not exist :<br>COMMIT FORCE '0.3130.00'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; ROLLBACK FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16258): the XID does not exist :<br>ROLLBACK FORCE '0.3130.00'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>V$XA_TRANSACTION (<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/9-database-information.md#6aa3b1129f860b99">V$XA_TRANSACTION</a>) 을 조회하여 commit/rollback을 수행할 xa transaction을 확인한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16259 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the XID string is not valid**

<a id="6280c89ad7336156"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>in-doubt commit/rollback을 수행하려고 하는 target xa transaction의 xid가 valid하지 않다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT FORCE '0.';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16259): the XID string is not valid:<br>COMMIT FORCE '0.'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-HY000(12162): invalid XID string<br><br>gSQL&gt; ROLLBACK FORCE '0.';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16259): the XID string is not valid:<br>ROLLBACK FORCE '0.'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-HY000(12162): invalid XID string</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>V$XA_TRANSACTION (<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/9-database-information.md#6aa3b1129f860b99">V$XA_TRANSACTION</a>) 을 조회하여 commit/rollback을 수행할 xa transaction을 확인한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16260 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the global transaction is in progress**

<a id="ff5d3dda6f2cd91e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>in-doubt commit/rollback을 수행하려는 target xa transaction이 associate 된 상태이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16260): the global transaction is in progress :<br>COMMIT FORCE '0.3130.00'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; ROLLBACK FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16260): the global transaction is in progress :<br>ROLLBACK FORCE '0.3130.00'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>V$XA_TRANSACTION (<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/9-database-information.md#6aa3b1129f860b99">V$XA_TRANSACTION</a>) 을 조회하여 commit/rollback을 수행할 xa transaction을 확인한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16261 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid INCREMENTAL BACKUP LEVEL specified : %d**

<a id="275ef75738cb6df1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>증분 백업의 level이 valid 하지 않다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 5;<br><br>ERR-42000(16261): invalid INCREMENTAL BACKUP LEVEL specified : 5</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>(<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#93565f80d30924b0">ALTER DATABASE BACKUP</a>) 증분 백업의 level은 0부터 4까지 지정할 수 있다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16262 (SQLSTATE: 42000): INCREMENTAL BACKUP LEVEL 0 cannot have any BACKUP options**

<a id="4a807d898e8c4f8a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>level 0 증분 backup은 backup option (CUMULATIVE/DIFFERENTIAL)을 이용하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0 CUMULATIVE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16262): INCREMENTAL BACKUP LEVEL 0 cannot have any BACKUP options<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0 DIFFERENTIAL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16262): INCREMENTAL BACKUP LEVEL 0 cannot have any BACKUP options</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>level 0 증분 backup은 backup option을 이용하지 않고 수행한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16263 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot RESTORE TABLESPACE; tablespace is in use**

<a id="767fe4a3d9c466f7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>사용 중인 tablespace (online)에 대해서 restore를 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RESTORE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16263): cannot RESTORE TABLESPACE; tablespace is in use :<br>ALTER DATABASE RESTORE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>tablespace를 offline 상태로 변경 후 restore를 수행할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS OFFLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RESTORE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16264 (SQLSTATE: HY000): transaction is in progress**

<a id="13714503fbebb12d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16265 (SQLSTATE: 42000): outer join operator (+) cannot be used with ANSI joins**

<a id="8788e9250ad7b27c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>outer join operator (+) 를 INNER JOIN 과 함께 기술할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 INNER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1 (+);<br><br>ERR-42000(16265): outer join operator (+) cannot be used with ANSI joins :<br>SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 INNER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1 (+)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>INNER JOIN 을 수행할 의도였다면 (+) 기호를 제거하고<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 INNER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1;<br><br>C1 C1<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>LEFT OUTER JOIN 을 수행할 의도였다면, SQL 표준 LEFT OUTER JOIN 을 구문을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;2 null<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>아래와 같이 비표준 구문으로 (+) 기호를 사용할 경우<br>위의 LEFT OUTER JOIN 과 동일한 결과를 얻을 수 있으나,<br>SQL 표준 구문인 LEFT OUTER JOIN 을 사용할 것을 권고한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.c1 = t2.c1 (+);<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;2 null<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16266 (SQLSTATE: 42000): outer join operator (+) not allowed in %s**

<a id="c36f5741c63f204c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>outer join operator (+) 를 SELECT list 에 기술할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1(+) FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16266): outer join operator (+) not allowed in select-list :<br>SELECT t1.c1(+) FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>비표준 연산자인 outer join operator (+) 는 WHERE 절에 사용할 수 있으나,<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.c1 = t2.c1 (+);<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;2 null<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>아래와 같이 SQL 표준인 LEFT OUTER JOIN 을 사용하는 것이 바람직하다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;2 null<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16267 (SQLSTATE: 42000): an outer join cannot be specified on a correlation column**

<a id="69c97228dbdb3479"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>outer join operator (+) 는 외부 컬럼에 대해 표현할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM t2 WHERE t2.c1 = t1.c1(+) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16267): an outer join cannot be specified on a correlation column :<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM t2 WHERE t2.c1 = t1.c1(+) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 outer join operator (+) 를 제거한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM t2 WHERE t2.c1 = t1.c1 );<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16268 (SQLSTATE: 42000): a predicate may reference only one outer-joined table**

<a id="2b2dba8ec5454b0e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>outer join operator (+) 를 여러 table 에 걸쳐 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1, t3.c1 FROM t1, t2, t3 WHERE t1.c1 = t2.c1(+) + t3.c1(+);<br><br>ERR-42000(16268): a predicate may reference only one outer-joined table :<br>SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1, t3.c1 FROM t1, t2, t3 WHERE t1.c1 = t2.c1(+) + t3.c1(+)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SQL 표준인 LEFT OUTER JOIN 을 사용하여 의도에 맞게 변경한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2_c1, t3_c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;( SELECT t2.c1 AS t2_c1, t3.c1 AS t3_c1 FROM t2, t3 ) v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ON t1.c1 = v1.t2_c1 + v1.t3_c1;<br><br>C1 T2_C1 T3_C1<br>-- ----- -----<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;null&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16269 (SQLSTATE: 42000): a table may be outer joined to at most one other table**

<a id="67d6dfb2bdf0aba3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>outer join operator (+) 를 이용한 outer join 관계는 하나의 table 은 다른 하나의 table 에 대해서만 표현할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1, t3.c1 FROM t1, t2, t3 WHERE t1.c1 = t3.c1(+) AND t2.c2 = t3.c2(+);<br><br>ERR-42000(16269): a table may be outer joined to at most one other table :<br>SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1, t3.c1 FROM t1, t2, t3 WHERE t1.c1 = t3.c1(+) AND t2.c2 = t3.c2(+)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SQL 표준인 LEFT OUTER JOIN 을 이용하여 목적에 맞게 변환한다.<br><br>데이터가 아래와 같다고 하자<br><br>gSQL&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT * FROM t2;<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT * FROM t3;<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>다수 테이블에 대한 LEFT OUTER JOIN 은 연산 순서에 따라<br>결과가 달라지므로 연산 순서를 명확히 하여야 한다.<br><br><ul><li>사례 1 : t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( t2 LEFT OUTER JOIN t3 )</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1, t3.c1 FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( t2 LEFT OUTER JOIN t3 ON t2.c2 = t3.c2 ) ON t1.c1 = t3.c1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ---- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;2 null null<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br><ul><li>사례 2 : t2 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t3 )</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1, t3.c1 FROM t2 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t3 ON t1.c1 = t3.c1 ) ON t1.c2 = t3.c2;<br><br>C1 C1 C1<br>-- -- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16270 (SQLSTATE: 42000): two tables cannot be outer-joined to each other**

<a id="c5723086ebe0d4e6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>outer join operator (+) 가 서로 교차되는 형태로 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.c1(+) = t2.c1 AND t1.c1 = t2.c1(+);<br><br>ERR-42000(16270): two tables cannot be outer-joined to each other :<br>SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.c1(+) = t2.c1 AND t1.c1 = t2.c1(+)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>outer join operator(+) 를 사용한 의도에 따라,<br>SQL 표준인 LEFT OUTER JOIN 또는 FULL OUTER JOIN 을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 FULL OUTER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;2 null<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16271 (SQLSTATE: 42000): RESTART value cannot be made to be less than the MINVALUE**

<a id="05394f2abebaf92f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시퀀스의 RESTART value 가 MINVALUE 보다 작다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 10000000;<br><br>Sequence created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 0;<br><br>ERR-42000(16271): RESTART value cannot be made to be less than the MINVALUE :<br>ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>RESTART value 는 MINVALUE 와 같거나 큰 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 1;<br><br>Sequence altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16272 (SQLSTATE: 42000): RESTART value cannot be made to exceed the MAXVALUE**

<a id="171819262fd36859"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시퀀스의 RESTART value 가 MAXVALUE 보다 크다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 20000;<br><br>ERR-42000(16272): RESTART value cannot be made to exceed the MAXVALUE :<br>ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 20000<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>RESTART value 는 MINVALUE ~ MAXVALUE 범위의 값을 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 1;<br><br>Sequence altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16273 (SQLSTATE: 42000): MINVALUE cannot be made to exceed the current value**

<a id="47d0a08a5750e4ec"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td align="left" valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시퀀스의 현재값보다 큰 MINVALUE 로 변경할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT seq1.NEXTVAL FROM dual;<br><br>NEXTVAL<br>-------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16273): MINVALUE cannot be made to exceed the current value :<br>ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>현재값보다 작은 MINVALUE 값으로 변경해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 1;<br><br>Sequence altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16274 (SQLSTATE: 42000): MAXVALUE cannot be made to be less than the current value**

<a id="d2ca57e98bb71c49"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시퀀스의 현재값보다 작은 MAXVALUE 로 변경할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT seq1.NEXTVAL FROM dual;<br><br>NEXTVAL<br>-------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MAXVALUE 4;<br><br>ERR-42000(16274): MAXVALUE cannot be made to be less than the current value :<br>ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MAXVALUE 4<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>현재값보다 큰 MAXVALUE 값으로 변경해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MAXVALUE 1000;<br><br>Sequence altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16275 (SQLSTATE: 42000): MINVALUE cannot be made to exceed the START WITH value**

<a id="b90c4dc638187cfa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시퀀스의 MINVALUE 가 START WITH 값보다 크다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 10;<br><br>Sequence created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 100 MINVALUE 20;<br><br>ERR-42000(16275): MINVALUE cannot be made to exceed the START WITH value :<br>ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 100 MINVALUE 20<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>MINVALUE 변경 시 START WITH 보다 작거나 같은 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 10;<br><br>Sequence created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 100 MINVALUE 1;<br><br>Sequence altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16276 (SQLSTATE: 42000): MAXVALUE cannot be made to be less than START WITH value**

<a id="324d3e080577b560"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시퀀스의 MAXVALUE 값이 START WITH 값보다 작다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 1000 INCREMENT BY -1 MAXVALUE 1000;<br><br>Sequence created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT seq1.NEXTVAL FROM t1;<br><br>NEXTVAL<br>-------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1000<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;999<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;998<br><br>3 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MAXVALUE 999;<br><br>ERR-42000(16276): MAXVALUE cannot be made to be less than START WITH value :<br>ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MAXVALUE 999<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>START WITH 보다 큰 MAXVALUE 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MAXVALUE 100000;<br><br>Sequence altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16277 (SQLSTATE: 42000): log group id is already used**

<a id="be81b7feafc868be"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>시스템에 이미 존재하는 log group id로 새로운 log group을 추가할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE GROUP 10 ( 'abc.log' ) SIZE 20M;<br><br>Database altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE GROUP 10 ( 'abc2.log' ) SIZE 20M;<br><br>ERR-42000(16277): log group id is already used :<br>ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE GROUP 10 ( 'abc2.log' ) SIZE 20M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>log group을 추가할 때 시스템에 존재하지 않는 새로운 log group id를 설정한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16278 (SQLSTATE: 42000): identity column cannot have a default value**

<a id="73f2837471ddac76"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Identity Column 에는 DEFAULT 값을 지정할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c1 SET DEFAULT 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16278): identity column cannot have a default value :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c1 SET DEFAULT 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>테이블의 Identity Column 을 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT table_name, column_name FROM user_tab_identity_cols;<br><br>TABLE_NAME COLUMN_NAME<br>---------- -----------<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c2 SET DEFAULT 1;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16279 (SQLSTATE: 42000): DEFAULT expression has errors**

<a id="8e4f6855391895ae"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DEFAULT 값에 에러가 발생하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1;<br><br>Sequence created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT 1, c2 INTEGER DEFAULT seq1.NEXTVAL );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT, DEFAULT );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP SEQUENCE seq1;<br><br>Sequence dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT, DEFAULT );<br><br>ERR-42000(16279): DEFAULT expression has errors :<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT, DEFAULT )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-42000(16036): 'SEQ1.NEXTVAL': invalid identifier :<br>DEFAULT seq1.NEXTVAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>컬럼의 DEFAULT 를 다시 설정한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c2 SET DEFAULT 1;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT, DEFAULT );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16280 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the statement is disallowed**

<a id="8190927d20259dfc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>제품 개발 단계에서 특정 테스트를 위해 사용하는 에러이다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16281 (SQLSTATE: 42000): resource manager doing work outside transaction**

<a id="7e34a33095ac3a8e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>세션에 수행 중인 트랜잭션이 존재할 때 in-doubt xa transaction을 commit/rollback 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ROLLBACK FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>ERR-42000(16281): resource manager doing work outside transaction<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>ERR-42000(16281): resource manager doing work outside transaction</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>세션에 수행 중인 트랜잭션을 완료 후 in-doubt xa transaction을 완료한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>Commit complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16282 (SQLSTATE: 42000): MEMORY tablespace does not support an AUTOEXTEND option**

<a id="e51f37e4d68ceb5d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>memory tablespace의 datafile은 autoextend를 지원하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DATAFILE 'system_data.dbf' AUTOEXTEND ON;<br><br>ERR-42000(16282): MEMORY tablespace does not support an AUTOEXTEND option :<br>ALTER DATABASE DATAFILE 'system_data.dbf' AUTOEXTEND ON<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>disk tablespace의 datafile에 대해서만 autoextend를 지원한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DATAFILE 'system_disk_data.dbf' AUTOEXTEND ON;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16283 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid ROWID**

<a id="5edb7490a2f76fee"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>유효하지 않은 ROWID 값이 사용되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT rowid FROM t1;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ROWID<br>-----------------------<br>AAAAAAAAYgeAACAAgCAjAAA<br>AAAAAAAAYgeAACAAgCAjAAB<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t2 WHERE ROWID = 'AAAAAAAAYgeAACAAgCAjAAA';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16283): invalid ROWID</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>ROWID 를 획득한 table 에 대해 조회해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE ROWID = 'AAAAAAAAYgeAACAAgCAjAAA';<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16284 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unable to execute in CDS mode**

<a id="4c1cd17730b0ff73"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">CDS 모드에서 실행할 수 없는 구문이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RESTORE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS2;<br>ERR-HY000(16286) unable to execute in CDS mode</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16285 (SQLSTATE: RP000): failed to create system threads**

<a id="9a6f1919f987335b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16286 (SQLSTATE: HY000): valid incremental backup does not exist**

<a id="f46fc2e158d707c4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">다음 구문들을 수행할 때 현재 incremental backup 이 존재하지 않는다.<br><ul><li>USING BACKUP 절이 없는<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#233fbcf85decd22e">ALTER DATABASE RECOVER DATAFILE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#60ea018060bd0c35">ALTER DATABASE RESTORE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#60ea018060bd0c35">ALTER DATABASE RESTORE TABLESPACE</a></li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RESTORE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14092): not exist incremental backup</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Incremental backup의 존재 여부를 확인한 후 다시 수행한다.<br><br>다음은 incremental backup 을 확인하는 방법이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT backup_name, backup_scope, incremental_level FROM v$incremental_backup;<br><br>BACKUP_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BACKUP_SCOPE INCREMENTAL_LEVEL<br>--------------------------------------- ------------ -----------------<br>database_D20260304_T133953_L0_Q0_P0.inc database&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>control_D20260304_T133954_L0_Q1.inc&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;control&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16287 (SQLSTATE: 42000): log group id does not exist**

<a id="f7435e90da6e5d28"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#975c069a4f386a7c">ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE</a>&nbsp;구문을 수행할 때 log group id 에 해당하는 그룹이 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE MEMBER 'redo_4_0.log' TO GROUP 4;<br><br>ERR-42000(16287): log group id does not exist :<br>ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE MEMBER 'redo_4_0.log' TO GROUP 4<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">log group id의 존재 여부를 확인한 후 다시 수행한다.<br><br>다음은 log group id 를 확인하는 방법이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT group_id, COUNT(group_id) FROM v$logfile GROUP BY group_id;<br><br>GROUP_ID COUNT(GROUP_ID)<br>-------- ---------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16288 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid string value specified**

<a id="d63161f75267ddf3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16289 (SQLSTATE: 42000): into clause can have only one row**

<a id="225a5e70d856cedb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SELECT INTO 의 결과 건수가 여러 개이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 INTO :v1 FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16289): into clause can have only one row</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>하나의 결과만 생성될 수 있도록 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 INTO :v1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16290 (SQLSTATE: 42000): SHUTDOWN must be executed in dedicated session**

<a id="318b56c17083b9fc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Shutdown 은 shared session 에서 실행할 수 없다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Shutdown 은 dedicated session 에서 실행해야 한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16291 (SQLSTATE: 40002): transaction rollback: integrity constraint violation**

<a id="4970efc022496291"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>지연가능한 제약조건을 위반한 상태로 COMMIT 하여 transaction 이 ROLLBACK 되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 2 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>ERR-40002(16291): transaction rollback: integrity constraint violation : T1_UNIQUE_C1(1)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 제약조건을 위배하지 않도록 하여 COMMIT 해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 2 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t1 SET c1 = 2 WHERE c2 = 2;<br><br>1 row updated.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16292 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column length specifier is out of range( 1 to %d ) for columnar table**

<a id="b3385dcd3daab7d7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16293 (SQLSTATE: 42000): columnar table does not support LONG VARCHAR and LONG VARBINARY**

<a id="19d189be37e206ef"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16294 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot defer a constraint that is not deferrable**

<a id="1b90e2f0166cb9aa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>NOT DEFERRABLE 제약조건에 DEFERRED 설정을 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER UNIQUE(c1) NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;<br><br>ERR-42000(16294): cannot defer a constraint that is not deferrable :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER UNIQUE(c1) NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 DEFERRABLE 을 기술해 주어야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER UNIQUE(c1) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16295 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid NOT NULL constraint specified on an identity column**

<a id="6a8a0a3cda5104fc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Identity Column 에 대해 deferrable NOT NULL 제약조건을 설정할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL DEFERRABLE );<br><br>ERR-42000(16295): invalid NOT NULL constraint specified on an identity column :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL DEFERRABLE )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 DEFERRABLE 을 제거한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16296 (SQLSTATE: 42000): constraint '%s' is not deferrable**

<a id="96fe254463e5dd64"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>지연가능한 제약조건이 아니다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_uk UNIQUE );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINTS t1_uk DEFERRED;<br><br>ERR-42000(16296): constraint 'T1_UK' is not deferrable :<br>SET CONSTRAINTS t1_uk DEFERRED<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>지연가능한 제약조건에 한해 SET CONSTRAINTS 구문을 사용할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_uk UNIQUE DEFERRABLE );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINTS t1_uk DEFERRED;<br><br>Constraints set.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16297 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate constraint name specified**

<a id="7c75d14ffea0195b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 제약조건 이름을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_uk1 UNIQUE, c2 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_uk2 UNIQUE );<br><br>Table created.<br><br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 RENAME CONSTRAINT t1_uk2 TO t1_uk1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16297): duplicate constraint name specified :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 RENAME CONSTRAINT t1_uk2 TO t1_uk1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>새로운 제약조건 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 RENAME CONSTRAINT t1_uk2 TO t1_uk_new;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16298 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot make primary key supplemental log data with primary key constraint violation**

<a id="efb172c093d307eb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16299 (SQLSTATE: 42000): datafile does not exist in database**

<a id="29864f4748bdc80f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#233fbcf85decd22e">ALTER DATABASE RECOVER DATAFILE</a>&nbsp;구문을 수행할 때 지정한 datafile 이 디스크 상에는 존재하지만 database 에서 사용 중인 파일이 아니다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER DATAFILE 'test.dbf';<br><br>ERR-42000(16299): datafile does not exist in database</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">해당 datafile 이 데이터베이스에서 사용 중인지 확인한 후 다시 수행한다.<br><br>다음은 사용 중인 datafile 을 확인하는 방법이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT tbs_name, datafile_name FROM v$datafile;<br><br>TBS_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DATAFILE_NAME<br>-------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------<br>DICTIONARY_TBS /test/db/system_dict.dbf<br>MEM_UNDO_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;/test/db/system_undo.dbf<br>MEM_DATA_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;/test/db/system_data.dbf<br>MEM_TEMP_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;system_temp<br>DISK_DATA_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;/test/db/system_disk_data.dbf<br>MEM_AUX_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;/test/db/system_aux.dbf<br>MEM_TRANS_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;/test/db/system_trans.dbf<br><br>7 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16300 (SQLSTATE: 42000): too many SQL resource**

<a id="3b7455606e349ede"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>expression 최대 개수 (2,147,483,648)를 초과하였다.<br><br>예: SELECT 1+2+3+...........+2147483647+2147483648 FROM dual;</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16301 (SQLSTATE: 42000): name '%s' is already used by an existing public synonym**

<a id="13ca68b772b18563"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 이름의 public synonym 이 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PUBLIC SYNONYM ps1 FOR t1;<br><br>Synonym created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PUBLIC SYNONYM ps1 FOR t2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16301): name 'PS1' is already used by an existing public synonym :<br>CREATE PUBLIC SYNONYM ps1 FOR t2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>기존에 사용 되지 않은 synonym 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PUBLIC SYNONYM ps2 FOR t2;<br><br>Synonym created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16302 (SQLSTATE: 42000): private synonym '%s' to be dropped does not exist**

<a id="6357d9934bd24cb4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>private synonym 이 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP SYNONYM s1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16302): private synonym 'S1' to be dropped does not exist :<br>DROP SYNONYM s1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>private synonym 이 존재하는지 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT synonym_name FROM user_synonyms;<br><br>SYNONYM_NAME<br>------------<br>S2<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP SYNONYM s2;<br><br>Synonym dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16303 (SQLSTATE: 42000): public synonym '%s' to be dropped does not exist**

<a id="6c2f27ae55b8411e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>public synonym 이 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP PUBLIC SYNONYM ps3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16303): public synonym 'PS3' to be dropped does not exist :<br>DROP PUBLIC SYNONYM ps3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>public synonym 이 존재하는지 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT synonym_name FROM all_synonyms WHERE synonym_schema IS NULL;<br><br>SYNONYM_NAME<br>-------------------<br>DUAL<br>...<br>...<br>PS1<br>PS2<br><br>317 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP PUBLIC SYNONYM ps1;<br><br>Synonym dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16304 (SQLSTATE: 42000): looping chain of synonyms**

<a id="292b7932f6dfe650"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>자기 자신을 참조하는 looping chain 이 발생하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SYNONYM s1 FOR s1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16304): looping chain of synonyms :<br>CREATE SYNONYM s1 FOR s1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>looping chain 이 발생하지 않도록 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SYNONYM s1 FOR t1;<br><br>Synonym created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16305 (SQLSTATE: 42000): synonym translation is no longer valid**

<a id="0e1a3d74c680007c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>synonym 이 참조하는 객체가 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SYNONYM s1 FOR invalid;<br><br>Synonym created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM s1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>SELECT * FROM s1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>참조하는 객체가 존재하는 synonym 을 생성한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SYNONYM s1 FOR t1;<br><br>Synonym created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM s1;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16306 (SQLSTATE: 42000): expression is out of iteration time scope**

<a id="5e2bd7bbb2eb2baf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>서버 내부에서 사용하는 에러 코드이다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16307 (SQLSTATE: 42000): constant value expression expected**

<a id="794c824affb90c42"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16308 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid or redundant resource**

<a id="2bf2956779a52c2b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>중복된 profile parameter 가 사용되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PROFILE p1 LIMIT FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 1 FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16308): invalid or redundant resource :<br>CREATE PROFILE p1 LIMIT FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 1 FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>중복된 profile parameter 를 제거한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PROFILE p1 LIMIT FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 1;<br><br>Profile created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16309 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the account is locked**

<a id="a0693b916c8b5c98"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>계정이 잠겨있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 ACCOUNT LOCK;<br><br>User altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br><br>ERR-28000(16309): the account is locked</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>계정 잠금을 해제한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 ACCOUNT UNLOCK;<br><br>User altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT current_user FROM dual;<br><br>CURRENT_USER<br>------------<br>U1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16310 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the password will expire in %ld days**

<a id="15c7281bd9ebe713"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>password 가 해당 기간 후에 만료된다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br><br>ERR-28000(16310): the password will expire in 1 days</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>사용자의 password 를 변경한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16311 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the password will expire soon**

<a id="533cafd7b399f31f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>사용자의 password 가 특정기간 (GRACE TIME) 이후 만료된다.<br><br>% gsql u1 u1<br><br>ERR-28000(16311): the password will expire soon<br><br>Connected to Database.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>사용자의 password 를 변경한다.<br><br>사용자의 계정 상태는 아래와 같이 확인할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT username, account_status, lock_date, expiry_date FROM user_users;<br><br>USERNAME ACCOUNT_STATUS LOCK_DATE EXPIRY_DATE<br>-------- -------------- --------- --------------------------<br>U1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXPIRED(GRACE) null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2024-02-29 14:40:50.140375<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 IDENTIFIED BY u1_new REPLACE u1;<br><br>User altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT username, account_status, lock_date, expiry_date FROM user_users;<br><br>USERNAME ACCOUNT_STATUS LOCK_DATE EXPIRY_DATE<br>-------- -------------- --------- --------------------------<br>U1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2025-02-28 14:51:18.110624<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16312 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the password has expired**

<a id="dd941a1b46bbcddd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>login 은 성공하였으나 password 가 만료되었다.<br><br>% gsql u1 u1<br><br>ERR-28000(16312): the password has expired<br>Changing password for u1<br>New password:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>새로운 password 를 입력한다.<br><br>Changing password for u1<br>New password: ******<br>Retype new password: ******<br><br>Connected to Database.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16313 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the password cannot be reused**

<a id="e53acf6f81b8eb99"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 password 로 변경할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 IDENTIFIED BY u1 REPLACE u1;<br><br>ERR-28000(16313): the password cannot be reused</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>기존과 다른 password 를 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 IDENTIFIED BY u1_new REPLACE u1;<br><br>User altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="7d4a8504ff3fbf52"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>존재하지 않는 PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION 을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PROFILE prof1 LIMIT PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION invalid;<br><br>ERR-42000(16316): function 'INVALID' not found :<br>ALTER PROFILE prof1 LIMIT PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION invalid<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 존재하는 PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION 을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PROFILE prof1 LIMIT PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION KISA_VERIFY_FUNCTION;<br><br>Profile altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16320 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot assign DEFAULT parameter value to "DEFAULT" profile**

<a id="aa36127ec67daff6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>"DEFAULT" profile 에는 DEFAULT 값을 설정할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PROFILE default LIMIT FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS DEFAULT;<br><br>ERR-42000(16320): cannot assign DEFAULT parameter value to "DEFAULT" profile :<br>ALTER PROFILE default LIMIT FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS DEFAULT<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>"DEFAULT" profile 에는 다른 profile 에서 사용할 DEFAULT 값이 설정되어 있다.<br>따라서 "DEFAULT" profile 에는 유효한 값으로 설정해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM dba_profiles WHERE profile_name = 'DEFAULT';<br><br>PROFILE_NAME RESOURCE_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RESOURCE_TYPE LIMIT_VALUE COMMON<br>------------ ------------------------ ------------- ----------- ------<br>DEFAULT&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PASSWORD&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;10&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;YES<br>DEFAULT&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PASSWORD&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;YES<br>DEFAULT&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PASSWORD&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;180&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;YES<br>DEFAULT&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PASSWORD_GRACE_TIME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PASSWORD&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;7&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;YES<br>DEFAULT&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PASSWORD_REUSE_MAX&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PASSWORD&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNLIMITED&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;YES<br>DEFAULT&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PASSWORD_REUSE_TIME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PASSWORD&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNLIMITED&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;YES<br>DEFAULT&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION PASSWORD&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;YES<br><br>7 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PROFILE default LIMIT FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 20;<br><br>Profile altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16321 (SQLSTATE: 42000): password length less than '%d'**

> **16322 (SQLSTATE: 42000): password must contain at least '%d' letter(s)**

<a id="eeb7d4b841cc1e1d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION 의 제약 중에 password 문자 사용 제약을 만족하지 못하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PROFILE p1 LIMIT PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION KISA_VERIFY_FUNCTION;<br><br>Profile created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 PROFILE p1;<br><br>User altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 IDENTIFIED BY "1234567801";<br><br>ERR-42000(16322): password must contain at least '1' letter(s)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>지정된 PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION 의 제약을 준수하는 password 를 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 IDENTIFIED BY axUt_z3qt;<br><br>User altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16323 (SQLSTATE: 42000): password must contain at least uppercase '%d' character(s)**

<a id="4c88623eb03a68e8"></a>

> **16324 (SQLSTATE: 42000): password must contain at least lowercase '%d' character(s)**

<a id="908dcb63464083d4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION 의 제약 중에 password 의 소문자 횟수 제약을 만족하지 못하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PROFILE p1 LIMIT PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION ORA12C_STRONG_VERIFY_FUNCTION;<br><br>Profile altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 PROFILE p1;<br><br>User altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 IDENTIFIED BY A1U2DX_12;<br><br>ERR-42000(16324): password must contain at least lowercase '2' character(s)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>지정된 PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION 의 제약을 준수하는 password 를 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 IDENTIFIED BY a1B2_C3f_dja;<br><br>User altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16335 (SQLSTATE: 42000): UPDATE primary key not allowed for supplemental log table**

<a id="0b940aa1aa76fcaf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SUPPLEMENTAL LOG 가 설정된 테이블의 primary key UPDATE 를 허용하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD SUPPLEMENTAL LOG DATA ( PRIMARY KEY ) COLUMNS;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET DISABLE_UPDATE_PK_CDC_GIVEUP = ON;<br><br>Session altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t1 SET c1 = 2 WHERE c2 = 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16335): UPDATE primary key not allowed for supplemental log table</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>DISABLE_UPDATE_PK_CDC_GIVEUP 프로퍼티가 설정된 경우 primary key 를 UPDATE 할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16336 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster group '%s' does not exist**

<a id="7e5df4a793390197"></a>

> **16337 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate cluster object listed**

<a id="841cb7a673da0663"></a>

> **16338 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster domain '%s' does not exist**

> **16339 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid hash shard count (must between %d and %d)**

<a id="3e972007e4c43d51"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>hash shard count 값의 범위를 벗어났다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1) SHARD COUNT 513;<br><br>ERR-42000(16339): invalid hash shard count (must between 1 and 512) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1) SHARD COUNT 513<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>유효한 hash shard count ( 1 ~ 512 ) 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1) SHARD COUNT 60;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16340 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not found available sharding key column**

<a id="3db0c0c1562cbe58"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>LONG VARCHAR 컬럼으로만 구성된 테이블은 DEFAULT_SHARDING 프로퍼티로 sharding 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET DEFAULT_SHARDING = 1;<br><br>Session altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 LONG VARCHAR );<br><br>ERR-42000(16340): not found available sharding key column</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>LONG VARCHAR 컬럼으로만 구성된 테이블은 cloned 로 생성한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET DEFAULT_SHARDING = 1;<br><br>Session altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 LONG VARCHAR ) CLONED;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16341 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot specifiy sharding strategy and placement for a table on dictionary schema '%s'**

<a id="8eda14c97000da54"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>system schema 에 생성하는 테이블은 sharding 정책을 명시할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE INFORMATION_SCHEMA.t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) CLONED;<br><br>ERR-42000(16341): cannot specify sharding strategy and placement for a table on dictionary schema 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>system schema 에 사용자 객체를 생성하지 않는다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16343 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid syntax for a stand-alone system**

<a id="169f93b69bc7d4ea"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>stand-alone 시스템에서 사용할 수 없는 구문이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD GLOBAL SECONDARY INDEX;<br><br>ERR-42000(16343): invalid syntax for a stand-alone system :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ADD GLOBAL SECONDARY INDEX<br>*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>cluster 시스템인지 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT is_cluster FROM x$instance;<br><br>IS_CLUSTER<br>----------<br>FALSE<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16344 (SQLSTATE: 42000): database is not local opened**

<a id="c21ed836a894fac0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>현재 start-up 단계가 local opened 상태가 아니다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \startup nomount<br><br>Startup success<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN GLOBAL DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16344): database is not local opened</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>현재 상태를 확인하고 단계적으로 start-up 단계를 변경한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \startup nomount<br><br>Startup success<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM MOUNT DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN LOCAL DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN GLOBAL DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16345 (SQLSTATE: 42000): database is already opened**

> **16346 (SQLSTATE: 42000): name '%s' is already used by an existing cluster object**

<a id="152f7f2f0bcc6d14"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>이미 사용 중인 cluster object 이름이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER CLUSTER GROUP g1 ADD<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g1n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 10101;<br>ERR-42000(16346): name 'G1N1' is already used by an existing cluster object :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g1n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 10101<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>이미 사용 중인 cluster object 이름인지 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT group_name, member_name FROM dba_cluster;<br><br>GROUP_NAME MEMBER_NAME<br>---------- -----------<br>G1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G1N1<br>G1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G1N2<br>G2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G2N1<br>G2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G2N2<br>G3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G3N1<br>G3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G3N2<br><br>6 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16347 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster port is out of range( %d to %d )**

<a id="fb8f25f2b8d1b084"></a>

> **16348 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate cluster connection listed**

<a id="5be2c4a2a181b6d2"></a>
