10428,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g4n29 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 10429,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g4n30 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 10430,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g4n31 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 10431,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g4n32 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 10432,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g4n33 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 10433<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16350): maximum number of cluster members exceeded</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>하나의 cluster group 은 최대 32 까지의 cluster member 로 구성할 수 있다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16351 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to connect to the cluster member '%s'**

<a id="ba3388a657d33d58"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>대상 노드가 구동 중이 아니거나 host 또는 port 값을 잘못 지정한 경우에 발생할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; alter cluster group g3 add cluster member g3n3 host '127.0.0.1' port 13350;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16351): failed to connect to the cluster member 'G3N3'<br>ERR-HY000(56022): failed to connect to a host<br>ERR-HY000(11067): failed to connect to a host with a socket : poll() - port '13350' : stnConnect() returned errno(111)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>대상 노드의 location 정보를 확인한 후 구문을 변경하여 다시 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16352 (SQLSTATE: 42000): mismatch local cluster member with location file**

<a id="0334bcaa3d7ba68b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>새로운 멤버나 그룹을 추가할 때, 대상 멤버의 location 정보와 구문에 지정된 location 정보가 일치하지 않으면&nbsp;&nbsp;발생한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g4 CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11111;<br><br>ERR-42000(16352): mismatch local cluster member with location file :<br>CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g4 CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11111<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>대상 노드의 location 정보를 확인한 후 구문을 변경하여 다시 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16353 (SQLSTATE: 42000): conflict between new cluster member and location file**

<a id="b6806d0c1b69a776"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>새로운 멤버나 그룹을 추가할 때 구문에 지정된 location 정보가 기존에 운영 중인 노드의 location 정보와 충돌하는 경우에 발생한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g4 CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11150;<br><br>ERR-42000(16353): conflict between new cluster member and location file :<br>CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g4 CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11150<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>기존에 운영 중인 노드의 location 정보를 확인한 후 구문을 변경하여 다시 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16354 (SQLSTATE: HY000): connection of member '%s' is broken**

<a id="bc01c7b6678319e8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>특정 cluster member 와의 연결이 단절되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM x$instance;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16354): connection of member 'G2N2' is broken</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>연결이 가능한 유효한 domain 을 명시하거나<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_name FROM x$instance@LOCAL;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_NAME<br>-----------------<br>G1N1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>해당 에러를 warning 으로 처리하는 CLUSTER_IGNORE_INACTIVE_MEMBER 옵션을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET CLUSTER_IGNORE_INACTIVE_MEMBER = ON;<br><br>Session altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_name FROM x$instance;<br><br>ERR-01000(16394): Warning: connection of member 'G2N2' is broken<br>LOCAL_MEMBER_NAME<br>-----------------<br>G1N1<br>G3N2<br>G3N1<br>G1N2<br>G2N1<br><br>5 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16355 (SQLSTATE: 42000): non-deterministic function not allowed here**

<a id="16f6166ba83f1091"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>값이 일정치 않은 non-deterministic function 을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( RANDOM(1,100) ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( RANDOM(1,200) ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16374): range shard bound value must be one of: valid constant or MAXVALUE<br>ERR-42000(16355): non-deterministic function not allowed here :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( RANDOM(1,100) ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 상수값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g2,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16356 (SQLSTATE: 42000): version conflict**

<a id="bd3ac04d86211949"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>서버 내부에서 제어하는 에러이다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16357 (SQLSTATE: 42R01): must be accessible to at least one member of group '%s'**

<a id="ce720df69acfa325"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>해당 cluster group 을 구성하는 모든 cluster member 에 접근할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 12, 12 );<br><br>ERR-42R01(16357): must be accessible to at least one member of group 'G4'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>최소 하나의 cluster member 를 복구해야 한다.<br>단, 다른 cluster group 에 대한 연산은 수행할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE T_RANGE SET I1 = 2 WHERE I1 = 1;<br><br>1 row updated.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16358 (SQLSTATE: 42R01): accessible member does not exist**

<a id="cf3061beacf1893f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>해당 domain 에 접근할 수 있는 cluster member 가 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_cloned@g1;<br><br>ERR-42R01(16358): accessible member does not exist</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>접근 가능한 cluster domain 을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_cloned@g3;<br><br>COUNT(*)<br>--------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16359 (SQLSTATE: 42000): no inactive members**

<a id="8e3217401b5c5cda"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>모든 cluster member 가 연결되어 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS;<br><br>ERR-42000(16359): no inactive members</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>연결이 끊긴 cluster member 를 제거하고자 할 때 수행한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16360 (SQLSTATE: 42R02): cloned table "%s"."%s" must have at least one usable replica**

<a id="6cea7ca8b9b7a9b5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>inactive cluster member 를 모두 drop 할 경우 clone table 의 data 를 모두 잃는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) CLONED AT CLUSTER GROUP g4;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>이후 G4 group 을 구성하는 모든 cluster member 의 연결이 단절된 후 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS;<br><br>ERR-42R02(16360): cloned table "PUBLIC"."T1" must have at least one usable replica</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>data loss 를 유발하는 cluster member 의 DROP 은 허용하지 않는다.<br>data loss 가 발생하지 않도록 최소 하나의 cluster member 를 복원해야 한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16361 (SQLSTATE: 42R02): sharded table "%s"."%s" must have at least one usable replica of group '%s'**

<a id="b61bf5db2a4de794"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>inactive cluster member 를 모두 drop 할 경우 sharded table 의 특정 shard data 를 모두 잃는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1);<br><br>Table created.<br><br>이후 shard 가 배치된 G4 group 을 구성하는 모든 cluster member 의 연결이 단절된 후 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS;<br><br>ERR-42R02(16361): sharded table "PUBLIC"."T1" must have at least one usable replica of group 'G4'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>data loss 를 유발하는 cluster member 의 DROP 은 허용하지 않는다.<br>data loss 가 발생하지 않도록 최소 하나의 cluster member 를 복원해야 한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16362 (SQLSTATE: 42000): NODE SHARDED table cannot be rebalanced**

<a id="8a8458426cb4baa7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>서버 내부에서 사용하는 에러 코드이다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16363 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the cluster member '%s' does not join in a cluster system**

<a id="0395c1f4976f893d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>cluster system 에 join 한 cluster member 가 아니다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16363): the cluster member 'G3N3' failed to join the cluster system</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>접속한 cluster member 는 cluster system 에 참여한 member 가 아니므로 cluster system 에 추가한 후 사용할 수 있다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16364 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster group has sharded data**

<a id="9f150ce292499393"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Sharded table에 data 가 존재하는 cluster group 은 제거할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP CLUSTER GROUP g4;<br>ERR-42000(16364): cluster group has sharded data</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Data loss를 유발하는 DROP CLUSTER GROUP 은 수행할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16365 (SQLSTATE: 42000): schema name of instant table must be SESSION_SCHEMA**

<a id="4f7331362cd76f61"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16366 (SQLSTATE: 42000): hash shard count smaller than AT CLUSTER GROUP list**

<a id="f59e3c3700b6d84b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>hash shard 의 개수보다 나열한 cluster group 의 개수가 작다<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD COUNT 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1, g2, g3;<br>ERR-42000(16366): hash shard count smaller than AT CLUSTER GROUP list</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SHARD COUNT 값을 cluster group 개수보다 크게 설정한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD COUNT 60<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1, g2, g3;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16367 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop sharding key column**

<a id="80a4a9b830b04e87"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>sharding key 로 사용하고 있는 컬럼은 제거할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER, c3 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (sk);<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN (sk);<br><br>ERR-42000(16367): cannot drop sharding key column</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>sharding key 에 포함되지 않은 컬럼만 제거할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN (c2);<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16368 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not a fixed table**

<a id="d28167b9fef5def9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>대상 테이블이 fixed table 이 아니다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER FIXED TABLE t1 RESET;<br><br>ERR-42000(16368): not a fixed table :<br>ALTER FIXED TABLE t1 RESET<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>fixed table 에 대해서만 수행할 수 있는 SQL 문이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER FIXED TABLE x$sql_system_info RESET;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16369 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not a statistics table**

<a id="60eaf38e26d306e2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>누적 통계 정보를 갖는 fixed table 이 아니다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER FIXED TABLE X$AGABLE_INFO RESET;<br><br>ERR-42000(16369): not a statistics table :<br>ALTER FIXED TABLE X$AGABLE_INFO RESET<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>누적 통계정보를 갖는 fixed table 에 대해서만 수행할 수 있는 SQL 문이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER FIXED TABLE x$sql_system_info RESET;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16370 (SQLSTATE: 42000): have to create one or more datafiles to each member**

<a id="b8bd7e5004c234fc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>특정 cluster member 에만 tablespace 를 생성할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS DATAFILE 'test_tbs_g1.dbf' SIZE 10M AT G1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16370): MEMBER(G2N1): have to create one or more datafiles to each member :<br>CREATE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS DATAFILE 'test_tbs_g1.dbf' SIZE 10M AT G1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>tablespace 는 모든 cluster member 에 생성해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS DATAFILE 'test_tbs_g1.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16371 (SQLSTATE: 42000): conversion is not applicable**

<a id="c22e05ddc9eeaf81"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16372 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate shard name**

<a id="4bffed256743d6d3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 shard 이름을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c3 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br><br>ERR-42000(16372): duplicate shard name :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 10:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 서로 다른 shard 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c3 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16373 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the number of elements in shard bound mismatch the sharding key columns**

<a id="ff45dfd2b7fee729"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>shard key column 개수와 value 개수가 다르다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c3 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200, 300 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br>ERR-42000(16373): the number of elements in shard bound mismatch the sharding key columns :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200, 300 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 10:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 shard bound 에 사용되는 값의 개수를 일치시킨다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c3 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16374 (SQLSTATE: 42000): range shard bound value must be one of: valid constant or MAXVALUE**

<a id="092d3def44cbd543"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>shard bound value 에 NULL 값을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( NULL ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16374): range shard bound value must be one of: valid constant or MAXVALUE :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( NULL ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 NULL 값이 아닌 상수를 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c3 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16375 (SQLSTATE: 42000): only MAXVALUE allowed after MAXVALUE**

<a id="095968b868a574f5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MAXVALUE 이후에 상수값을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1, c2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100, MAXVALUE ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE, 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE, MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16375): only MAXVALUE allowed after MAXVALUE :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE, 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 MAXVALUE 의 위치를 조정한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1, c2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100, MAXVALUE ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200, MAXVALUE ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE, MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16376 (SQLSTATE: 42000): multiple MAX shard defined**

<a id="71073bc3510f8ae0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MAX shard 를 여러 번 지정하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16376): multiple MAX shard defined :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 6:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 MAX shard 는 하나만 존재해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16377 (SQLSTATE: 42000): MAX shard not defined**

<a id="302c6338cf31c97f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MAX shard 를 정의하지 않았다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16377): MAX shard not defined :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 MAX shard 를 정의한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16378 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate shard bound value**

<a id="d63eadd8adbb1821"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 shard bound value 를 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16378): duplicate shard bound value :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 서로 다른 shard bound value 를 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16379 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables, '%d' tables failed to rebalance**

<a id="a7faa7f711f8d8b8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>일부 테이블의 rebalance 가 정상적으로 완료되지 않았다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE REBALANCE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16379): of the total '5' tables, '2' tables failed to rebalance :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;concurrent execution : 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;inactive member&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;replica usablility&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;offline tablespace&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;others&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br><br>Database altered.<br><br><ul><li>concurrent execution<br><ul><li>다른 세션과의 동시성 문제로 인해서 실패한 경우</li></ul></li><li>inactive member<br><ul><li>모든 active member의 replica 들이 offline 상태이고 inactive member 가 있는 경우</li></ul></li><li>replica usability<br><ul><li>Local replica 가 unusable 상태이거나</li><li>모든 active member 의 replica 들이 unusable 상태인 경우</li></ul></li><li>offline tablespace<br><ul><li>Local replica 가 오프라인 된 tablespace 에 만들어진 경우</li></ul></li><li>others<br><ul><li>위에 기술된 원인을 제외한 나머지 경우</li></ul></li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td><ul><li>concurrent execution<br><ul><li>동시성 문제로 인해 다른 세션에서의 DDL 수행을 중지하고 다시 시도한다.</li></ul></li><li>inactive member<br><ul><li>inactive member 를 cluster 에 join 한 후 다시 시도한다.</li></ul></li><li>replica usability<br><ul><li>unusable 상태의 replica 를 제거한 후 다시 시도한다.</li><li>unusable replica 는<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#436fa49da2672327">ALTER TABLE name DROP UNUSABLE SEGMENTS</a>&nbsp;구문으로 제거할 수 있다.</li></ul></li><li>offline tablespace<br><ul><li>오프라인 된 tablespace 를 온라인으로 전환한 후 다시 시도한다.</li><li>온라인 전환은<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b9a7e09545483657">ALTER TABLESPACE name [ONLINE|OFFLINE]</a>&nbsp;구문을 사용한다.</li></ul></li><li>others<br><ul><li>system.trc 에서 원인을 확인하고 조치를 취한 후 다시 시도한다.</li></ul></li></ul></td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16380 (SQLSTATE: HYC00): UNIQUE or PRIMARY KEY must include all sharding key columns for cluster system**

<a id="7763c39ed8478247"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>PRIMARY KEY 가 shard key 를 포함하지 않았다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (sk);<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD PRIMARY KEY (c1);<br><br>ERR-HYC00(16380): UNIQUE or PRIMARY KEY must include all sharding key columns for cluster system</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 shard key 를 포함하여 생성한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD PRIMARY KEY (c1, sk);<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16381 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid shard count (must between %d and %d)**

<a id="8f75a1972c44f893"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16382 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster member '%s' does not exist**

<a id="44c80bb73c7e0171"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>cluster member 가 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMENT ON CLUSTER MEMBER invalid IS 'test comment';<br><br>ERR-42000(16382): cluster member 'INVALID' does not exist :<br>COMMENT ON CLUSTER MEMBER invalid IS 'test comment'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>유효한 cluster member 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMENT ON CLUSTER MEMBER g2n1 IS 'test comment';<br><br>Comment created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16383 (SQLSTATE: 42000): domain '%s' is unknown**

<a id="fdd0110b2e65194a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16384 (SQLSTATE: 42000): multiple DEFAULT shard defined**

<a id="8b2ee7050396cb5e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DEFAULT shard 를 여러 개 정의하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16384): multiple DEFAULT shard defined :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 6:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 하나의 DEFAULT shard 만 정의한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16385 (SQLSTATE: 42000): DEFAULT shard not defined**

<a id="b5bc7fd0d647fe57"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DFEAULT shard 를 정의하지 않았다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16385): DEFAULT shard not defined :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 DEFAULT shard 를 정의한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16386 (SQLSTATE: 42000): DEFAULT cannot be specified with other values**

<a id="0df18728135c142f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DEFAULT 는 다른 값과 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT, 200 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16386): DEFAULT cannot be specified with other values :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT, 200 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>DEFAULT 는 아래와 같이 단독으로 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100, 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16387 (SQLSTATE: 42000): list shard bound value must be one of: valid constant or NULL or DEFAULT**

<a id="3383241071288628"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>shard bound 값으로 유효하지 않은 함수를 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( SUM(200) ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16387): list shard bound value must be one of: valid constant or NULL or DEFAULT<br>ERR-42000(16158): group function is not allowed here :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( SUM(200) ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 유효한 상수, NULL, DEFAULT 등을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( NULL ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16388 (SQLSTATE: HYC00): does not support deferrable constraints in the cluster system**

<a id="cd48aa38b286b459"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>cluster system 에서 deferrable constraint 를 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DEFERRABLE,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY HASH( c1 );<br><br>ERR-HYC00(16388): does not support deferrable constraints in the cluster system :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DEFERRABLE,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 DEFERRABLE 옵션을 제거한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY HASH( c1 );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16389 (SQLSTATE: 42000): domain names of the datafile for renaming don't mismatch**

<a id="5b1ae0bd4d0ddbc2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>서로 다른 domain 이름을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS RENAME DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS_1.dbf' AT G2N2 TO 'TEST_TBS_111.dbf' AT G2N1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16389): domain names of the datafile for renaming don't mismatch</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 동일한 domain 이름을 사용하거나 제거한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS RENAME DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS_1.dbf' AT G2N2 TO 'TEST_TBS_111.dbf' AT G2N2;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS RENAME DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS_1.dbf' AT G2N2 TO 'TEST_TBS_111.dbf';<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16390 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid table for sharding strategy and placement specified**

<a id="66034a074a8955fe"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>함수의 인자로 사용하는 테이블이 sharded table 이 아니다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SHARD_ID( x$instance, 1 ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16390): invalid table for sharding strategy and placement specified :<br>SELECT SHARD_ID( x$instance, 1 ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 sharded table 을 인자로 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1);<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SHARD_ID( t1, 1 ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>SHARD_ID( T1, 1 )<br>-----------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16391 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the number of sharding key in function is mismatch**

<a id="4ccac2e8678ad53e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>shard key 의 개수와 인자의 개수가 다르다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE( sk )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g3<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SHARD_NAME( t1, 10, 20 ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(16391): the number of sharding key in function is mismatch :<br>SELECT SHARD_NAME( t1, 10, 20 ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 shard key 의 개수만큼 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SHARD_NAME( t1, 300 ) FROM dual;<br><br>SHARD_NAME( T1, 300 )<br>---------------------<br>S3<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16392 (SQLSTATE: HYC00): the number of sharding key in function is mismatch**

<a id="61b2df61f6f7acbb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16393 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: accessible member does not exist**

<a id="c49eaefb3d63959f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>View에 domain과 함께 IGNORE_INACTIVE_MEMBER 옵션을 사용하였으나 접근할 수 있는 cluster member 가 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM view1@G4N2[RANDOM_MEMBER, IGNORE_INACTIVE_MEMBER] ORDER BY 1;<br><br>ERR-01000(16393): Warning: accessible member does not exist<br>no rows selected.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>접근할 수 있는 member 를 포함한 domain 을 기술한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM view1@G4[RANDOM_MEMBER, IGNORE_INACTIVE_MEMBER] ORDER BY 1;<br><br>C1<br>----<br>G1N1<br>G1N2<br>G2N1<br>G2N2<br>G2N3<br>G3N1<br>G3N2<br>G4N1<br>G4N2<br><br>9 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16394 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: connection of member '%s' is broken**

<a id="58c505fdddb2c4fa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>질의 결과는 얻었으나 특정 cluster member 의 연결 오류가 감지되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;table_name,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;blocks<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM ALL_TABLES<br>&nbsp;WHERE table_schema = 'PUBLIC'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AND table_name IN ( 'TAB_CLONED' )<br>&nbsp;ORDER BY 1;<br><br>ERR-01000(16394): Warning: connection of member 'G4N2' is broken<br>TABLE_NAME BLOCKS<br>---------- ------<br>TAB_CLONED&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;448<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>해당 cluster member 를 cluster system 에 join 한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16395 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: must be accessible to at least one member of group '%s'**

<a id="92ff2128cb1030d5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>질의 결과는 얻었으나 특정 cluster group 의 data에 접근하지 못하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_range@GLOBAL[ IGNORE_INACTIVE_MEMBER ];<br><br>ERR-01000(16395): Warning: must be accessible to at least one member of group 'G1'<br>COUNT(*)<br>--------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>해당 cluster group 을 cluster system 에 join 한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16396 (SQLSTATE: 42000): exceeds the maximum number of nodes**

<a id="4d1ed96891dd11f0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>cluster system 에 추가할 수 있는 cluster member 의 최대 개수를 초과하였다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>MAX_NODE_COUNT 프로퍼티 값만큼 cluster member 를 추가할 수 있다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16397 (SQLSTATE: 42000): exceeds the maximum number of groups**

<a id="561f2fdfa82a4490"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>cluster system 에 추가할 수 있는 cluster group 의 최대 개수를 초과하였다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>MAX_GROUP_COUNT 프로퍼티 값만큼 cluster group 을 추가할 수 있다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16398 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the domain of property does not match with domain '%s'**

<a id="d202549c0a38eefa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>특정 domain 에서만 변경할 수 없는 property 이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SET NLS_DATE_FORMAT = 'YYYY-MM-DD' DEFERRED AT G1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16398): the domain of property does not match with domain 'G1' :<br>ALTER SYSTEM SET NLS_DATE_FORMAT = 'YYYY-MM-DD' DEFERRED AT G1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 AT 절을 사용하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SET NLS_DATE_FORMAT = 'YYYY-MM-DD' DEFERRED;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16399 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot insert or update a generated always identity column, value shall be a DEFAULT**

<a id="bfe9e535d623ab1e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY 로 생성한 컬럼은 값을 명시할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16399): cannot insert or update a generated always identity column, value shall be a DEFAULT :<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 DEFAULT 를 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16400 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN; invalid SCN format**

<a id="c6436fc63a2a1b28"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">특정 scn까지 복구를 수행하기 위한 scn_format이 유효하지 않다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN '10.*.*';<br>ERR-HY000(16400): cannot RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN; invalid SCN format<br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN '10.10';<br>ERR-HY000(16400): cannot RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN; invalid SCN format</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#233fbcf85decd22e">ALTER DATABASE RECOVER</a>&nbsp;구문에서 설명한 유효한 scn_format을 사용하여 불완전 복구를 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN '10.*';<br><br>Database altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN '10.10.*';<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16401 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid SAMPLE size specified**

<a id="f5c068013ff2cbf8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SAMPLE 의 크기가 유효하지 않다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 ESTIMATE STATISTICS SAMPLE 0 ROWS;<br><br>ERR-42000(16401): invalid SAMPLE size specified :<br>ANALYZE TABLE t1 ESTIMATE STATISTICS SAMPLE 0 ROWS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SAMPLE 의 크기는 양의 정수를 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 ESTIMATE STATISTICS SAMPLE 1000000 ROWS;<br><br>Table analyzed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16402 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate index name**

<a id="ef9b1cb3c56f5bbd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 index 를 나열하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR INDEXES idx1, idx1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16402): duplicate index name :<br>ANALYZE TABLE t1 COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR INDEXES idx1, idx1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>서로 다른 index 이름을 기술한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR INDEXES idx1, idx2;<br><br>Table analyzed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16403 (SQLSTATE: 42000): failed to join some of nodes to the global database**

<a id="ffe52b9522eed1dd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>GLOBAL OPEN 단계로 전환할 때, cluster 를 구성하는 모든 멤버가 참여하지 못한 경우 발생하는 경고 메시지이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN GLOBAL DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16403): of the total '6' nodes, '3' nodes failed to join the global database<br>ERR-HY000(56022): failed to connect to a host<br>ERR-HY000(11067): failed to connect to a host with a socket : poll() - port '21250' : stnConnect() returned errno(111)<br>System altered.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>참여하지 못한 노드는 필요한 조치를 수행한 후<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#d64c686b2011e181">ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE</a>&nbsp;구문을 사용하여 개별적으로 참여시킬 수 있다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16404 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute the statement with OS user permissions**

<a id="80d1a522374047ab"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>설치 계정이 아닌 계정으로 DA 모드에서 파일 수정이 필요한 DDL 을 수행할 경우에 발생한다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>파일 수정을 수반하는 DA 모드 DDL은 설치 계정에서만 수행한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16405 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables in the database, '%d' tables need to be rebalanced**

<a id="d3ec8546d4058ccd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>일부 테이블을 온라인 상태로 변경하지 못했다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16405): of the total '5' tables in the database, '2' tables need to be rebalanced :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;concurrent execution : 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;inactive member&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;replica usablility&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;offline tablespace&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;low table scn&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;others&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br><br>System altered.<br><br><ul><li>concurrent execution<br><ul><li>다른 세션과의 동시성 문제로 인해서 실패한 경우</li></ul></li><li>inactive member<br><ul><li>모든 active member의 replica 들이 offline 상태이고 inactive member 가 있는 경우</li></ul></li><li>replica usability<br><ul><li>Local replica 가 unusable 상태이거나</li><li>모든 active member 의 replica 들이 unusable 상태인 경우</li></ul></li><li>offline tablespace<br><ul><li>Local replica 가 오프라인 된 tablespace 에 만들어진 경우</li></ul></li><li>low table scn<br><ul><li>Local replica 가 최신이 아닌 경우</li></ul></li><li>others<br><ul><li>위에 기술된 원인을 제외한 나머지 경우</li></ul></li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td><ul><li>concurrent execution<br><ul><li>동시성 문제로 인해 다른 세션에서의 DDL 수행을 중지하고 다시 시도한다.</li></ul></li><li>inactive member<br><ul><li>inactive member 를 cluster 에 join 한 후 다시 시도한다.</li></ul></li><li>replica usability<br><ul><li>unusable 상태의 replica 를 제거한 후 다시 시도한다.</li><li>unusable replica 는<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#436fa49da2672327">ALTER TABLE name DROP UNUSABLE SEGMENTS</a>&nbsp;구문으로 제거할 수 있다.</li></ul></li><li>offline tablespace<br><ul><li>오프라인 된 tablespace 를 온라인으로 전환한 후 다시 시도한다.</li><li>온라인 전환은<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b9a7e09545483657">ALTER TABLESPACE name [ONLINE|OFFLINE]</a>&nbsp;구문을 사용한다.</li></ul></li><li>low table scn<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#4dcbc8cc43487ef2">ALTER TABLE name REBALANCE</a>또는<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#baf7d0e8598b3f6a">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a>&nbsp;구문으로 데이터를 동기화한다.</li></ul></li><li>others<br><ul><li>system.trc 에서 원인을 확인하고 조치를 취한 후 다시 시도한다.</li></ul></li></ul></td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16406 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid routine name**

<a id="0962fd3344e70d35"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16407 (SQLSTATE: 42000): procedure or function does not exist**

<a id="0759f80a4705f4ff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>유효하지 않은 procedure 이름을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PROCEDURE invalid COMPILE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16407): procedure or function does not exist :<br>ALTER PROCEDURE invalid COMPILE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>존재하는 procedure 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PROCEDURE proc1 COMPILE;<br><br>Procedure altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16408 (SQLSTATE: 42000): bind variables not allowed for procedures or functions**

<a id="571c2aaa428415cb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>procedure 생성 시 bind 변수를 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE PROCEDURE proc1( a1 INTEGER )<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x1 := :v1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-42000(16244): bind variables not allowed for data definition operations</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>procedure 생성 시 bind 변수를 사용하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE PROCEDURE proc1( a1 INTEGER )<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x1 := a1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Procedure created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16409 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: Routine definition has compilation errors**

<a id="67479bb6c524d159"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>routine(procedure/function) 은 생성되었으나 compile error 가 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE PROCEDURE proc1( a1 INTEGER )<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( a1 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(PROC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (4:4): ERR-42000(16053): not enough values<br>Procedure created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>compile error 를 확인하고 이를 수정한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1( a1 INTEGER, a2 INTEGER )<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( a1, a2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Procedure created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16410 (SQLSTATE: 42000): Startup driver node must have the latest data - a suitable startup driver node is '%s' member**

<a id="f6c4b265ba3d1c67"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16411 (SQLSTATE: 42000): maximum number of recursive SQL levels (%d) exceeded.**

<a id="06960192cf0aedba"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>최대 재귀호출 회수를 초과하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1( A1 INTEGER )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;IF( A1 &gt; 0 ) THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'A1 = ' || A1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROC1( A1 -1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;END IF;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CALL proc1(100);<br><br>A1 = 100<br>A1 = 99<br>A1 = 98<br>A1 = 97<br>...<br>... (중략)<br>...<br>A1 = 55<br>A1 = 54<br>A1 = 53<br><br>ERR-42000(16411): maximum number of recursive SQL levels (50) exceeded. : ERROR at PROCEDURE("PUT_LINE")<br><br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("PROC1")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>재귀호출 procedure 를 수정하거나 재귀호출 회수를 위반하지 않도록 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CALL proc1(5);<br><br>A1 = 5<br>A1 = 4<br>A1 = 3<br>A1 = 2<br>A1 = 1<br><br>Procedure Call complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16412 (SQLSTATE: 42R02): all of shards in a table must be online.**

<a id="9959b0a671c6e144"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DDL 대상 테이블에 offline 상태의 shard 가 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX tix3 ON t1( i3 );<br><br>ERR-42R02(16412): all of shards in a table 'T1' must be online. :<br>CREATE INDEX t1x3 ON t1( i3 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>테이블의 offline 상태를 확인하고 이를 조치한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT MEMBER_NAME, MEMBER_OFFLINE FROM USER_TAB_PLACE WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'T1' ORDER BY MEMBER_NAME;<br><br>ERR-01000(16394): Warning: connection of member 'G3N3' is broken<br>MEMBER_NAME MEMBER_OFFLINE<br>----------- --------------<br>G1N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G1N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G2N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G2N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G3N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE<br>G3N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE<br>G3N3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE<br><br>7 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16413 (SQLSTATE: 42000): LOCAL_OFFLINE domain must be specified to base table**

<a id="f9708d8910c923cf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>서버 내부에서 사용하는 에러 코드이다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16414 (SQLSTATE: 42000): domain option not allowed here**

<a id="e4d3342e05544a66"></a>
