> **16445 (SQLSTATE: 42000): REBALANCE EXCLUDE can be executed only on cluster wide sharded tables**

<a id="fc5f6ac38053f953"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>REBALANCE EXCLUDE 구문은 group-specific shard table 에 대해 수행할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP g2<br><br>ERR-42000(16445): REBALANCE EXCLUDE can be executed only on cluster wide sharded tables :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 REBALANCE EXCLUDE 구문은 cluster-wide shard table 에 대해 수행할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t2 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t2 REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16446 (SQLSTATE: 42000): REBALANCE EXCLUDE target group is empty**

<a id="adf0738b77d4c779"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>모든 cluster group 을 REBALANCE EXCLUDE 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t2 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t2 REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP g1, g2, g3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16446): REBALANCE EXCLUDE target group is empty :<br>ALTER TABLE t2 REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP g1, g2, g3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>일부 cluster group 만 REBALANCE EXCLUDE 할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t2 REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16447 (SQLSTATE: HY000): internal error ( %s, %d )**

<a id="e2307ab39b5de2c6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>서버 내부에서 사용하는 에러 코드이다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16448 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables, '%d' tables failed to move shard**

<a id="f770c6870b03a155"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#4752ea45b3668af4">ALTER DATABASE MOVE SHARD</a>&nbsp;구문을 수행할 때 일부 shard 이동에 실패했다.<br><br>다음은 7개 테이블 중에 1개 테이블에서 shard 이동이 실패한 예이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP g1 TO CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16448): of the total '7' tables, '1' tables failed to move shard<br>Database altered.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">System trace 로그를 확인하여 원인을 해결한 후 다시 수행한다.<br><br>다음은 이동 실패 시 system trace 로그에 기록되는 에러 메시지이다.<br><br>[2026-03-04 10:58:27.880218 INSTANCE(G1N1) THREAD(50590,140314313557824)] [WARNING]<br>[MOVE SHARD] failed to move shard table 'PUBLIC.T1 - global transaction id(0.124553461858)<br>(G1N1) ERR-HYT00(14026): resource busy or timeout expired</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16449 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster group does not have sharded data**

<a id="49c8f21031e33e15"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#4752ea45b3668af4">ALTER DATABASE MOVE SHARD</a>&nbsp;구문을 수행할 때 source 그룹에 이동할 shard 가 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP g1 TO CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16449): cluster group does not have sharded data :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP g1 TO CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">테이블의 shard 가 저장된 그룹을 확인하고 다시 수행한다.<br><br>다음은 테이블의 shard 저장 그룹을 확인하는 방법이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT group_name, member_name FROM user_tab_place WHERE table_name = 'T1';<br><br>GROUP_NAME MEMBER_NAME<br>---------- -----------<br>G2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G2N1<br>G2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G2N2<br>G3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G3N1<br>G3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G3N2<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16450 (SQLSTATE: 42000): exceeded global property lock timeout**

<a id="30c4e7dac68ee86c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>여러 세션에서 동시에 global 프로퍼티 값을 변경하려는 경우, 정해진 대기 시간을 초과하면 발생한다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td><a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#f73695ebaf90903a">GLOBAL_PROPERTY_LOCK_TIMEOUT</a>&nbsp;값을 늘려서 다시 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16451 (SQLSTATE: 42000): rownum not allowed here**

<a id="49dde291e09e08f4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ROWNUM 을 DEFAULT 값으로 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT ROWNUM );<br><br>ERR-42000(16451): rownum not allowed here :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT ROWNUM )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 상수를 DEFAULT 값으로 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT 0 );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16452 (SQLSTATE: 42000): rownum not allowed in sensitive cursor**

<a id="a9417231eb6b9d36"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>sensitive cursor 에서 ROWNUM 을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>DECLARE cur1 SENSITIVE SCROLL CURSOR<br>FOR SELECT ROWNUM<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE c1 &gt; 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR UPDATE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16452): rownum not allowed in sensitive cursor</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>sensitive cursor 사용 시 ROWNUM 을 SELECT target 으로 사용하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>DECLARE cur1 SENSITIVE SCROLL CURSOR<br>FOR SELECT c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE c1 &gt; 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR UPDATE;<br><br>Cursor declared.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16453 (SQLSTATE: 42000): rownum not allowed in positioned UPDATE**

<a id="f11b0254f49f4ae4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>UPDATE CURRENT OF cursor 구문에서 ROWNUM 을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>DECLARE cur1 CURSOR<br>FOR SELECT ROWNUM<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE ROWNUM &lt; 4<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR UPDATE;<br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t1 SET c1 = ROWNUM WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16453): rownum not allowed in positioned UPDATE</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>UPDATE CURRENT OF cursor 구문에서 ROWNUM 을 사용하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t1 SET c1 = c1 + 10 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16454 (SQLSTATE: 42000): function '%s' not allowed here**

<a id="873d5d167803aa6b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>INSERT RETURN 구문에서 해당 함수를 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT ) RETURN LAST_IDENTITY_VALUE() INTO :v1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16454): function 'LAST_IDENTITY_VALUE' not allowed here :<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT ) RETURN LAST_IDENTITY_VALUE() INTO :v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>INSERT RETURN 구문에서 해당 함수를 사용하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT ) RETURN c1 INTO :v1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>10<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16455 (SQLSTATE: 42000): routine "%s.%s" has errors**

<a id="e56449c414763a2f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16456 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the startup phase '%s' of cluster member '%s' is mismatch with the required startup phase '%s'**

<a id="5a71125fada602db"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>추가하려는 cluster member 의 startup phase 가 OPEN 상태가 아니다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER GROUP G4 CLUSTER MEMBER G4N1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 14150;<br><br>ERR-42000(16456): the startup phase 'LOCAL OPEN' of cluster member 'G4N1' is mismatch with the required startup phase 'OPEN'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>해당 cluster member 의 startup phase 를 OPEN 상태로 변경한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16457 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the connection map of cluster member '%s' is mismatch with local connection map**

<a id="ac83349c281c93d9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#d64c686b2011e181">ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE</a>&nbsp;수행 시 발생할 수 있는 에러로, local 노드의 connection map 이 remote 노드의 connection map 과 일치하지 않을 경우에 발생한다.<br>일반적으로는 발생하지 않지만, 구문 수행 중 remote 노드가 중지되는 경우에 발생할 수 있다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>중지된 remote 노드의 failover 가 완료된 후 다시 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16458 (SQLSTATE: 42000): reserved domain cannot be used with other domains**

<a id="f16d98c4b67f5f8d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16459 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute on hash sharded tables**

<a id="557cd4e5ad2dda6e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MERGE SHARDS 구문은 hash sharded table 에서는 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T1( I1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY HASH( I1 );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS S1, S2 INTO S1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16459): cannot execute on hash sharded tables :<br>ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS S1, S2 INTO S1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>MERGE SHARDS 구문은 range/ list sharded table 에서 사용할 수 있다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16460 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute on range sharded tables**

<a id="758e9319f8bc9bad"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16461 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid shard values**

<a id="5d28be20bcd6b8f1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>range sharded table 에 대해 SPLIT SHARD 시 IN shard value 를 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>ALTER TABLE t1 SPLIT SHARD s2 INTO<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( 50 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP G3<br>);<br><br>ERR-42000(16461): invalid shard values :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( 50 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP G3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 LESS THAN shard value 를 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SPLIT SHARD s2 INTO<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP G3<br>);<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16462 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot split shard - source shard cannot be empty**

<a id="9897209624328259"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SPLIT 을 할 경우 source shard 의 IN shard value 가 empty 상태가 된다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 1,2 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>ALTER TABLE t1 SPLIT SHARD s1 INTO<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD S1_1&nbsp;&nbsp;VALUES IN ( 1 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD S1_2&nbsp;&nbsp;VALUES IN ( 2 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>);<br><br>ERR-42000(16462): cannot split shard - source shard cannot be empty :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 SPLIT SHARD s1 INTO<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 source shard 의 IN shard value 가 존재할 수 있도록 SPLIT 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>ALTER TABLE t1 SPLIT SHARD s1 INTO<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD S1_2&nbsp;&nbsp;VALUES IN ( 2 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>);<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16463 (SQLSTATE: 42000): first CREATE CLUSTER GROUP must include only one cluster member**

<a id="2b68a0d6456c53fa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>cluster system 생성을 위한 최초 cluster group 생성 시에는 자기 자신의 cluster member 만 포함할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g1n1 HOST '192.168.0.101' PORT 11000,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g1n2 HOST '192.168.0.102' PORT 12000;<br><br>ERR-42000(16463): first CREATE CLUSTER GROUP must include only one cluster member</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 최초 cluster group 생성 시에는 자기 자신의 cluster member 만 포함한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g1n1 HOST '192.168.0.101' PORT 11000;<br><br>Cluster Group created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16464 (SQLSTATE: HY000): unsupported feature with temporary table**

<a id="d9001d764e881b8c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>global temporary table 에는 사용할 수 없는 기능이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 PCTFREE 100;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16464): unsupported feature with temporary table :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 PCTFREE 100<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>global temporary table 에 대해 storage option 을 사용할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16465 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop local cluster group**

<a id="941e166b1eae147f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>현재 접속한 cluster group 을 DROP 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP CLUSTER GROUP g1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16465): cannot drop local cluster group :<br>DROP CLUSTER GROUP g1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>현재 접속한 cluster group 을 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_group_name() FROM dual;<br><br>LOCAL_GROUP_NAME()<br>------------------<br>G1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16466 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute with SERIALIZABLE**

<a id="cdebc28b03222276"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE 모드에서는 REBALANCE 를 실행할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET SESSION CHARACTERISTICS AS TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;<br><br>Session set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 REBALANCE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16466): cannot execute with SERIALIZABLE</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>ISOLATION LEVEL 을 READ COMMITTED 로 변경하고 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET SESSION CHARACTERISTICS AS TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;<br><br>Session set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 REBALANCE;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16467 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table '%s' is READ ONLY**

<a id="0cf63287a75a84a2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>READ ONLY table 에 대해 DML을 수행할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 READ ONLY;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16467): table 'T1' is READ ONLY :<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>READ WRITE 로 변경하고 DML 을 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 READ WRITE;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16468 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot create TEMPORARY object in a NON-TEMPORARY tablespace '%s'**

<a id="05bcfdb35140b659"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>global temporary table 은 data tablespace 에 생성할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16468): cannot create TEMPORARY object in a NON-TEMPORARY tablespace 'MEM_DATA_TBS' :<br>CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>global temporary table 은 temporary tablespace 에 생성해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE mem_temp_tbs;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16469 (SQLSTATE: 0A000): cannot execute on global connection**

<a id="3da4a7dcc7573b92"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Global connection 환경에서는 global temporary table 을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>ERR-0A000(16469): cannot execute on global connection</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Global connection의<a href="../part-05-developer-manual/33-database-connection.md#71cda5def23903b0">제약 사항</a>을 참조한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16470 (SQLSTATE: 42000): datafile size specified is smaller than minimum required '%ld'**

<a id="d1708304b3e327b1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Tablespace 의 datafile 크기가 범위를 벗어났다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SIZE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXTSIZE 1048576;<br><br>ERR-RD000(16080): file size is out of range( 4194304 to 32212254720 ) :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SIZE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Tablespace 의 datafile 크기는 4M ~ 32G 여야 한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16471 (SQLSTATE: 42000): audit policy '%s' does not exists**

<a id="3d6bfab77e8118b1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>해당 audit policy 가 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY invalid;<br><br>ERR-42000(16471): audit policy 'INVALID' does not exists :<br>AUDIT POLICY invalid<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 audit policy 가 존재하는지 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT policy_name FROM audit_policies;<br><br>POLICY_NAME<br>-----------<br>P1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16472 (SQLSTATE: 42000): audit policy cannot be dropped as it is currently enabled**

<a id="c54295ee03776c3f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>현재 활성화되어 있는 audit policy 를 DROP 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1;<br><br>Audit succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP AUDIT POLICY p1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16472): audit policy cannot be dropped as it is currently enabled :<br>DROP AUDIT POLICY p1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 비활성화 한 후 DROP 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; NOAUDIT POLICY p1;<br><br>Noaudit succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP AUDIT POLICY p1;<br><br>Audit Policy dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16473 (SQLSTATE: 42000): audit policy '%s' already exists**

<a id="4aa99a3e60ca57e8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>audit policy 객체가 이미 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE AUDIT POLICY p1 ACTIONS CREATE TABLE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16473): audit policy 'P1' already exists :<br>CREATE AUDIT POLICY p1 ACTIONS CREATE TABLE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 audit policy 객체가 존재하는지 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT policy_name FROM audit_policies;<br><br>POLICY_NAME<br>-----------<br>P1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16474 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not auditable option**

<a id="0f5727bf2b894ce1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>권한 감사에 사용할 수 없는 privilege 이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE AUDIT POLICY p1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PRIVILEGES CREATE SESSION<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16474): not auditable option :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PRIVILEGES CREATE SESSION<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 PRIVILEGES audit option 은 database privilege 만 가능하다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE AUDIT POLICY p1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PRIVILEGES SELECT ANY TABLE<br>;<br><br>Audit Policy created.<br><br>audit 가능한 database privilege 는 아래와 같이 조회한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT privilege_name FROM v$auditable_db_privileges;<br><br>PRIVILEGE_NAME<br>-----------------<br>ADMINISTRATION<br>ALTER DATABASE<br>...<br>...<br>...<br>EXECUTE ANY LIBRARY<br><br>55 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16475 (SQLSTATE: 42000): audit policy already applied with the BY clause**

<a id="65aef96e92e87d95"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>이미 BY user 로 audit policy 가 활성화되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1 BY u1;<br><br>Audit succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1 EXCEPT u1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16475): audit policy already applied with the BY clause</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 BY user 로 audit policy 를 비활성화 한 후 EXCEPT user 로 활성화한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; NOAUDIT POLICY p1 BY u1;<br><br>Noaudit succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1 EXCEPT u1;<br><br>Audit succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16476 (SQLSTATE: 42000): audit policy already applied with the EXCEPT clause**

<a id="e5706fcc93a97021"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>audit policy 가 EXCEPT user 로 이미 활성화되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1 EXCEPT u1;<br><br>Audit succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1 BY u1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16476): audit policy already applied with the EXCEPT clause</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>audit policy 를 BY/EXCEPT 옵션 없이 비활성화 한 후 BY user 로 활성화한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; NOAUDIT POLICY p1;<br><br>Noaudit succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1 BY u1;<br><br>Audit succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16477 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not auditable object**

<a id="6ccd729d4b94b258"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>감사 가능한 object 가 아니다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE AUDIT POLICY p1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ACTIONS ALL ON X$SESSION<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16477): not auditable object :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ACTIONS ALL ON X$SESSION<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>사용자가 생성한 table 에 대해서만 audit 이 가능하다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE AUDIT POLICY p1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ACTIONS ALL ON t1<br>;<br><br>Audit Policy created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16478 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace '%s' is not temporary tablespace or data tablespace**

<a id="7cd67cb7272332e5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>지정한 tablespace 가 INDEX TABLESPACE 로 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 INDEX TABLESPACE mem_undo_tbs;<br><br>ERR-42000(16478): tablespace 'MEM_UNDO_TBS' is not temporary tablespace or data tablespace :<br>ALTER USER u1 INDEX TABLESPACE mem_undo_tbs<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>temporary tablespace 나 data tablespace 를 INDEX TABLESPACE 로 지정한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 INDEX TABLESPACE mem_temp_tbs;<br><br>User altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16479 (SQLSTATE: 42000): failed to update system version - %s**

<a id="b6b81146711e4fac"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>여러 개의 세션에서 동시에 system version 을 갱신할 때 정해진 대기 시간을 초과하면 발생한다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>System version 은 global connection을 사용하는 클라이언트에게 cluster 의 topology 변경 사항을 알리기 위해 증가된다.<br>Global connection 을 사용하는 경우,<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#e7de24004dd647b5">ALTER SYSTEM RECONNECT GLOBAL CONNECTION</a>&nbsp;구문을 사용하여 system version 을 수동으로 증가시킬 수 있다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16480 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot set irrecoverable on the local cluster member**

<a id="2553f657281645c5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#2751a9e856140404">ALTER SYSTEM IRRECOVERABLE CLUSTER MEMBER</a>&nbsp;구문을 수행할 때 지정된 member 이름이 local member 이름과 동일하다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_name() FROM dual;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_NAME()<br>-------------------<br>G1N1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM IRRECOVERABLE CLUSTER MEMBER g1n1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16480): cannot set irrecoverable on the local cluster member :<br>ALTER SYSTEM IRRECOVERABLE CLUSTER MEMBER g1n1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">지정할 member 이름을 확인한 후 다시 수행한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16481 (SQLSTATE: 42000): global tempoary table segment no longer exists**

<a id="8659c9e06b98b424"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16482 (SQLSTATE: 42R02): database is not accessible; '%s' has detached from the cluster**

<a id="779b559f4d66837f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>현재 접속한 member(G3N3) 가 cluster system 에서 떨어져 있는 상태이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42R02(16482): database is not accessible; 'G3N3' has detached from the cluster<br>ERR-42R01(16357): must be accessible to at least one member of group 'G1'</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 cluster member(G3N3) 를 cluster system 에 join 한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16483 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' sequences, '%d' sequences failed to synchronize**

<a id="52107dba9500dde1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>노드를 추가하거나 참여시키는 과정에서 발생할 수 있으며, sequence 동기화 대상 객체들 중에 실패한 개수를 표시한다.<br>실패한 원인은 대부분 lock 으로 인한 동시성 문제이다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>모든 sequence 가 성공적으로 동기화될 때까지<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#1620340d3358eb5b">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE SEQUENCE</a>&nbsp;구문을 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16484 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' identity columns, '%d' identity columns failed to synchronize**

<a id="d90aa101a83e9f0f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>노드를 추가하거나 참여시키는 과정에서 발생할 수 있으며, identity column 동기화 대상들 중에 실패한 개수를 표시한다.<br>실패한 원인은 대부분 lock 으로 인한 동시성 문제이다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>모든 identity column이 성공적으로 동기화될 때까지<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#1620340d3358eb5b">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE SEQUENCE</a>&nbsp;구문을 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16485 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table '%s' does not have an identity column**

<a id="3cea84526fd92528"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>해당 table 은 identity column 을 가지고 있지 않다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t2 SYNCHRONIZE IDENTITY COLUMN;<br><br>ERR-42000(16485): table '%s' does not have an identity column :<br>ALTER TABLE t2 SYNCHRONIZE IDENTITY COLUMN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 identity column 을 가지는 테이블을 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT table_name, column_name FROM user_tab_identity_cols;<br><br>TABLE_NAME COLUMN_NAME<br>---------- -----------<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE IDENTITY COLUMN;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16486 (SQLSTATE: RD000): maximum file size is out of range( %ld to %ld )**

<a id="92db119bcf2b4e67"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>최대 file 크기를 초과하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE DISK TABLESPACE DISK_TBS DATAFILE 'DISK_TBS.dbf' SIZE 10M AUTOEXTEND ON MAXSIZE 31G;<br><br>ERR-RD000(16486): maximum file size is out of range( 4194304 to 32212254720 ) :<br>CREATE DISK TABLESPACE DISK_TBS DATAFILE 'DISK_TBS.dbf' SIZE 10M AUTOEXTEND ON MAXSIZE 31G<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>file 크기는 다음과 같은 범위 ( 4M ~ 30G ) 에서 지정 가능하다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16487 (SQLSTATE: 42000): only range sharded table is allowed**

<a id="1aa061fc45618e2f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MERGE SHARDS start_shard_name TO end_shard_name 구문은 list sharded table 에서 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST(sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 101, 201 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( 102, 202 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( 103, 203 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s4 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1 TO s2 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16487): only range sharded table is allowed :<br>ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1 TO s2 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>MERGE SHARDS start_shard_name TO end_shard_name 구문은 range sharded table 에서 사용 가능하다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE(sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( 300 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s4 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1 TO s2 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16488 (SQLSTATE: 42000): shards being merged are not adjacent**

<a id="5d4483d6b6719563"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>인접하지 않은 shard 들을 merge 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE(sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( 300 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s4 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s3 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16488): shards being merged are not adjacent :<br>ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s3 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 인접한 shard 들을 merge 해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2, s3 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16489 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster group name must be specified**

<a id="9227ad3576b706bf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>cluster group 이름을 명시하지 않았다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE(sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( 300 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s4 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2 INTO s5;<br><br>ERR-42000(16489): cluster group name must be specified :<br>ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2 INTO s5<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 cluster group 이름을 명시한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16490 (SQLSTATE: 42000): mismatch the group name of the source shard '%s'**

<a id="f8ce04e55f2f161e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 shard 가 source shard 와 destine shard 에서 사용될 때 해당 shard 의 cluster group 이름이 다르게 기술되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE(sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( 300 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s4 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2 INTO s2 AT CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16490): mismatch the group name of the source shard 'S2' :<br>ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2 INTO s2 AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>동일한 shard 가 source shard 와 destine shard 에서 사용될 때 해당 shard 의 cluster group 이름을 기술해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2 INTO s2 AT CLUSTER GROUP g1;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16491 (SQLSTATE: 42000): exceed the maximum number of shards (%d)**

<a id="8b4f2c8cbfe704d1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>최대 shard 개수를 초과하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0001 VALUES LESS THAN (10001),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0002 VALUES LESS THAN (10002),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0003 VALUES LESS THAN (10003),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0004 VALUES LESS THAN (10004),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;...<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;...<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;...<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0510 VALUES LESS THAN (10510),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0511 VALUES LESS THAN (10511),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0512 VALUES LESS THAN (10512),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0513 VALUES LESS THAN (MAXVALUE)<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16491): exceed the maximum number of shards (512) :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0513 VALUES LESS THAN (MAXVALUE)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 520:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>정의할 수 있는 최대 shard 개수는 512 개이다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16492 (SQLSTATE: 42000): can not perform DDL/DML over objects in Recycle Bin**

<a id="e155e3b7bede9023"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>gSQL&gt; create table t1 ( c1 integer ) ;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; drop table t1;<br><br>Table dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; select OBJECT_NAME, ORIGINAL_NAME from dba_recyclebin;<br><br>OBJECT_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORIGINAL_NAME<br>------------------------------------ -------------<br>BIN$A202F0C6E59611EE8E17DF67981EB0BF T1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; drop table BIN$A202F0C6E59611EE8E17DF67981EB0BF;<br><br>ERR-42000(16492): can not perform DDL/DML over objects in Recycle Bin :<br>drop table BIN$A202F0C6E59611EE8E17DF67981EB0BF<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>휴지통에 저장된 OBJECT는 DDL/DML을 수행할 수 없다. FLASHBACK TABLE 구문을 사용하여 복구한 후에 DDL/DML을 수행할 수 있다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16493 (SQLSTATE: 42000): object not in Recycle Bin**

<a id="b8dd31b72a2a2106"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>gSQL&gt; select OBJECT_NAME, ORIGINAL_NAME from dba_recyclebin;<br><br>OBJECT_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORIGINAL_NAME<br>------------------------------------ -------------<br>BIN$A202F0C6E59611EE8E17DF67981EB0BF T1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; purge table t2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16493): object not in Recycle Bin :<br>purge table t2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; flashback table t2 to before drop;<br><br>ERR-42000(16493): object not in Recycle Bin :<br>flashback table t2 to before drop<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>휴지통에 저장된 OBJECT를 삭제하거나 복구할 때에는 올바른 OBJECT NAME을 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; purge table t1;<br><br>Table purged.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16494 (SQLSTATE: 42000): original name is used by an existing object**

<a id="ee23209cd47d1102"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>gSQL&gt; select OBJECT_NAME, ORIGINAL_NAME from dba_recyclebin;<br><br>OBJECT_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORIGINAL_NAME<br>------------------------------------ -------------<br>BIN$9D8ADDDAE59911EE8E17DF67981EB0BF T1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; create table t1 ( c1 integer ) ;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; flashback table t1 to before drop;<br><br>ERR-42000(16494): original name is used by an existing object :<br>flashback table t1 to before drop<br>*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>휴지통에 저장된 OBJECT을 복구할 때 동일한 이름의 OBJECT가 존재하는 경우 발생하는 에러이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; flashback table t1 to before drop rename to t2;<br><br>Flashback complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16495 (SQLSTATE: HY000): package or package body does not exist**

<a id="649af956a3a12937"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>해당 package 가 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP PACKAGE invalid;<br><br>ERR-42000(16495): package or package body does not exist :<br>DROP PACKAGE invalid<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 존재하는 package 를 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT object_name FROM user_objects WHERE object_type = 'PACKAGE';<br><br>OBJECT_NAME<br>-----------<br>PKG1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16496 (SQLSTATE: 42000): built-in package '%s' is not modifiable**

<a id="f455def68d59a4b6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16497 (SQLSTATE: 42000): lacks privilege (EXECUTE ON PACKAGE "%s"."%s")**

<a id="5995b9f9136b96a2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>사용자에게 EXECUTE ON PACKAGE 권한이 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT pkg1.func1(100) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(16497): lacks privilege (EXECUTE ON PACKAGE "PUBLIC"."PKG1") :<br>SELECT pkg1.func1(100) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT current_user FROM dual;<br><br>CURRENT_USER<br>------------<br>U1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Package 소유자가 해당 사용자에게 권한을 부여해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT EXECUTE ON PACKAGE "PUBLIC"."PKG1" TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT current_user FROM dual;<br><br>CURRENT_USER<br>------------<br>U1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT pkg1.func1(100) FROM dual;<br><br>PKG1.FUNC1(100)<br>---------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;100<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16498 (SQLSTATE: 42000): Only Btree indexes can be rebuilt**

<a id="baeca2636c60e757"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Global temporary index에 INDEX REBUILD 구문을 사용할 때 발생하는 에러이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX t1_idx ON t1 ( c1 );<br><br>Index created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX t1_idx REBUILD;<br><br>ERR-42000(16498): Only Btree indexes can be rebuilt :<br>ALTER INDEX t1_idx REBUILD<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Global temporary index 는 REBUILD 구문을 지원하지 않는다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16499 (SQLSTATE: 42000): operation is not allowed on immutable table '%s'**

<a id="e735cea7ab8025fe"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Immutable table 에 대해 해당 구문을 수행할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE IMMUTABLE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16499): operation is not allowed on immutable table 'T1' :<br>DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Immutable table 은 INSERT 만 가능한 테이블이다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16500 (SQLSTATE: 0A000): cannot execute on global session**

<a id="9dfb0fbc033278d2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Global session 환경의 client 에서 DDL 을 수행할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-0A000(16500): cannot execute on global session</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Global connection, global session 에서의<a href="../part-05-developer-manual/33-database-connection.md#71cda5def23903b0">제약 사항</a>을 확인한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16501 (SQLSTATE: 42000): size of log file is larger than maximum size of log file(%ld bytes).**

<a id="c63988da12d76aa7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#975c069a4f386a7c">ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE GROUP</a>&nbsp;구문을 수행할 때 지정한 SIZE 절 값이 1 Terabyte 를 초과하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE GROUP 4 ( 'redo_4_0.log' ) SIZE 2T REUSE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16501): size of log file is larger than maximum size of log file(1099511627776 bytes).</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">SIZE 절을 1 Terabyte 보다 작게 설정한 후에 다시 수행한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16502 (SQLSTATE: 42000): recursive WITH clause must reference itself directly in one of the UNION ALL branches**

<a id="995958aaf699ea84"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>recursive WITH 절 기술 방식이 잘못되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 ( w_emp, w_mgr ) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.w_emp<br>)<br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16502): recursive WITH clause must reference itself directly in one of the UNION ALL branches :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 UNION ALL 로 기술한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; WITH w1 ( w_emp, w_mgr ) AS<br><br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.w_emp<br>)<br><br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>W_EMP W_MGR<br>----- -----<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br>park&nbsp;&nbsp;kim<br>choi&nbsp;&nbsp;kim<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;park<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16505 (SQLSTATE: 42000): recursive WITH clause must have column alias list**

<a id="ed29aa9e18e1454b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>recursive WITH 절에는 column alias 를 기술해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>)<br><br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br>ERR-42000(16505): recursive WITH clause must have column alias list :<br>WITH w1 AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 query name (w1) 에 column alias 를 기술한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1(emp, mgr) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>)<br><br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR<br>---- ----<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br>park kim<br>choi kim<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16506 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unsupported join in recursive WITH query**

<a id="86dde5e837c1441c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>recursive WITH 절의 recursive query part 에 LEFT OUTER JOIN 을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1(emp, mgr) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;w1 ON t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>)<br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16506): unsupported join in recursive WITH query :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;w1 ON t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 9:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>recursive WITH 절의 recursive query part 는 INNER JOIN 을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1(emp, mgr) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>)<br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR<br>---- ----<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br>park kim<br>choi kim<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16511 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cycle detected while executing recursive WITH query**

<a id="0568ccc20aab5b96"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>recursive WITH 절 실행 과정에서 cycle 이 발견되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; WITH w1(emp, mgr) AS<br><br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>)<br><br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16511): cycle detected while executing recursive WITH query</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 CYCLE 절을 이용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; WITH w1(emp, mgr) AS<br><br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>) CYCLE emp, mgr SET w_cycle TO 'T' DEFAULT 'F'<br><br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR&nbsp;&nbsp;W_CYCLE<br>---- ---- -------<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null F<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;tom&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park F<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park F<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;tom&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;tom&nbsp;&nbsp;T<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;T<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br><br>12 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16512 (SQLSTATE: 42000): CONNECT BY clause required in this query block**

<a id="b5c4bdf70fda8a98"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>LEVEL 은 CONNECT BY 절과 함께 사용하는 hierarchy function 이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT emp, mgr, LEVEL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16512): CONNECT BY clause required in this query block :<br>SELECT emp, mgr, LEVEL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SELECT emp, mgr, LEVEL<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;START WITH emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;CONNECT BY mgr = PRIOR emp<br>;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR&nbsp;&nbsp;LEVEL<br>---- ---- -----<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16513 (SQLSTATE: 42000): hierarchy function not allowed here**

<a id="19f107abff027967"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>hierarchy function 은 PRIOR 와 함께 SELECT target 에 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT emp, mgr, PRIOR SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH( emp, '/' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;START WITH emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;CONNECT BY mgr = PRIOR emp<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16513): hierarchy function not allowed here :<br>SELECT emp, mgr, PRIOR SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH( emp, '/' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 PRIOR 를 제거한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT emp, mgr, SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH( emp, '/' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;START WITH emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;CONNECT BY mgr = PRIOR emp<br>;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR&nbsp;&nbsp;SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH( EMP, '/' )<br>---- ---- -------------------------------<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null /kim<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;/kim/choi<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;/kim/park<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park /kim/park/tom<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16514 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cycle detected while executing CONNECT BY Clause**

<a id="d79d701ef908f609"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>CONNECT BY 실행 중 cycle 이 감지되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;START WITH emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;CONNECT BY mgr = PRIOR emp<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16511): cycle detected while executing recursive WITH query</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 NOCYCLE 옵션을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT emp, mgr<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;START WITH emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;CONNECT BY NOCYCLE mgr = PRIOR emp<br>;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR<br>---- ----<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br>choi kim<br>park kim<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>NOCYCLE 옵션이 누락되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT emp, mgr, CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;START WITH emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;CONNECT BY mgr = PRIOR emp<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16517): NOCYCLE keyword is required with CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE :<br>SELECT emp, mgr, CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>hierarchy function CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE 은 NOCYCLE 옵션과 함께 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT emp, mgr, CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;START WITH emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;CONNECT BY NOCYCLE mgr = PRIOR emp<br>;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR&nbsp;&nbsp;CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE<br>---- ---- ------------------<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16518 (SQLSTATE: 42000): LOCAL_OFFLINE domain expected**

<a id="b726e497e238c521"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>현재 접속한 local data 가 offline 상태이므로 LOCAL_OFFLINE 옵션으로 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1@local;<br><br>ERR-42000(16518): LOCAL_OFFLINE domain expected :<br>SELECT * FROM t1@local<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 현재 접속한 local data 가 offline 상태임을 확인할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_name() FROM dual;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_NAME()<br>-------------------<br>G2N2<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT table_name, member_name, member_offline FROM user_tab_place WHERE table_name = 'T1';<br><br>TABLE_NAME MEMBER_NAME MEMBER_OFFLINE<br>---------- ----------- --------------<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G1N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G1N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G2N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G2N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G3N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G3N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br><br>6 rows selected.<br><br>table(t1) 을 REBALANCE 하거나 아래와 같이 LOCAL_OFFLINE domain 으로 조회할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1@local_offline;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16519 (SQLSTATE: 42000): global secondary index expected in cluster DML**

<a id="0e2944245d29f3cb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>non-deterministic DML 을 수행하기 위해서는 global secondary index 가 필요하다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( id INTEGER ) SHARDING BY(id) WITHOUT GLOBAL SECONDARY INDEX;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM t1 LIMIT 3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16519): global secondary index expected in cluster DML</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 global secondary index 를 추가한 후 실행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD GLOBAL SECONDARY INDEX;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM t1 LIMIT 3;<br><br>no rows deleted.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>hash bucket count 값을 잘못 설정하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET HINT_ERROR = ON;<br><br>Session altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \explain plan<br><br>SELECT /*+ USE_HASH(t2, 0) */<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;t1.id, t1.name<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, t2<br>&nbsp;WHERE t1.id = t2.id;<br><br>ERR-42000(16521): invalid hash bucket count (must between 1 and 9223372036854775807) :<br>SELECT /*+ USE_HASH(t2, 0) */<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 유효한 범위의 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \explain plan<br><br>SELECT /*+ USE_HASH(t2, 1024) */<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;t1.id, t1.name<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, t2<br>&nbsp;WHERE t1.id = t2.id;<br><br>ID NAME<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1 kim<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>&gt;&gt;&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;start print plan<br><br>... 중략 ...<br><br>&lt;&lt;&lt;&nbsp;&nbsp;end print plan</td></tr></tbody></table>

9<br>&nbsp;ORDER BY member_position<br>;<br><br>MEMBER_NAME MEMBER_POSITION<br>----------- ---------------<br>G1N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>G1N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>G2N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>G2N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br>G3N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4<br>G3N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5<br>null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6<br>G4N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;7<br>null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;8<br><br>9 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>ALTER CLUSTER GROUP g4 ADD<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 14150 POSITION 6;<br><br>Cluster Group altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16524 (SQLSTATE: 42000): package specification '%s' does not exist. package body requires its package specification**

<a id="8af8df193ddd194e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>package specification 이 유효하지 않아 package body 를 compile 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE PACKAGE pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t1.c1%TYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION f1 RETURN INTEGER;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE PACKAGE BODY pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION f1 RETURN INTEGER<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN v1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE t1;<br><br>Table dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PACKAGE pkg1 COMPILE BODY;<br><br>ERR-2F000(17102): PACKAGE(PKG1) Body has compilation errors :<br>(1) : ERR-42000(16524): Cannot compile package body of 'PUBLIC.PKG1' without its specification<br>Package altered.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>package specification 오류 원인을 수정한 후 package body 를 compile 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PACKAGE pkg1 COMPILE BODY;<br><br>Package altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16526 (SQLSTATE: 42000): only recursive WITH element can have recursive search clause**

> **16527 (SQLSTATE: 42000): only recursive WITH element can have recursive cycle clause**

<a id="091d5a2eb3e61c8e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>CYCLE 절을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 ( emp, mgr ) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>) CYCLE emp SET w_cycle TO 1 DEFAULT 0<br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16527): only recursive WITH element can have recursive cycle clause :<br>) CYCLE emp SET w_cycle TO 1 DEFAULT 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 6:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>CYCLE 절은 recursive WITH 절에만 사용할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 ( emp, mgr ) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>) CYCLE emp SET w_cycle TO 1 DEFAULT 0<br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR&nbsp;&nbsp;W_CYCLE<br>---- ---- -------<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null 0<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park 0<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>
