<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>WITH 절을 여러 번 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 AS ( SELECT emp, mgr FROM t1 )<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;WITH w2 AS ( SELECT emp, mgr FROM w1 WHERE emp = 'park' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT * FROM w2<br>);<br><br>ERR-42000(16540): multiple WITH clauses not allowed :<br>WITH w1 AS ( SELECT emp, mgr FROM t1 )<br>*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 하나의 WITH 절에 순서대로 query name 을 나열한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 AS ( SELECT emp, mgr FROM t1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, w2 AS ( SELECT emp, mgr FROM w1 WHERE emp = 'park' )<br>SELECT * FROM w2;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR<br>---- ---<br>park kim<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16541 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot affect row a second time**

<a id="6280d80d6f72524b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>upsert 시 하나의 row 가 두 번 UPDATE 된다.<br><br>DROP TABLE t1;<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE );<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br>COMMIT;<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 ), ( 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET c1 = c1 + 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16541): cannot affect row a second time</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 하나의 row 가 두 번 영향을 받지 않도록 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET c1 = c1 + 1;<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET c1 = c1 + 1;<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16542 (SQLSTATE: 42000): upsert not allowed for the row that caused more than one unique constraint violation**

<a id="aae6b6bed6126793"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>둘 이상의 unique violation 을 유발하는 upsert 는 허용하지 않는다.<br><br>DROP TABLE t1;<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE , c2 INTEGER UNIQUE );<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 2, 2 );<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 3, 3 );<br>COMMIT;<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br><br>3 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 2 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET c1 = c1 + 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16542): upsert not allowed for the row that caused more than one unique constraint violation</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>둘 이상의 unique violation 을 유발하지 않도록 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 3, 4 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET c1 = c1 + 1;<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br><br>3 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16543 (SQLSTATE: 42000): upsert is not allowed for the table with a deferrable constraint (%s.%s)**

<a id="c98a4e1e43cac219"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>제약 조건이 DEFERRED 로 설정된 상태에서는 upsert 구문을 수행할 수 없다.<br><br>DROP TABLE t1;<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, cnt INTEGER );<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br>COMMIT;<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINTS ALL DEFERRED;<br><br>Constraints set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET cnt = cnt + 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16543): upsert is not allowed for the table with a deferrable constraint (PUBLIC.T1_PRIMARY_KEY)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>제약 조건을 IMMEDIATE 로 변경한 후 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE;<br><br>Constraints set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET cnt = cnt + 1;<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16544 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: Package '%s.%s' has compilation errors**

<a id="cf1fed5bd95041c3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16545 (SQLSTATE: 42R02): cloned table "%s"."%s" must have at least one online usable replica**

<a id="3d61f6a1fa40a080"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">CLONED 타입의 테이블에서 발생하는 오류로서, 모든 replica 들이 OFFLINE 상태이고 inactive 멤버가 존재할 때 다음 구문을 수행하면 발생한다.<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8ce707cabe9dc37a">ALTER DATABASE DROP INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#122c923f4ef34146">ALTER TABLE name DROP OFFLINE SEGMENTS</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#baf7d0e8598b3f6a">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a></li></ul><br>다음은 2x2 cluster 에서 모든 replica 가 OFFLINE 상태이고 inactive 멤버가 존재하는 경우의 예이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT map.group_id, map.member_id, map.is_offline<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM table_member_map@local map,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;definition_schema.tables@local tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE map.table_id = tbl.table_id AND tbl.table_name = 'T1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORDER BY 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6 ;<br><br>GROUP_ID MEMBER_ID IS_OFFLINE<br>-------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 TRUE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 TRUE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 TRUE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 TRUE<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT member_id, STATUS FROM v$cluster_member@local;<br><br>MEMBER_ID STATUS<br>--------- --------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 INACTIVE<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>ERR-42R02(16545): cloned table "PUBLIC"."T1" must have at least one online usable replica</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE 구문을 수행할 때 에러가 발생하는 이유는 inactive member 가 존재하기 때문이다. 모든 inactive member 들을 cluster 에 참여시킨 후에 다시 시도한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_id() FROM dual;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_ID()<br>-----------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT member_id, STATUS FROM v$cluster_member@local;<br><br>MEMBER_ID STATUS<br>--------- ------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 ACTIVE<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16546 (SQLSTATE: 42R02): sharded table "%s"."%s" must have at least one online usable replica of group '%s'**

<a id="99b8901342323f0e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">SHARDED 타입의 테이블에서 발생하는 오류로서, 특정 그룹의 모든 replica 들이 OFFLINE 상태이고 그룹 내에 inactive 멤버가 존재할 때 다음 구문을 수행하면 발생한다.<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8ce707cabe9dc37a">ALTER DATABASE DROP INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#122c923f4ef34146">ALTER TABLE name DROP OFFLINE SEGMENTS</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#baf7d0e8598b3f6a">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a></li></ul><br>다음은 2x2 cluster 에서 g2 의 모든 replica 들이 OFFLINE 상태이고 inactive 멤버가 존재하는 경우의 예이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT map.group_id, map.member_id, map.is_offline<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM table_member_map@local map,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;definition_schema.tables@local tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE map.table_id = tbl.table_id AND tbl.table_name = 'T1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORDER BY 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6 ;<br><br>GROUP_ID MEMBER_ID IS_OFFLINE<br>-------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 FALSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 FALSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 TRUE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 TRUE<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT group_id, member_id, STATUS FROM v$cluster_member@local;<br><br>MEMBER_ID STATUS<br>--------- --------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 INACTIVE<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>ERR-42R02(16546): sharded table "PUBLIC"."T1" must have at least one online usable replica of group 'G2'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">모든 inactive member 들을 cluster 에 참여시킨 후에 다시 시도한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_id() FROM dual;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_ID()<br>-----------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT member_id, STATUS FROM v$cluster_member@local;<br><br>MEMBER_ID STATUS<br>--------- ------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 ACTIVE<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16547 (SQLSTATE: 01000): of the total '%d' tables in the database, '%d' tables have offline replica**

<a id="6f215dbb4a79914f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#cbf215370461aa13">ALTER SYSTEM {MOUNT | OPEN} DATABASE</a>&nbsp;구문은 모든 멤버를 cluster 에 참여시킨 후 OFFLINE 상태의 replica 들을 ONLINE 상태로 변경하려고 시도한다.<br>이 때 ONLINE 상태로 변경할 수 없는 테이블이 있을 경우 발생하는 경고 메시지이다.<br>ONLINE 전환 실패는 ONLINE replica 의 SCN 이 OFFLINE replica 의 SCN 보다 큰 경우에 발생한다.<br><br>다음은 g1 그룹만 있는 1x2 cluster 에서 ALTER SYSTEM OPEN GLOBAL DATABASE 구문을 수행할 때 테이블 t1 의 replica 를 ONLINE 상태로 전환하지 못한 예이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN GLOBAL DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-01000(16547): of the total '4' tables in the database, '1' tables have offline replica<br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT global_scn FROM gv$relation@g1n1 WHERE name = 'T1';<br><br>GLOBAL_SCN<br>----------<br>9.1.0<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT global_scn FROM gv$relation@g1n2 WHERE name = 'T1';<br><br>GLOBAL_SCN<br>----------<br>5.0.0<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#baf7d0e8598b3f6a">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a>&nbsp;또는<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#1620340d3358eb5b">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE</a>&nbsp;구문을 수행하여 테이블을 ONLINE 상태로 전환한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT map.group_id, map.member_id, map.is_offline<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM table_member_map@local map,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;definition_schema.tables@local tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE map.table_id = tbl.table_id AND tbl.table_name = 'T1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORDER BY 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6 ;<br><br>GROUP_ID MEMBER_ID IS_OFFLINE<br>-------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 FALSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 TRUE<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT map.group_id, map.member_id, map.is_offline<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM table_member_map@local map,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;definition_schema.tables@local tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE map.table_id = tbl.table_id AND tbl.table_name = 'T1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORDER BY 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6 ;<br><br>GROUP_ID MEMBER_ID IS_OFFLINE<br>-------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 FALSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 FALSE<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16548 (SQLSTATE: 01000): of the total '%d' tables in the member to be dropped, %d' tables have offline replica**

<a id="ad98cea84785fd2e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8ce707cabe9dc37a">ALTER DATABASE DROP FORCE INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS</a>&nbsp;구문은 inactive 멤버를 삭제한 후 OFFLINE 상태의 replica 를 ONLINE 상태로 변경하려고 시도한다.<br>이 때 ONLINE 상태로 변경할 수 없는 테이블이 있을 경우 발생하는 경고 메시지이다.<br>ONLINE 전환 실패는 ONLINE replica 의 SCN 이 OFFLINE replica 의 SCN 보다 큰 경우에 발생한다.<br><br>다음은 g1 그룹만 있는 1x3 cluster 에서 inactive 멤버 (g1n3)를 강제로 삭제하는 예이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT member_id, status FROM v$cluster_member@local;<br><br>MEMBER_ID STATUS<br>--------- --------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 INACTIVE<br><br>3 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP FORCE INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS;<br><br>ERR-01000(16548): of the total '4' tables in the member to be dropped, '1' tables have offline replica<br>Database altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT global_scn FROM gv$relation@g1n1 WHERE name = 'T1';<br><br>GLOBAL_SCN<br>----------<br>15.1.0<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT global_scn FROM gv$relation@g1n2 WHERE name = 'T1';<br><br>GLOBAL_SCN<br>----------<br>7.0.0<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#baf7d0e8598b3f6a">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a>&nbsp;또는<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#1620340d3358eb5b">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE TABLE</a>&nbsp;구문을 수행하여 테이블을 ONLINE 상태로 전환한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT map.group_id, map.member_id, map.is_offline<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM table_member_map@local map,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;definition_schema.tables@local tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE map.table_id = tbl.table_id AND tbl.table_name = 'T1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORDER BY 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6 ;<br><br>GROUP_ID MEMBER_ID IS_OFFLINE<br>-------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 FALSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 TRUE<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT map.group_id, map.member_id, map.is_offline<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM table_member_map@local map,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;definition_schema.tables@local tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE map.table_id = tbl.table_id AND tbl.table_name = 'T1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORDER BY 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6 ;<br><br>GROUP_ID MEMBER_ID IS_OFFLINE<br>-------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 FALSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 FALSE<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16549 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid bind parameter**

<a id="93b87cfc986d28a3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>bind parameter 가 유효하지 않다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT id, name FROM t1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v_id INTEGER<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v_name VARCHAR(32)<br><br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO v_id, :v_name;<br><br>ERR-42000(16549): invalid bind parameter :<br>FETCH cur1 INTO v_id, :v_name<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 호스트 변수는 (:) 과 함께 사용하여야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v_id, :v_name;<br><br>V_ID V_NAME<br>---- ------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 kim<br><br>1 row fetched.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16550 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to offline the already dropped cluster member**

<a id="cabf802c3f665d3a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>서버 내부에서 사용하는 에러 코드이다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>별도의 조치는 필요없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16552 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute on NODE SHARDED table**

<a id="68b3cdbef62f2d96"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16553 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables, '%d' tables failed to drop offline segments**

<a id="f1ac5d98aa541da7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#68248209f3b43891">ALTER DATABASE DROP OFFLINE SEGMENTS</a>&nbsp;구문 수행 중 특정 테이블의 segment 삭제에 실패하였다.<br>이는 대부분 동시성 제어 과정에서 필요한 lock을 획득하지 못한 경우에 발생한다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#4cceb35f6411d58d">DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT</a>&nbsp;값을 증가시킨 후에 다시 수행한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16554 (SQLSTATE: 42000): NODE SHARDED table cannot be synchronized**

<a id="351f25cce9a5fe07"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16555 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables, '%d' tables failed to synchronize**

<a id="68e991aacfb7aee4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>일부 테이블의 synchronize 가 정상적으로 완료되지 않았다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16379): of the total '5' tables, '2' tables failed to synchronize :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;concurrent execution : 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;inactive member&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;replica usablility&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;offline tablespace&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;others&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br><br>Database altered.<br><br><ul><li>concurrent execution<br><ul><li>다른 세션과의 동시성 문제로 인해서 실패한 경우</li></ul></li><li>inactive member<br><ul><li>모든 active member의 replica 들이 offline 상태이고 inactive member 가 있는 경우</li></ul></li><li>replica usability<br><ul><li>Local replica 가 unusable 상태이거나</li><li>모든 active member 의 replica 들이 unusable 상태인 경우</li></ul></li><li>offline tablespace<br><ul><li>Local replica 가 오프라인 된 tablespace 에 만들어진 경우</li></ul></li><li>others<br><ul><li>위에 기술된 원인을 제외한 나머지 경우</li></ul></li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td><ul><li>concurrent execution<br><ul><li>동시성 문제로 인해 다른 세션에서의 DDL 수행을 중지하고 다시 시도한다.</li></ul></li><li>inactive member<br><ul><li>inactive member 를 cluster 에 join 한 후 다시 시도한다.</li></ul></li><li>replica usability<br><ul><li>unusable 상태의 replica 를 제거한 후 다시 시도한다.</li><li>unusable replica 는<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#436fa49da2672327">ALTER TABLE name DROP UNUSABLE SEGMENTS</a>&nbsp;구문으로 제거할 수 있다.</li></ul></li><li>offline tablespace<br><ul><li>오프라인 된 tablespace 를 온라인으로 전환한 후 다시 시도한다.</li><li>온라인 전환은<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b9a7e09545483657">ALTER TABLESPACE name [ONLINE|OFFLINE]</a>&nbsp;구문을 사용한다.</li></ul></li><li>others<br><ul><li>system.trc 에서 원인을 확인하고 조치를 취한 후 다시 시도한다.</li></ul></li></ul></td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16556 (SQLSTATE: 42000): scan partition is out of range( 1 to %d )**

<a id="0236af9cdbca967b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같은 구문을 수행할 때 지정한 SCAN PARTITION 의 값이 최대값 (1000)을 초과하였다.<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#1620340d3358eb5b">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE TABLE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#4752ea45b3668af4">ALTER DATABASE MOVE SHARD</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#045abf2d149b6478">ALTER DATABASE REBALANCE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#baf7d0e8598b3f6a">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b64b6ca52ad7b811">ALTER TABLE name MOVE SHARD</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#4dcbc8cc43487ef2">ALTER TABLE name REBALANCE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b33b38d54cfadfd0">ALTER TABLE name REORGANIZE</a></li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 REORGANIZE SCAN PARTITION 1001;<br><br>ERR-42000(16556): scan partition is out of range( 1 to 1000 ) :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 REORGANIZE SCAN PARTITION 1001<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">SCAN PARTITION 값을 1000 이하로 변경한 후에 다시 수행한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16577 (SQLSTATE: 42000): offset argument is out of range**

<a id="c732f8a464587737"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>LEAD() 함수의 offset 값으로 음수를 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT s_year<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, s_quarter<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, s_revenue<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, LEAD( s_revenue, -1 ) OVER ( ORDER BY s_revenue ) AS lead_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16577): offset argument is out of range</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 양수 offset 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT s_year<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, s_quarter<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, s_revenue<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, LEAD( s_revenue, 1 ) OVER ( ORDER BY s_revenue ) AS lead_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>;<br><br>S_YEAR S_QUARTER S_REVENUE LEAD_VALUE<br>------ --------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2010 1/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;100&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;100<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2011 1/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;100&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2010 2/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2010 4/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2011 4/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;220<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2011 2/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;220&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;250<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2011 3/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;250&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;300<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2010 3/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;300&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br><br>8 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16578 (SQLSTATE: 42000): percentile value should be a number between 0 and 1**

<a id="d7740ef965054bd4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>PERCENTILE_DISC() 함수의 인자값이 잘못되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT s_year<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, s_quarter<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, s_revenue<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, PERCENTILE_DISC( 10 ) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY s_revenue ) OVER ( PARTITION BY s_year ) AS pertile_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16578): percentile value should be a number between 0 and 1</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>PERCENTILE_DISC() 함수의 값은 비율을 의미하는 0 ~ 1 사이의 값이어야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT s_year<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, s_quarter<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, s_revenue<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, PERCENTILE_DISC( 0.5 ) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY s_revenue ) OVER ( PARTITION BY s_year ) AS pertile_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>;<br><br>S_YEAR S_QUARTER S_REVENUE PERTILE_VALUE<br>------ --------- --------- -------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2010 1/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;100&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2010 2/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2010 4/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2010 3/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;300&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2011 1/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;100&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2011 4/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2011 2/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;220&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2011 3/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;250&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br><br>8 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16579 (SQLSTATE: 42000): INDEX COALESCE only supports b-tree type index**

<a id="419ea9941e03d545"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Global temporary index에 INDEX COALESCE 구문을 사용할 때 발생하는 에러이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX t1_idx ON t1 ( c1 );<br><br>Index created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX t1_idx COALESCE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16579): INDEX COALESCE only supports b-tree type index :<br>ALTER INDEX t1_idx COALESCE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Global temporary index 는 COALESCE 구문을 지원하지 않는다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16580 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table '%s' is not online on cluster domain '%s'**

<a id="73021f35b000aafe"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>해당 cluster member 에서 이미 offline 상태이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET OFFLINE AT g2n2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16580): table 'T1' is not online on cluster domain 'G2N2'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>다음과 같이 table 의 offline 여부를 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT member_name, member_offline FROM user_tab_place WHERE table_name = 'T1';<br><br>MEMBER_NAME MEMBER_OFFLINE<br>----------- --------------<br>G1N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G1N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G2N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G2N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE<br>G3N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G3N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br><br>6 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16581 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot find global transaction logfile**

<a id="d8e9301a26b496a7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#99bcbcc9f4d63ec3">ALTER DATABASE RENAME GLOBAL TRANSACTION LOGFILE</a>&nbsp;구문을 수행할 때 지정한 source TCL (Transacion Commit Log) 로그 파일이 현재 사용 중인 로그 파일이 아니다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RENAME GLOBAL TRANSACTION LOGFILE 'commit_2.log' TO 'new_commit_2.log';<br><br>ERR-42000(16581): cannot find global transaction logfile&nbsp;&nbsp;:<br>ALTER DATABASE RENAME GLOBAL TRANSACTION LOGFILE 'commit_2.log' TO 'new_commit_2.log'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">변경하려는 로그 파일이 현재 사용 중인 TCL 로그 파일인지 확인한 후, 올바른 로그 파일을 지정하여 다시 수행한다.<br><br>다음은 현재 사용 중인 TCL 로그 파일을 확인하는 방법이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT group_id, file_name, group_state FROM v$tcl_logfile;<br><br>GROUP_ID FILE_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GROUP_STATE<br>-------- ---------------------- -----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0 /test/wal/commit_0.log CURRENT<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 /test/wal/commit_1.log UNUSED<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16582 (SQLSTATE: 42000): there are active cluster members in the target cluster group '%s'**

<a id="4493fc06f8c92573"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>active cluster member 가 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP CLUSTER GROUP g4;<br><br>ERR-42000(16582): there are active cluster members in the target cluster group 'G4'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>active cluster member 가 존재하는 cluster group 은 DROP 할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16583 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot transactional service: %s**

<a id="576f7fa024f24bc4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>login 시 password 변경이 필요하나 password 변경을 위한 transaction service 가 가능한 상태가 아니다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>cluster system 을 서비스 가능한 global open 단계로 변경한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16584 (SQLSTATE: 42000): index type '%s' exceeds maximum shard sequence**

<a id="59d52da3b2bf612a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b64b6ca52ad7b811">ALTER TABLE name MOVE SHARD</a>&nbsp;구문에서 발생할 수 있으며, shard 이동시 인덱스에 저장된 shard 는 물리적으로 삭제되지 않고 논리적으로 삭제된다.<br>논리적 삭제는 최대 255 번까지 수행할 수 있으며, 이를 초과하면 오류가 발생한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 MOVE SHARD s2 TO CLUSTER GROUP g1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16584): index 'T1X' exceeds maximum shard sequence</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#ba3aecf4b34c844b">ALTER INDEX name COALESCE</a>&nbsp;또는<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#56aed70ce2b90a69">ALTER INDEX name REBUILD</a>&nbsp;구문을 수행한 후에 MOVE SHARD 구문을 다시 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16585 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop cluster group that includes a global coordinator**

<a id="68e7a29b1d583a66"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16586 (SQLSTATE: 42000): role name '%s' conflicts with another user or role name**

<a id="ae826958443f4608"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 user 또는 role 이름이 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE ROLE r1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16586): role name 'R1' conflicts with another user or role name :<br>CREATE ROLE r1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 동일한 이름을 갖는 user 나 role 이 존재하는지 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT role_name, 'ROLE' AS auth FROM dba_roles WHERE role_name = 'R1'<br>&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>SELECT username,&nbsp;&nbsp;'USER' AS auth FROM dba_users WHERE username = 'R1';<br><br>ROLE_NAME AUTH<br>--------- ----<br>R1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ROLE<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16587 (SQLSTATE: 28000): role '%s' does not exists**

<a id="8926bc6ec39bd184"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>해당 role 이 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP ROLE r1;<br><br>ERR-28000(16587): role 'R1' does not exists :<br>DROP ROLE r1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 해당 role 이 존재하는지 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT role_name FROM dba_roles WHERE role_name = 'R1';<br><br>no rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16588 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot GRANT to a role/public WITH GRANT OPTION**

<a id="ccd0bfa28dd34b87"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>role 이나 public 에는 WITH GRANT OPTION 으로 권한을 부여할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT ON t1 TO PUBLIC WITH GRANT OPTION;<br><br>ERR-42000(16588): cannot GRANT to a role/public WITH GRANT OPTION</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 WITH GRANT OPTION 없이 권한을 부여한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT ON t1 TO PUBLIC;<br><br>Grant succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16589 (SQLSTATE: 0P000): circular role grant detected**

<a id="fddec46f67de4739"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>role 부여 시 cycle 이 발생하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT role1 TO role2;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT role2 TO role1;<br><br>ERR-0P000(16589): circular role grant detected</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>role 부여 시 cycle 이 발생하지 않도록 한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16590 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate role name in role granted/revoked list**

<a id="86dbebb28df2a362"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>중복된 role name 이 사용되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT role1, role2, role1 TO u1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16590): duplicate role name in role granted/revoked list :<br>GRANT role1, role2, role1 TO u1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 중복된 role name 을 제거한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT role1, role2 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16591 (SQLSTATE: 28000): cannot GRANT/REVOKE built-in role(SYSDBA, ADMIN) to/from authorization**

<a id="d855bfca031a90eb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>sysdba 와 admin ROLE 은 다른 user 나 role 에게 부여할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT sysdba TO role1;<br><br>ERR-28000(16591): cannot GRANT/REVOKE built-in role(SYSDBA, ADMIN) to/from authorization :<br>GRANT sysdba TO role1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>sysdba 와 admin ROLE 은 다른 user 나 role 에게 부여하거나 철회할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16592 (SQLSTATE: 0P000): invalid role specification**

<a id="865fc0cd535afa7c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>존재하지 않는 role 이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET ROLE invalid;<br><br>ERR-0P000(16592): invalid role specification</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>설정 가능한 role name 을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET ROLE dba;<br><br>Session set.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16593 (SQLSTATE: 25001): invalid transaction state: active transaction exists**

<a id="8d1dafd58980ff2d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>transaction 이 진행 중인 상태에서 SET ROLE 을 수행할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET ROLE role1;<br><br>ERR-25001(16593): invalid transaction state: active transaction exists</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>transaction 을 종료한 후 SET ROLE 을 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET ROLE role1;<br><br>Session set.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16594 (SQLSTATE: 42000): role '%s' not granted or need ADMIN OPTION**

<a id="67c987b68325e78b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ADMIN OPTION 이 없는 role 은 다른 사용자에게 role 을 부여할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT role1 TO u2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16594): role 'ROLE1' not granted or need ADMIN OPTION</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 자신에게 부여된 role 정보를 확인할 수 있으며, ADMIN OPTION 이 존재하는 role만 다른 사용자에게 부여할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT username, granted_role, admin_option FROM user_role_privs;<br><br>USERNAME GRANTED_ROLE ADMIN_OPTION<br>-------- ------------ ------------<br>U1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ROLE1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NO<br>U1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ROLE2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;YES<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT role2 TO u2;<br><br>Grant succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16595 (SQLSTATE: 42000): role '%s' not granted to '%s'**

<a id="1d0c595772f59b57"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>사용자가 부여하지 않은 role 은 철회할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; REVOKE role1 FROM u2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16595): role 'ROLE1' not granted to 'U2'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 사용자가 부여한 role 을 철회할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; REVOKE role2 FROM u2;<br><br>Revoke succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16596 (SQLSTATE: 42000): transactional service temporarily unavailable**

<a id="7e50625b5591912c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#d64c686b2011e181">ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE</a>&nbsp;가 진행 중인 상태에서 참여 중인 노드에 접속하여 transaction 서비스를 요청할 경우에 발생한다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#d64c686b2011e181">ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE</a>&nbsp;가 완료된 후에 다시 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16598 (SQLSTATE: 42000): GROUPING function requires GROUP BY clause**

<a id="f04bde2f221e1406"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>GROUPING 함수는 GROUP BY 와 함께 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT GROUPING( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS RESULT<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16598): GROUPING function requires GROUP BY clause :<br>SELECT GROUPING( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT c1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c3,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COUNT(*),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GROUPING( c1, c2, c3 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>GROUP BY ROLLUP(c1, c2, c3);<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C3 COUNT(*) GROUPING( C1, C2, C3 )<br>---- ---- ---- -------- ----------------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 null null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 null null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br>null null null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;7<br><br>10 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16599 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not a GROUP BY expression**

<a id="ca2acd3b1d44970f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>GROUPING() 함수의 인자가 GROUP BY 에 사용된 expression 이 아니다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT c1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COUNT(*)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>HAVING GROUPING(c1) = 0;<br><br>ERR-42000(16599): not a GROUP BY expression :<br>HAVING GROUPING(c1) = 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 GROUP BY 에 사용된 컬럼을 GROUPING() 함수의 인자로 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT c1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COUNT(*)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;GROUP BY c1<br>HAVING GROUPING(c1) = 0;<br><br>C1 COUNT(*)<br>-- --------<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16600 (SQLSTATE: 42000): The number of columns in a column group must be in the range (%d ~ %d)**

<a id="3ed76da6bef1a29d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 COLUMN GROUPS에 나열된 column의 개수가 2 ~ 4 개 범위를 벗어났다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR COLUMN GROUPS ( c1, c2, c3, c4, c5 );<br>ERR-42000(16600): The number of columns in a column group must be in the range(2 ~ 4) :</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Column group을 나열할 때 2 ~ 4 개의 column을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR COLUMN GROUPS ( c1, c2 );<br>Table analyzed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16601 (SQLSTATE: 42000): specified column group statistics already exists**

<a id="859061ead31f3b8b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">이미 정의된 column group 통계 정보가 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR COLUMN GROUPS ( c1, c2 );<br>ERR-42000(16601): specified column group statistics already exists</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">이미 존재하는 column group 인지 확인하고<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT column_groups FROM USER_STAT_COLUMN_GROUP WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'T1';<br>COLUMN_GROUPS<br>-------------<br>( C1, C2 )<br><br>재구축하고자 할 경우 다음과 같이 삭제하고 다시 구축한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 DELETE STATISTICS FOR COLUMN GROUPS ( c1, c2 );</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16602 (SQLSTATE: 42000): specified column group statistics not exists**

<a id="87cf6a181a6ad63c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Column group 통계 정보가 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 DELETE STATISTICS FOR COLUMN GROUPS ( c1, c2 );<br>ERR-42000(16602): specified column group statistics not exists</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 존재하는 column group 인지 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT column_groups FROM USER_STAT_COLUMN_GROUP WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'T1';<br>no rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16603 (SQLSTATE: 42000): system session cannot be canceled**

<a id="fe4b56d49170951f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">System session이나 cluster session에는 ALTER SYSTEM CANCEL SESSION 구문이 적용되지 않는다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Session id와 serial number가 정확한지 확인한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16604 (SQLSTATE: 42000): pivot operations are not supported on lateral views**

<a id="6b6afc0058a890bf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Lateral view에 대한 pivot은 지원하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1, LATERAL( SELECT c1 FROM dual) PIVOT( COUNT(*) FOR c1 IN ( 1 ) );<br>ERR-42000(16604): pivot operations are not supported on lateral views :<br>SELECT * FROM t1, LATERAL( SELECT c1 FROM dual) PIVOT( COUNT(*) FOR c1 IN ( 1 ) )<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Lateral view를 대상으로 하는 pivot 구문은 기술하지 않는다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16605 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unpivot operations are not supported on lateral views**

<a id="68d5052da07467c2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Lateral view에 대한 unpivot은 지원하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1, LATERAL( SELECT c1 FROM dual) UNPIVOT( col_val FOR col_name IN ( c1 ) );<br>ERR-42000(16605): unpivot operations are not supported on lateral views :<br>SELECT * FROM t1, LATERAL( SELECT c1 FROM dual) UNPIVOT( col_val FOR col_name IN ( c1 ) )<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Lateral view를 대상으로 하는 unpivot 구문은 기술하지 않는다</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16606 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the number of elements in pivot values mismatch the pivot columns**

<a id="de14001063e1523f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Pivot 구문에 기술된 pivot column의 개수와 pivot value의 개수가 다르다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 PIVOT( COUNT(*) FOR ( c1, c2 ) IN ( ( 1, 2 ), ( 3 ) ) );<br>ERR-42000(16606): the number of elements in pivot values mismatch the pivot columns :<br>SELECT * FROM t1 PIVOT( COUNT(*) FOR ( c1, c2 ) IN ( ( 1, 2 ), ( 3 ) ) )<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Pivot 구문에 기술된 pivot column의 개수와 pivot value의 개수가 일치하는지 확인한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16607 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the number of elements in unpivot values mismatch the unpivot columns**

<a id="0fca93b33cba844e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Unpivot 구문에 기술된 unpivot column의 개수와 unpivot value의 개수가 다르다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 UNPIVOT( col_val FOR ( col1, col2 ) IN ( ( c1, c2 ), ( c3 ) ) );<br>ERR-42000(16607): the number of elements in unpivot values mismatch the unpivot columns :<br>SELECT * FROM t1 UNPIVOT( col_val FOR ( col1, col2 ) IN ( ( c1, c2 ), ( c3 ) ) )<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Unpivot 구문에 기술된 unpivot column의 개수와 unpivot value의 개수가 일치하는지 확인한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16608 (SQLSTATE: 42000): non-constant expression is not allowed for pivot|unpivot values**

<a id="205b48d01246deb8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Pivot value 또는 unpivot value는 상수 expression만 허용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 UNPIVOT( col_ FOR c1 IN ( c1 AS RANDOM( 1, 1 ) ) );<br>ERR-42000(16608): non-constant expression is not allowed for pivot|unpivot values :<br>SELECT * FROM t1 UNPIVOT( col_ FOR c1 IN ( c1 AS RANDOM( 1, 1 ) ) )<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 UNPIVOT( col_ FOR c1 IN ( c1 AS CLOCK_DATE() ) );<br>ERR-42000(16608): non-constant expression is not allowed for pivot|unpivot values :<br>SELECT * FROM t1 UNPIVOT( col_ FOR c1 IN ( c1 AS CLOCK_DATE() ) )<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">상수가 아닌 expression을 pivot value 또는 unpivot value로 사용하지 않는다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16609 (SQLSTATE: 42000): lacks privilege (EXECUTE ON LIBRARY \"%s\".\"%s\")**

<a id="9a1439a6ea850565"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">EXECUTE ON LIBRARY 권한이 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( p1 NATIVE_INTEGER ) RETURN NATIVE_INTEGER AS<br>LANGUAGE C<br>LIBRARY u2.ext_lib1 NAME "sample"<br>PARAMETERS ( p1 INT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN INT );<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(FUNC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) : ERR-42000(16609): lacks privilege (EXECUTE ON LIBRARY "U2"."EXT_LIB1")<br>Function created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">아래와 같이 소유자가 권한을 부여한 후 실행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT EXECUTE ON LIBRARY u2.ext_lib1 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( p1 NATIVE_INTEGER ) RETURN NATIVE_INTEGER AS<br>LANGUAGE C<br>LIBRARY u2.ext_lib1 NAME "sample"<br>PARAMETERS ( p1 INT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN INT );<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16610 (SQLSTATE: 42000): library does not exist**

<a id="54e5fb1afa9c6bc5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">해당 library 가 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1 RETURN NATIVE_INTEGER AS<br>LANGUAGE C<br>LIBRARY invalid NAME "sample"<br>PARAMETERS( RETURN INT );<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(FUNC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (3:9): ERR-42000(16610): library does not exist<br>Function created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">아래와 같이 존재하는 library 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT library_name FROM user_libraries;<br><br>LIBRARY_NAME<br>------------<br>LIB1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1 RETURN NATIVE_INTEGER AS<br>LANGUAGE C<br>LIBRARY lib1 NAME "sample"<br>PARAMETERS( RETURN INT );<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16611 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the number of pieces is out of range( 1 to %d )**

<a id="886222596ab53ebb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">다음 구문을 수행할 때 지정한 PIECE 절의 값이 최대값 (1024)보다 크다.<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#93565f80d30924b0">ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#7b6fbab7bad894d2">ALTER TABLESPACE BACKUP INCREMENTAL</a></li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0 PIECE 1025;<br><br>ERR-42000(16611): the number of pieces is out of range( 1 to 1024 ) :<br>ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0 PIECE 1025<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">PIECE 값을 1024 이하로 변경한 후에 다시 수행한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16612 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid backup format ( %s )**

<a id="6a3e8bc18155ca70"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">다음 구문을 수행할 때 지정한 FORMAT 절 문자열의 형식이 올바르지 않다.<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#93565f80d30924b0">ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#7b6fbab7bad894d2">ALTER TABLESPACE BACKUP INCREMENTAL</a></li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0 FORMAT 'backup_%p%z';<br><br>ERR-42000(16612): invalid backup format ( backup_%p%z ) :<br>ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0 FORMAT 'backup_%p%z'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">올바른 FORMAT 절의 형식을 확인한 후 다시 수행한다.<br>자세한 내용은 ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL 구문의 FORMAT 절 설명을 참고한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16613 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot backup; tablespace(%s) is temporary**

<a id="da334a8a00355c8a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Temporary tablespace 에 대해<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#7b6fbab7bad894d2">ALTER TABLESPACE name BACKUP</a>&nbsp;구문을 수행하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_temp_tbs BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0;<br><br>ERR-42000(16613): cannot backup; tablespace(MEM_TEMP_TBS) is temporary :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE mem_temp_tbs BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">별도의 조치는 필요없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16614 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unreachable WHEN clause specified after unconditional WHEN clause**

<a id="1a503747bb4ae501"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">• &lt;search condition&gt; 이 없는 &lt;merge when matched clause&gt; 가 기술된 경우, 더 이상의 &lt;merge when matched clause&gt; 를 기술할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>MERGE INTO t1<br>USING t2<br>ON t1.c1 = t2.c1<br>WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ( c1, c2 ) = ( t2.c1, t2.c2 )<br>WHEN MATCHED AND t1.c1 = 100 THEN DO NOTHING;<br><br>ERR-42000(16614): unreachable WHEN clause specified after unconditional WHEN clause :<br>WHEN MATCHED AND t1.c1 = 100 THEN DO NOTHING<br>*<br>ERROR at line 5:<br><br>• &lt;search condition&gt; 이 없는 &lt;merge when not matched clause&gt; 가 기술된 경우, 더 이상의 &lt;merge when not matched clause&gt; 를 기술할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>MERGE INTO t1<br>USING t2<br>ON t1.c1 = t2.c1<br>WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT VALUES ( c1, c2 )<br>WHEN NOT MATCHED AND c1 = 4 THEN INSERT DEFAULT VALUES;<br><br>ERR-42000(16614): unreachable WHEN clause specified after unconditional WHEN clause :<br>WHEN NOT MATCHED AND c1 = 4 THEN INSERT DEFAULT VALUES<br>*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">• &lt;search condition&gt; 이 없는 &lt;merge when matched clause&gt; 는 &lt;merge when matched clause&gt; 마지막 순서로 기술한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>MERGE INTO t1<br>USING t2<br>ON t1.c1 = t2.c1<br>WHEN MATCHED AND t1.c1 = 100 THEN DO NOTHING<br>WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ( c1, c2 ) = ( t2.c1, t2.c2 );<br>3 rows merged.<br><br>• &lt;search condition&gt; 이 없는 &lt;merge when not matched clause&gt; 는 &lt;merge when not matched clause&gt; 마지막 순서로 기술한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>MERGE INTO t1<br>USING t2<br>ON t1.c1 = t2.c1<br>WHEN NOT MATCHED AND c1 = 4 THEN INSERT DEFAULT VALUES<br>WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT VALUES ( c1, c2 );<br>3 rows merged.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16615 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: failed to make sequences online**

<a id="ea25ec70a52ed1d9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">sequence 객체들을 online 상태로 변경하는데 실패할 때 발생하는 경고이다.<br>일반적인 상황에서는 발생하지 않고 리소스가 부족한 한계 상황에서 발생할 수 있다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#1620340d3358eb5b">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE</a>&nbsp;구문으로 sequence 객체들을 online 으로 만들 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE SEQUENCE;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16616 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: failed to make tables online**

<a id="4a632a9591875cd0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">table 객체들을 online 상태로 변경하는 데 실패할 때 발생하는 경고이다.<br>일반적인 상황에서는 발생하지 않고 리소스가 부족한 한계 상황에서 발생할 수 있다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#1620340d3358eb5b">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE</a>&nbsp;구문으로 table 객체들을 online 으로 만들 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE TABLE;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16617 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: failed to drop offline segments**

<a id="d2392bfa72063b88"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">오프라인된 세그먼트들의 삭제에 실패할 때 발생하는 경고이다.<br>일반적인 상황에서는 발생하지 않고 리소스가 부족한 한계 상황에서 발생할 수 있다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#68248209f3b43891">ALTER DATABASE DROP OFFLINE SEGMENTS</a>&nbsp;구문으로 오프라인된 세그먼트들을 삭제할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP OFFLINE SEGMENTS;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16618 (SQLSTATE:01000): of the total '%d' members, it was executed only on '%d' members**

<a id="2392011c8f104670"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">inactive 멤버가 있어도 수행 가능한 구문에서 발생할 수 있는 경고 메시지이다.<br>대상으로 지정된 멤버들 중 일부가 inactive 상태였음을 알려준다.<br><br>다음은 g2 그룹에 속한 두 멤버 중 한 멤버에서만 구문이 수행된 예이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE CLEAR AUDIT TRAIL AT g2;<br><br>ERR-01000(16618): of the total '2' members, it was executed only on '1' members<br>Database altered.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">inactive 멤버를 active 상태로 전환한 후, 해당 멤버에서 다시 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16619 (SQLSTATE: 42000): AT DOMAIN can be specified in the GLOBAL OPEN phase of the cluster database**

<a id="20d3d66b14a5e3fc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">GLOBAL OPEN 미만 단계에서는 AT domain 을 지정할 수 없다.<br><br>다음은 LOCAL OPEN 단계에서 AT domain 절을 지정하는 예이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT status FROM x$instance@local;<br><br>STATUS<br>----------<br>LOCAL OPEN<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM CHECKPOINT AT g1n1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16619): AT DOMAIN can be specified in the GLOBAL OPEN phase of<br>the cluster database :<br>ALTER SYSTEM CHECKPOINT AT g1n1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">로컬에서 수행하는 경우, AT domain을 제거한 후 다시 시도한다.<br>원격으로 수행하는 경우, cluster 에 참여한 후 다시 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16620 (SQLSTATE: 42000): The domain option cannot be specified together with ONLINE, TABLESPACE, or index attributes options**

<a id="11cd987ae7487ab9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">ALTER INDEX name REBUILD 시 ONLINE, TABLESPACE 또는 index 속성과 함께 AT domain 절을 사용하는 경우에 발생한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( i1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX t1x ON t1( i1 );<br><br>Index created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX t1x REBUILD ONLINE AT g2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16620): The domain option cannot be specified together with<br>ONLINE, TABLESPACE, or index attributes options :<br>ALTER INDEX t1x REBUILD ONLINE AT g2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">AT domain 절을 제거한 후에 다시 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16621 (SQLSTATE: 42000): a transaction can insert into only one table in append manner**

<a id="6e6a09d537b10f98"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">한 트랜잭션에서 두 개 이상의 테이블에 append insert 방식으로 데이터를 추가하려고 할 때 발생하는 에러 메시지이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T2 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16621): a transaction can insert into only one table in append manner</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">두 개 이상의 테이블에 append insert 방식으로 데이터를 추가하려면, 각 테이블마다 별도의 트랜잭션으로 수행해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T2 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16622 (SQLSTATE: 42000): append insert attributes mismatch**

<a id="a710f4972be2c26d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">한 트랜잭션 내에서 append insert 문을 두 번 이상 수행하면서 이전과 다른 옵션을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND NOLOGGING */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 2 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16622): append insert attributes mismatch</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">한 트랜잭션에서 append insert 문을 여러 번 수행하는 경우 동일한 옵션을 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 2 );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16623 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute DDL - append inserts unfinished**

<a id="dbd884397d0baf89"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">append insert 를 수행한 트랜잭션이 완료되기 전에 DDL 문을 수행하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T2 ( I1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-42000(16623): cannot execute DDL - append inserts unfinished</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>append insert 를 수행한 트랜잭션을 완료한 후에 DDL 문을 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T2 ( I1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16624 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute DML - append inserts unfinished**

<a id="469c4847c6771a92"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">append insert 를 수행한 트랜잭션이 완료되기 전에 동일한 테이블에 대해 DML을 수행하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE T1 SET I1 = 2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16624): cannot execute DML - append inserts unfinished</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">append insert 를 수행한 트랜잭션을 완료한 후에 DML을 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE T1 SET I1 = 2;<br><br>1 row updated.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16625 (SQLSTATE: 42000): segment is unusable in the member with the latest data of table '%s.%s'**

<a id="5f24621bb53917db"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">다음 구문을 수행할 때 UNUSABLE 상태인 replica 의 SCN 이 다른 멤버의 OFFLINE replica 의 SCN 보다 크다.<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#1620340d3358eb5b">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE TABLE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#4752ea45b3668af4">ALTER DATABASE MOVE SHARD</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#045abf2d149b6478">ALTER DATABASE REBALANCE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#baf7d0e8598b3f6a">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b64b6ca52ad7b811">ALTER TABLE name MOVE SHARD</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#4dcbc8cc43487ef2">ALTER TABLE name REBALANCE</a></li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16625): segment is unusable in the member with the latest data of table 'PUBLIC.T1'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">UNUSABLE 상태의 replica 는 더 이상 사용할 수 없기 때문에<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#436fa49da2672327">ALTER TABLE name DROP UNUSABLE SEGMENTS</a>&nbsp;구문을 사용하여 삭제한 후에 다시 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 DROP UNUSABLE SEGMENTS;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>※ 주의: 테이블은 OFFLINE 상태의 replica 가 가진 과거 시점의 데이터를 기준으로 동기화 된다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16626 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables in the database, failed to modify the offline member map in '%d' tables**

<a id="ea6afc6aed979e49"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#98259b572214ad92">ALTER DATABASE OFFLINE INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS</a>&nbsp;구문은 active 멤버들이 유지하고 있는 table member map 에서 inactive 멤버를 OFFLINE 상태로 설정하는 구문이다.<br>이 구문은 모든 테이블에 대해 순차적으로 수행되며, OFFLINE 설정에 실패한 테이블이 있는 경우에 이 경고 메시지가 발생한다.<br>OFFLINE 설정 실패는 대부분 동시성 제어 과정에서 필요한 lock을 획득하지 못한 경우에 발생한다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#4cceb35f6411d58d">DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT</a>&nbsp;값을 증가시킨 후에 다시 수행한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16627 (SQLSTATE: 42000): Input to JSON generation function has unsupported data type**

<a id="92e515d727e464e3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>JSON string constructor 함수의 인자로 사용할 수 없는 데이터 타입이 사용되었다.<br><br>CREATE TABLE test ( col INTEGER );<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT JSON_ARRAY( test.rowid )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM test;<br><br>ERR-42000(16627): Input to JSON generation function has unsupported data type :<br>SELECT JSON_ARRAY( test.rowid )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">사용할 수 있는 데이터 타입으로 변환한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT JSON_ARRAY( CAST( test.rowid AS VARCHAR(32) ) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM test;<br><br>JSON_ARRAY( CAST( TEST.ROWID AS VARCHAR(32) ) )<br>-----------------------------------------------<br>["AAAAAAAAYeoAACAAAEAkAAA"]<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16628 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unusable replicas in table '%s' must be offline**

<a id="7e26fc20d9526d03"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>서버 내부에서 사용하는 에러 코드이다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16629 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables, '%d' tables failed to drop unusable segments**

<a id="8df13d3d8282f5f3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Unusable segment를 가진 테이블들 중 일부에서 해당 segment의 삭제에 실패했을 때 발생하는 오류이다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">실패 원인은 다양할 수 있으므로, 정확한 원인은 system.trc 로그를 통해 확인해야 한다.<br>문제를 해결한 후, 다시 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16630 (SQLSTATE: 42000): global transactions cannot perform append inserts**

<a id="d8961c778e6434a3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">XA 트랜잭션에서는 데이터 추가를 위해 APPEND INSERT 방식을 사용할 수 없다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">XA 트랜잭션에서는 CONVENTIONAL INSERT를 사용하여 데이터를 추가한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16631 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables, '%d' tables failed to offline**

<a id="97775b3af5ab144d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">테이블스페이스와 관련된 테이블들 중 일부의 offline 상태 전환에 실패했을 때 발생하는 에러이다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">실패 원인은 다양할 수 있으므로, 정확한 원인은 system.trc 로그를 통해 확인해야 한다.<br>문제를 해결한 후, 다시 시도한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16632 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tables related to tablespace '%s' must be offline**

<a id="7a2ab7bb9310ddec"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">테이블스페이스와 관련된 테이블들 중 일부의 offline 상태 전환에 실패했을 때 발생하는 에러이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE space1 OFFLINE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16632): tables related to tablespace 'SPACE1' must be offline</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">ALTER TABLESPACE .. OFFLINE TABLES 구문으로 관련 테이블들을 OFFLINE 상태로 변경한 후에 다시 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESAPCE space1 OFFLINE TABLES;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE space1 OFFLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16633 (SQLSTATE: 42000): all tablespaces related to table '%s' must be online**

<a id="598d3b59a0963bb9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">OFFLINE 상태인 테이블스페이스와 관련된 테이블들에 대해 다음 구문들을 수행할 경우 발생하는 에러이다.<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#4dcbc8cc43487ef2">ALTER TABLE name REBALANCE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#5f2f7d4e4bdedbe5">ALTER TABLE name REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP cluster_group_list</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#baf7d0e8598b3f6a">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b64b6ca52ad7b811">ALTER TABLE name MOVE SHARD</a></li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">OFFLINE 상태의 테이블스페이스를 ONLINE 으로 변경한 후에 다시 수행한다.<br>테이블스페이스를 ONLINE 으로 변경하는 방법은<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b9a7e09545483657">ALTER TABLESPACE name [ONLINE|OFFLINE]</a>&nbsp;을 참조한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16634 (SQLSTATE: 42000): referenced table '%s' does not have a primary key**

<a id="2cd641a1e6af1236"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Parent 테이블에 primary key가 존재하지 않는다<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent );<br>ERR-42000(16634): referenced table '%s' does not have a primary key :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Parent 테이블에 primary key 제약 조건을 추가한 후에 foreign key를 생성한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE parent ADD CONSTRAINT parent_pk PRIMARY KEY(pk);<br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16635 (SQLSTATE: 42000): number of referencing columns must match referenced columns**

<a id="4b5c4fe120ff4421"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Foreign key의 column 개수와 primary key의 column 개수가 서로 다르다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TABLE parent ( c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CONSTRAINT parent_pk PRIMARY KEY (c1, c2) );<br>&nbsp;Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( c1 INTEGER REFERENCES parent );<br>ERR-42000(16635): number of referencing columns must match referenced columns :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( c1 INTEGER REFERENCES parent )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 primary의 column 개수와 동일한 수의 foreign key 를 생성한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TABLE child ( c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOREIGN KEY (c1, c2) REFERENCES parent );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16636 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column type incompatible with referenced column type**

<a id="15c7f39ebe0312bb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Primary key와 foreign key의 data type이 호환되지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk VARCHAR(10) REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>ERR-42000(16636): column type incompatible with referenced column type :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk VARCHAR(10) REFERENCES parent(pk) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Foreign key의 data type을 primary key의 data type과 일치시킨다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16637 (SQLSTATE: 42000): no matching unique or primary key for this column list**

<a id="ab43837693a90b64"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">참조하는 column에 해당하는 primary key 또는 unique key 가 존재하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c1 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(c1) );<br>ERR-42000(16637): no matching unique or primary key for this column list :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(c1) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Primary key 또는 unique key 에 해당하는 column을 참조한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16638 (SQLSTATE: 23000): referential constraint "%s"."%s" violated : parent keys not found**

<a id="6848c9515cb5cab9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">FOREIGN KEY 제약 조건이 설정된 column의 값이 참조 대상인 PRIMARY KEY 또는 UNIQUE 제약 조건이 설정된 column에 존재하지 않을 경우에 발생하는 에러이다.<br><br>다음과 같은 경우에 이 에러가 발생할 수 있다.<br><ul><li>Child 테이블에서 참조 중인 parent 테이블의 값을 삭제한 경우</li><li>Parent table에 존재하지 않는 값을 child table에 삽입한 경우</li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Parent table의 레코드를 삭제할 경우, 해당 레코드가 child table에서 참조되고 있는지 확인한다.<br>Child table에 레코드를 삽입할 경우, 참조 대상인 값이 parent table에 존재하는지 확인한다.<br>FOREIGN KEY constraint에 대한 자세한 내용은<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/19-sql-references-c-g.md#254ccdad9ba898ff">FOREIGN KEY 제약 조건</a>을 참조한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16639 (SQLSTATE: 42000): attempt to reference non-base table '%s' in referential integrity constraint**

<a id="f26187a7c315a809"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Global temporary table 을 FOREIGN KEY 로 참조할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>ERR-42000(16639): attempt to reference non-base table '%s' in referential integrity constraint :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 base table 만 FOREIGN KEY 로 참조할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16640 (SQLSTATE: 42000): attempt to create referential integrity constraint on non-base table**

<a id="97007e89e4dd8aad"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Global temporary table 에 FOREIGN KEY 를 생성할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE child ( fk INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE child ADD CONSTRAINT child_fk FOREIGN KEY(fk) REFERENCES parent(pk);<br>ERR-42000(16640): attempt to create referential integrity constraint on non-base table</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">FOREIGN KEY 는 base table 에서만 생성할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE child ADD CONSTRAINT child_fk FOREIGN KEY(fk) REFERENCES parent(pk);<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16641 (SQLSTATE: 42000): referenced unique constraint shall not be deferrable**

<a id="cba6ac59356695a6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">DEFERRABLE 제약 조건을 FOREIGN KEY 로 참조할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DEFERRABLE );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>ERR-42000(16641): referenced unique constraint shall not be deferrable :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 제약 조건을 NOT DEFERRABLE 로 변경한 후에 FOREIGN KEY 를 생성한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE parent ALTER CONSTRAINT parent_primary_key NOT DEFERRABLE;<br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>
