> **16642 (SQLSTATE: 42000): for referencing generated column, delete rule shall not specify SET NULL or SET DEFAULT**

<a id="5f6cfc7e8aefede5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Generated column 에 대한 FOREIGN KEY 의 delete rule 로 SET NULL 등을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;REFERENCES parent(pk) ON DELETE SET NULL );<br>ERR-42000(16642): for referencing generated column, delete rule shall not specify SET NULL or SET DEFAULT :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;REFERENCES parent(pk) ON DELETE SET NULL )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 ON DELETE CASCADE 등과 같은 delete rule 을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;REFERENCES parent(pk) ON DELETE CASCADE );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16643 (SQLSTATE: 42000): for referencing generated column, update rule shall not specify SET NULL or SET DEFAULT or CASCADE**

<a id="b620059517f03786"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Generated column 에 대한 FOREIGN KEY 의 update rule 로 CASCADE 등을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;REFERENCES parent(pk) ON UPDATE CASCADE );<br>ERR-42000(16643): for referencing generated column, update rule shall not specify SET NULL or SET DEFAULT or CASCADE :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;REFERENCES parent(pk) ON UPDATE CASCADE )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 ON UPDATE NO ACTION 등과 같은 update rule 을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;REFERENCES parent(pk) ON UPDATE NO ACTION );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16644 (SQLSTATE: 42000): constraint schema '%s' shall be equivalent to table schema**

<a id="c562156ac6d05db4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">제약 조건의 schema 와 테이블의 schema 가 다르다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE s1.t1 ( pk INTEGER CONSTRAINT s2.t1_pk PRIMARY KEY );<br><br>ERR-42000(16644): constraint schema '%s' shall be equivalent to table schema :<br>CREATE TABLE s1.t1 ( pk INTEGER CONSTRAINT s2.t1_pk PRIMARY KEY )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">제약 조건은 테이블과 동일한 schema 에 생성해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE s1.t1 ( pk INTEGER CONSTRAINT s1.t1_pk PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16645 (SQLSTATE: 42000): such referential constraint already exists in table**

<a id="caff0e9553b0895b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">동일한 FOREIGN KEY 제약 조건이 이미 생성되어 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;uk INTEGER UNIQUE );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE child ADD CONSTRAINT child_fk FOREIGN KEY( fk ) REFERENCES parent(pk);<br>ERR-42000(16645): such referential constraint already exists in table :<br>ALTER TABLE child ADD CONSTRAINT child_fk FOREIGN KEY( fk ) REFERENCES parent(pk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 서로 다른 정의를 갖는 FOREIGN KEY 를 생성한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE child ADD CONSTRAINT child_fk FOREIGN KEY( fk ) REFERENCES parent(uk);<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16646 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column definition is not specified**

<a id="95c38480cbedacfc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Column을 정의하지 않았다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( UNIQUE( c1 ) );<br>ERR-42000(16646): column definition is not specified</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 column을 정의한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, UNIQUE( c1 ) );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16647 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column is referenced in a multi-column constraint "%s"."%s"**

<a id="613e7881ab53eba0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">다수의 column으로 정의된 제약 조건에 해당 column이 포함되어 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER, c3 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD PRIMARY KEY (c2, c3);<br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN c2;<br>ERR-42000(16647): column is referenced in a multi-column constraint "PUBLIC"."T1_PRIMARY_KEY"</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">CASCADE 옵션을 사용하여 해당 제약 조건도 함께 제거한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN c2 CASCADE;<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16648 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop parent key column : child foreign key "%s"."%s"**

<a id="bfd5a16bc09963fd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">FOREIGN KEY에서 참조하고 있으므로 PRIMARY KEY column을 제거할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c1 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE parent SET UNUSED COLUMN pk;<br>ERR-42000(16648): cannot drop parent key column : child foreign key "PUBLIC"."CHILD_FOREIGN_KEY_FK_REFERENCES_PARENT_PK"</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 CASCADE 옵션을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE parent SET UNUSED COLUMN pk CASCADE;<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16649 (SQLSTATE: 42000): trigger does not exist**

<a id="4b0bfb155c5a4546"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">comment, drop, rename 와 같은 구문에서 트리거 객체 이름이 잘못 사용되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TRIGGER trg1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TRIGGER trg2 RENAME TO new_trg;<br>ERR-42000(16649): trigger does not exist :<br>ALTER TRIGGER trg2 RENAME TO new_trg<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">올바른 트리거 객체 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TRIGGER trg1 RENAME TO new_trg;<br>Trigger altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16650 (SQLSTATE: 42000): object "%s" is not %s**

<a id="0ba01b035e3c3107"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">해당 SQL 구문을 실행할 수 없는 객체이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP VIEW t1;<br>ERR-42000(16650): object "T1" is not VIEW :<br>DROP VIEW t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 객체에 부합하는 SQL 구문을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE t1;<br><br>Table dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16651 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate trigger event**

<a id="fa5fcf3cbb1c600f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">트리거 이벤트가 중복으로 정의되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16651): duplicate trigger event :<br>AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">이벤트를 올바르게 기술한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16652 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate transition table or variable name**

<a id="828931ebede0c109"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">트리거의 transition에서 테이블 이름 또는 변수 이름이 중복으로 정의되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS t_tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NEW TABLE AS t_tbl<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16652): duplicate transition table or variable name :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NEW TABLE AS t_tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">올바른 테이블 이름 또는 변수 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_t_tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NEW TABLE AS new_t_tbl<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16653 (SQLSTATE: 42000): transition table or variable specified more than once**

<a id="b28a4be6e5f8cb84"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">트리거의 transition에서 OLD와 NEW를 중복으로 사용했다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OLD ROW AS o_row2<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16653): transition table or variable specified more than once :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OLD ROW AS o_row2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">트리거 transition을 올바르게 기술한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NEW ROW AS o_row2<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16654 (SQLSTATE: 42000): transition table can not be specified in multi-event trigger**

<a id="359e862dfe69fad0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">트리거에서 다중 이벤트를 정의하고 transition 테이블을 사용하면 에러가 발생할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE OR DELETE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o_tbl<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16654): transition table can not be specified in multi-event trigger :<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o_tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">트리거 transition 테이블을 사용하려면 단일 이벤트만 기술해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o_tbl<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16655 (SQLSTATE: 42000): transition table can be declared only in AFTER triggers**

<a id="e109cdda2be3406d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">트리거 동작 시점을 BEFORE로 기술하고 transition 테이블 사용했다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>BEFORE UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o_tbl<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16655): transition table can be declared only in AFTER triggers :<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o_tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">트리거 transition 테이블을 사용하려면 동작 시점을 AFTER로 기술해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o_tbl<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16656 (SQLSTATE: 42000): transition variable requires FOR EACH ROW syntax**

<a id="0f4299015cc7824f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">트리거 동작을 FOR EACH STATEMENT로 설정한 후에 transition 변수를 사용했다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row<br>FOR EACH STATEMENT<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16656): transition variable requires FOR EACH ROW syntax :<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Transition&nbsp;&nbsp;변수를 사용하려면 트리거 동작을 FOR EACH ROW 로 기술해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16657 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid use of %s transition table or variable**

<a id="af4b99d871b5f7f3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">INSERT 트리거에 OLD transition을 기술하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16657): invalid use of OLD transition table or variable :<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">INSERT 트리거에는 NEW transition을 기술해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>REFERENCING NEW ROW AS o_row<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16658 (SQLSTATE: 42000): trigger "%s"."%s" already exists on another table and can not be replaced**

<a id="0f02945cb41b02f0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">기존 트리거를 새로운 트리거로 대체할 때 베이스 테이블의 이름이 다르면 발생하는 에러이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t2<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16658): trigger "PUBLIC"."T2" already exists on another table and can not be replaced :<br>CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">베이스 테이블 이름이 다른 경우에는 기존 트리거를 삭제하거나 트리거 이름을 분리해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri2<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t2<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16659 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: trigger "%s"."%s" has compilation errors**

<a id="3c526fc755c65eb8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">트리거 바디에 객체가 없거나, 잘못된 내용들이 기술되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT count(*) INTO var1 FROM n_tbl;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-01000(16659): Warning: trigger "PUBLIC"."TRI1" has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (7:3): ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist<br>Trigger created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">트리거 바디에 명시된 테이블이 존재하지 않아 발생한 오류이므로, 해당 테이블을 생성해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE n_tbl ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT count(*) INTO var1 FROM n_tbl;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16660 (SQLSTATE: 23001): referential constraint "%s"."%s" restriction violated : can not delete or update parent row**

<a id="d3e7ede5cc02c499"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">FOREIGN KEY 제약 조건이 설정된 column 값과 동일한 값을 가지는 참조 대상인 PRIMARY KEY 또는 UNIQUE 제약 조건의 column을 변경할 경우에 발생하는 에러이다.<br><br>FOREIGN KEY 제약 조건의 referential triggered action이 ON UPDATE RESTRICT 또는 ON DELETE RESTRICT로 정의된 경우 발생한다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Child table의 레코드 변경을 먼저 시도한다.<br>FOREIGN KEY constraint에 대한 자세한 내용은<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/19-sql-references-c-g.md#254ccdad9ba898ff">FOREIGN KEY 제약 조건</a>을 참조한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16661 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column is referenced in a update column trigger "%s"."%s"**

<a id="843ab640d0d057f3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">제거하려는 column을 참조하는 UPDATE COLUMN TRIGGER 가 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TRIGGER trg1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AFTER UPDATE OF c1 ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Trigger created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN c1;<br>ERR-42000(16661): column is referenced in a update column trigger "PUBLIC"."TRG1"</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">CASCADE 옵션을 사용하여 해당 TRIGGER 도 함께 제거한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN c1 CASCADE;<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16662 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute for the disabled index**

<a id="975baf4c0535be66"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">해당 인덱스가 DISABLE 상태이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1(c1);<br>Index created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX idx1 DISABLE;<br>Index altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX idx1 REBUILD;<br>ERR-42000(16662): cannot execute for the disabled index :<br>ALTER INDEX idx1 REBUILD<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 ENABLE 로 변경하여 인덱스를 재구축한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX idx1 ENABLE;<br>Index altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16663 (SQLSTATE: 42000): referenced unique constraint must be ENFORCED**

<a id="440cee8635b3f02e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">참조하려는 제약 조건이 NOT ENFORCED 상태이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER CONSTRAINT parent_pk PRIMARY KEY NOT ENFORCED );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>ERR-42000(16663): referenced unique constraint must be ENFORCED :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 참조하려는 제약 조건을 ENFORCED 로 변경한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE parent ALTER CONSTRAINT parent_pk ENFORCED;<br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16664 (SQLSTATE: 42000): trigger type mismatch : %s**

<a id="19502058470ea095"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">호환되지 않는 trigger 들의 순서를 바꿀 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Trigger created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Trigger created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t2 SET TRIGGER ORDER trg2, trg1;<br>ERR-42000(16664): trigger type mismatch : event object mismatch&nbsp;&nbsp;:<br>ALTER TABLE t2 SET TRIGGER ORDER trg2, trg1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 호환되는 trigger 들을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET TRIGGER ORDER trg2, trg1;<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16665 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate trigger name**

<a id="2fa7fa9ac3a48fb8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Trigger 이름이 중복되어 나열되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET TRIGGER ORDER trg1, trg1;<br>ERR-42000(16665): duplicate trigger name :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 SET TRIGGER ORDER trg1, trg1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Trigger 이름을 중복되지 않게 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET TRIGGER ORDER trg1, trg2;<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16666 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not analyzed system**

<a id="ca6bbb426613873d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">ANALYZE SYSTEM 을 실행한 적이 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE SYSTEM EXPORT 'sys.stat';<br>ERR-42000(16666): not analyzed system</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">ANALYZE SYSTEM 을 실행한 후에 EXPORT 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE SYSTEM;<br>analyzed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE SYSTEM EXPORT 'sys.stat';<br>analyzed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16667 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot append insert - foreign keys are enabled on the table**

<a id="caafac4f1b8b503b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">FOREIGN KEY 제약 조건이 설정된 테이블에서는 deferred index maintenance 방식의 append insert 를 수행할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE PARENT ( I1 INTEGER UNIQUE );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE CHILD ( I1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE CHILD ADD CONSTRAINT CHILD_FK FOREIGN KEY( I1 ) REFERENCES PARENT( I1 );<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND DEFERRED_INDEX_MAINTENANCE */ INTO PARENT VALUES ( 2 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16667): cannot append insert - foreign keys are enabled on the table</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">FOREIGN KEY 제약 조건을 일시적으로 비활성화한 후 append insert를 수행하고 작업 완료 후에 FOREIGN KEY 제약 조건을 다시 활성화한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE CHILD ALTER CONSTRAINT CHILD_FK NOT ENFORCED;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND DEFERRED_INDEX_MAINTENANCE */ INTO PARENT VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE CHILD ALTER CONSTRAINT CHILD_FK ENFORCED;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16668 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table sampling can only be performed on a single base table or temporary table**

<a id="8bb22554b9d72f64"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">다음 객체에는 sample clause 를 기술할 수 없다.<br><ul><li>join</li><li>viewed table</li><li>inline view</li><li>common table expression (CTE)</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT * FROM t1 ) TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>ERR-42000(16663): table sampling can only be performed on a single base table or temporary table :<br>SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT * FROM t1 ) TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v1 TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>ERR-42000(16663): table sampling can only be performed on a single base table or temporary table :<br>SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v1 TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Sample clause는 단일 base table 이나 단일 temporary table에만 기술한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>COUNT(*)<br>--------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;100549<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 A TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS ), t1 B TABLESAMPLE( 2 PERCENT ROWS ) WHERE A.c1 = B.c1;<br><br>COUNT(*)<br>--------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;20005<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>Table sampling에 대한 자세한 내용은<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/20-sql-references-h-z.md#778d71bbe6c00108">sample clause</a>&nbsp;를 참조한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16669 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table sampling rate must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100**

<a id="2480d061c3ecddb7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Table sampling rate가 유효 범위를 벗어난 경우에 발생하는 에러이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 0 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>ERR-42000(16664): table sampling rate must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100 :<br>SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 0 PERCENT ROWS )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 200 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>ERR-42000(16664): table sampling rate must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100 :<br>SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 200 PERCENT ROWS )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 0 보다 크고 100 이하인 table sampling rate를 입력한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 100 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>COUNT(*)<br>--------<br>&nbsp;1000000<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>COUNT(*)<br>--------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;99812<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>Table sampling에 대한 자세한 내용은 sample clause 절을 참조한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16670 (SQLSTATE: 23000): check constraint "%s"."%s" violated**

<a id="4d802280c7fff765"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">CHECK 제약 조건을 위반하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CHECK ( c1 &gt; 0 ) );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( -1 );<br>ERR-23000(16670): check constraint "PUBLIC"."T1_CHECK_C1" violated</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">CHECK 제약 조건을 만족하는 값을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16671 (SQLSTATE: 42000): maximum number of check columns exceeded**

<a id="e87e09f2816047a8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">CHECK 제약 조건에 기술할 수 있는 column 개수를 초과하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ADD<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CHECK ( c1&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c2&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c3&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c4&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c5&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c6&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c7&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c8&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c9&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c10 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c11 + c12 + c13 + c14 + c15 + c16 + c17 + c18 + c19 + c20 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c21 + c22 + c23 + c24 + c25 + c26 + c27 + c28 + c29 + c30 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c31 + c32 + c33 &gt; 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;);<br><br>ERR-42000(16671): maximum number of check columns exceeded :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CHECK ( c1&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c2&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c3&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c4&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c5&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c6&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c7&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c8&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c9&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c10 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 CHECK 제약 조건에는 최대 32 개의 column을 사용할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ADD<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CHECK ( c1&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c2&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c3&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c4&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c5&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c6&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c7&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c8&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c9&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c10 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c11 + c12 + c13 + c14 + c15 + c16 + c17 + c18 + c19 + c20 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c21 + c22 + c23 + c24 + c25 + c26 + c27 + c28 + c29 + c30 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c31 + c32 + c32 &gt; 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;);<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16672 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot append insert - triggers are enabled on the table**

<a id="66dd4f7682f07f66"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">insert 할 테이블에 trigger 가 활성화되어 있으면 append insert 를 수행할 수 없다.<br><br>DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t1;<br>DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t2;<br>CREATE TABLE t1( c1 INTEGER );<br>CREATE TABLE t2( c1 INTEGER );<br>INSERT INTO t2 VALUES ( 1 ), ( 2 ), ( 3 );<br>COMMIT;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg1<br>BEFORE INSERT ON t1<br>FOR EACH STATEMENT<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'BEFORE INSERT ON t1' );<br>END;<br>/<br>COMMIT;<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO t1 SELECT * FROM t2;<br>ERR-42000(16672): cannot append insert - triggers are enabled on the table</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">append insert를 수행하려면 trigger를 비활성화해야 한다.<br>Trigger 활성화 여부는 user_triggers view로 조회할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TRIGGER trg1 DISABLE;<br>Trigger altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO t1 SELECT * FROM t2;<br>3 rows created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16673 (SQLSTATE: 42000): visible conflict**

<a id="5039f8c88d347ae3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>서버 내부에서 사용하는 에러 코드이다.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16674 (SQLSTATE: 42000): A version conflict was detected while synchronizing the replica**

<a id="64576c801bcf55f1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">DML 수행 중 master 노드에서의 update는 성공했으나, slave 노드에서 update를 수행하는 과정에서 version conflict가 발생하였다.<br>일반적인 상황에서는 발생하지 않으며, update master 노드 장애로 인해 update slave 노드가 새로운 update master로 승격되는 경우에 한해 발생할 수 있다.<br>이 에러가 발생하면 해당 transaction은 강제로 rollback된다.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">애플리케이션 프로그램에서 해당 작업을 재시도 한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16675 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot offline transaction tablespace**

<a id="c0268dec7b54dac6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Transaction TABLESPACE 는 OFFLINE 상태로 변경할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_trans_tbs OFFLINE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16675): cannot offline transaction tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE mem_trans_tbs OFFLINE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">다음과 같이 OFFLINE 으로 변경하려는 TABLESPACE 의 용도를 사전에 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT tablespace_name, contents FROM dba_tablespaces WHERE tablespace_name = 'MEM_TRANS_TBS';<br><br>TABLESPACE_NAME CONTENTS<br>--------------- -----------<br>MEM_TRANS_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRANSACTION<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16676 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot specify NOLOGGING without the PARALLEL option**

<a id="678d293b867004d6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">INSERT 구문에서 NOLOGGING 힌트를 지정했지만 PARALLEL 힌트를 함께 지정하지 않은 경우에 발생하는 에러 메시지이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND NOLOGGING */ INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16676): cannot specify NOLOGGING without the PARALLEL option</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">NOLOGGING 힌트를 사용하려면 PARALLEL 힌트를 함께 지정한다.<br>NOLOGGING 방식이 필요하지 않은 경우 NOLOGGING 힌트를 제거한 후 다시 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL NOLOGGING */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16677 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unable to set table to 'usable' state due to remaining corrupted pages**

<a id="a7ff6604d8cfb398"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Unusable segment인 테이블에 논리적으로 손상된 페이지가 존재하여 usable 상태로 변경할 수 없다. 자세한 내용은<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#903acda421fae3cd">ALTER TABLE name USABLE</a>을 참조한다.<br>Unusable segment가 존재하는 테이블은 V$RELATION 을 통해 확인할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT NAME, USABLE FROM V$RELATION WHERE USABLE = FALSE AND TYPE = 'TABLE';<br><br>NAME USABLE<br>---- ------<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 USABLE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16677): unable to set table to 'usable' state due to remaining corrupted pages.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle"><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#a996ea8c8491c041">ALTER DATABASE REGISTER IRRECOVERABLE SEGMENT</a>&nbsp;구문으로 추가한 경우, 해당 segment는 복구가 필요하지 않은 대상으로 등록된 것이므로 해당 테이블을 truncate 하여 데이터를 재구축하거나 drop 한다.<br>NOLOGGING APPEND INSERT 를 수행하여 발생한 unusable segment의 경우, NOLOGGING APPEND INSERT 수행 후에 생성한 백업 데이터 파일을 사용하여 복구한 다음 작업을 다시 수행한다.<br>백업 데이터가 없는 경우, 논리적으로 손상된 페이지는 복구할 수 없으므로 해당 테이블을 usable 상태로 변경할 수 없다.<br>이러한 상황을 방지하기 위해 GOLDILOCKS에서는 NOLOGGING APPEND INSERT 수행 후 체크포인트 및 백업을 수행할 것을 권장한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16678 (SQLSTATE: 42000): LOCAL SHARD LIMIT is supported only for sharded tables**

<a id="aa8b9f91808f884a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Sharded table에 대한 DELETE FROM 문에서만 LOCAL SHARD LIMIT을 사용할 수 있다.<br>자세한 내용은&nbsp;&nbsp;DELETE FROM의<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/19-sql-references-c-g.md#d23d83f814803841">&lt;local shard limit clause&gt;</a>를 참조한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t_cloned ( c1 INTEGER ) CLONED;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM t_cloned LOCAL SHARD LIMIT 10 ROWS;<br><br>ERR-42000(16678): LOCAL SHARD LIMIT is supported only for sharded tables :<br>DELETE FROM t_cloned LOCAL SHARD LIMIT 10 ROWS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">DELETE FROM 문에 LOCAL SHARD LIMIT를 지정한 경우, FROM 절에는 sharded table을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t_shard ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY ( c1 );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM t_shard&nbsp;&nbsp;LOCAL SHARD LIMIT 10 ROWS;<br><br>no rows deleted.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="e1a591dcf1c42966"></a>
## PSM 관련 에러

```
PSM 에러 관련 예시는 아래 스키마를 기준으로 작성되었다.

gSQL>
CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER, c3 integer);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 10, 10 );

CREATE TABLE t2 ( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) );
INSERT INTO t2 VALUES( 101, 'SUNJESOFT' );
INSERT INTO t2 VALUES ( 102, 'GOLDILOCKS' );

CREATE TABLE t3 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, c2 INTEGER );

CREATE LIBRARY lib AS 'add.so';
/

// add.c
// gcc -shared -fPIC -I$GOLDILOCKS_HOME/include -o $GOLDILOCKS_DATA/extlib/add.so add.c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <goldilocks.h>

int addFunc( int a, int b )
{
 return a + b;
}

int addFuncWithCTX( SQLExtProcContext * context, int a, int b )
{
 return a + b;
}
```

> **17000 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): failed to initialize PSM processor layer**

<a id="b66bf7cf304a57e0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17001 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): not implemented feature (%s)**

<a id="e7f328e31c222504"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">미구현 기능 또는 지원되지 않는 기능이다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE taa IS TABLE OF VARCHAR(10) INDEX BY DATE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (2:45): ERR-2F000(17001): not implemented feature (unsupported index type)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">해당 기능은 사용할 수 없다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17002 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): duplicated label name**

<a id="1b2d918002bfc86a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>동일한 label 이름이 사용되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>&lt;&lt;aaa&gt;&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 10;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;aaa&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('1st aaa');<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;aaa&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('2nd aaa');<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (7:5): ERR-2F000(17002): duplicated label name</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 서로 다른 label 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>&lt;&lt;aaa&gt;&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 10;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;bbb&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('1st bbb');<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;ccc&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('2nd ccc');<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17003 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): duplicated exception name**

<a id="144794bf109f4874"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>EXCEPTION 절에 동일한 exception 이름이 사용되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 EXCEPTION;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 EXCEPTION;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN v1 THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHEN v1 THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (9:18): ERR-2F000(17003): duplicated exception name</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 서로 다른 exception 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 EXCEPTION;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 EXCEPTION;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN v1 THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHEN v2 THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17004 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): duplicated variable name**

<a id="c4c177378ebcff25"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17005 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): not applicable expression type**

<a id="2776589d40b56f43"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>해당 에러 발생 시 고객센터에 문의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17006 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): unknown variable or column name (%s)**

<a id="d63e55c1cd46a1c0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>선언하지 않은 변수 이름이 사용되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var0 INTEGER;<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg2<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 var0%TYPE;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(PKG2) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (3:10): ERR-2F000(17006): unknown variable or column name (VAR0)<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 변수를 선언한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg2<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 pkg1.var0%TYPE;<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17007 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid expression**

<a id="e40e10a5fae033a7"></a>

> **17025 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): The command cannot be executed when global transaction is in the ACTIVE state**

<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>XA 환경에서는 DDL 을 포함한 procedure 를 실행할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1()<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc2()<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;';<br>END;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \xa start 10<br>XA transaction started<br><br>gSQL&gt; CALL proc1;<br><br>ERR-2F000(17025): The command cannot be executed when global transaction is in the ACTIVE state :<br>&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc2()<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("PROC1")<br><br>gSQL&gt; \xa rollback 10<br>Rollback completed</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>XA 환경이 아닌 상태에서 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CALL proc1;<br><br>Procedure Call complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17026 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): Transaction is READ ONLY**

<a id="45362bdb0a727adf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>read only transaction 에서는 DML 을 수행할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY;<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t1(c1, c2) VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COMMIT;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17026): Transaction is READ ONLY :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t1(c1, c2) VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>read write transaction 으로 변경하고 DML 을 수행한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET TRANSACTION READ WRITE;<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t1(c1, c2) VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COMMIT;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="1517ec6766a14b29"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>중복된 변수가 선언되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:4): ERR-2F000(17027): duplicated identifier</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>변수 이름이 중복되지 않도록 선언한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17028 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): out of scope**

<a id="df21759a45573593"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>참조할 수 없는 scope(label) 의 변수에 접근했다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>&lt;&lt;AA&gt;&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 10;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;BB&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 20;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BB.v1 := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (12:6): ERR-2F000(17028): out of scope error</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 참조할 수 있는 scope(label) 의 변수를 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>&lt;&lt;AA&gt;&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 10;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;BB&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 20;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AA.v1 := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17029 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): too many depths of scope (limit=%d)**

<a id="8c3f0a419d6e8ea6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>지나치게 깊은 depth 의 변수 참조가 발생하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql_text varchar(4000);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql_text := 'DECLARE v1 integer; {1} v1:= 10; {2}';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql_text := REPLACE(v_sql_text, '{1}', REPEAT('BEGIN ', 128));<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql_text := REPLACE(v_sql_text, '{2}', REPEAT('END; ', 128));<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_sql_text;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (1:1): ERR-2F000(17029): too many depths of scope (limit=128)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_sql_text;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 9:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>상위 128 개 미만의 scope 의 변수를 참조할 수 있다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17030 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid reference (%s)**

<a id="a85aae1c89e5aa6c"></a>

> **17031 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): mismatch identifier type**

<a id="e027fe28dc756e20"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>구문에서 사용할 수 없는 variable 유형이 사용되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE t_arr IS TABLE OF VARCHAR(32) INDEX BY INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_arr t_arr;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_arr(0) := 'A';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_arr(1) := v_arr();<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( v_arr(1) );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (6:16): ERR-2F000(17031): mismatch identifier type</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 구문에서 사용할 수 있는 variable 유형을 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE t_arr IS TABLE OF VARCHAR(32) INDEX BY INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_arr t_arr;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_arr(0) := 'A';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_arr(1) := v_arr(0);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( v_arr(1) );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>A<br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="295f9c1b3902540d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>USING OUT은 INTO 절 또는 RETURNING INTO 절과 함께 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var2 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_str VARCHAR(100);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_str := 'INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 3 ,3 ) RETURNING * INTO ? , ?';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_str<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;USING OUT var1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURNING INTO var2;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (8:3): ERR-2F000(17048): INTO clause or RETURNING INTO clause cannot be used with a USING clause that has OUT-mode</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>USING OUT을 INTO 절 또는 RETURNING INTO 절과 함께 사용하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var2 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_str VARCHAR(100);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_str := 'INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 3 ,3 ) RETURNING * INTO ? , ?';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_str<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;USING OUT var1 , OUT var2;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.<br><br>또는<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var2 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_str VARCHAR(100);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_str := 'INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 3 ,3 ) RETURNING * INTO ? , ?';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_str<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURNING INTO var1 , var2;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17051 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid statement-type**

<a id="f2c277aa3f8026e3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>사용할 수 없는 SQL 구문이 사용되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR rec IN ( insert into t2 values (101, 'leekmo') )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LOOP<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END LOOP;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (2:16): ERR-2F000(17051): invalid statement-type</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>cursor FOR LOOP 구문에는 아래와 같이 SELECT 질의를 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR rec IN ( select * from t2 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LOOP<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END LOOP;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17070 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): return statement in procedures or anonymous blocks cannot have &lt;value&gt; clause**

<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>procedure 내에서는 RETURN 절을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(PROC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (5:4): ERR-2F000(17070): return statement in procedures or anonymous blocks cannot have &lt;value&gt; clause<br>Procedure created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 RETURN 절을 제거한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Procedure created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17071 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): return statement in functions should have &lt;value&gt; clause**

<a id="2c5eae238b9ef1ec"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>stored function 의 RETURN 절은 값을 명시해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(FUNC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (5:5): ERR-2F000(17071): return statement in functions should have &lt;value&gt; clause<br>Function created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 RETURN 절에 값을 명시한다.<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17072 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): existing state of routine has been discarded**

<a id="61124376a9c80abc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>아래와 같이 DROP PROCEDURE 구문에 의해 procedure 가 실행할 수 없는 상태가 된다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1 AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql VARCHAR(1024);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql := 'DROP PROCEDURE proc1;';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_sql;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17072): existing state of routine(PROC1) has been discarded :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 9:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("PROC1")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>procedure 진행 중에 DROP 하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1 AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql VARCHAR(1024);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql := 'DROP PROCEDURE proc1;';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;-- EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_sql;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17073 (SQLSTATE: 2F003): DDLs or DCLs cannot be invoked during DMLs or SELECT statements are executing in "%s"."%s"**

<a id="00f6d75300138444"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>아래와 같이 SELECT 에서 사용하는 stored function 이 DDL 을 포함하고 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'DROP TABLE t2';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN a1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT FUNC1( id ) FROM t2 where id = 101;<br><br>ERR-2F003(17073): DDLs or DCLs cannot be invoked during DMLs or SELECT statements are executing in "PUBLIC"."FUNC1" :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'DROP TABLE t2';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>SELECT FUNC1( id ) FROM t2 where id = 101<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SELECT 에서 사용하는 stored function 은 DDL 이 없어야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN a1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT FUNC1( id ) FROM t2 where id = 101;<br><br>FUNC1( ID )<br>-----------<br>&nbsp;101<br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17074 (SQLSTATE: 2F003): cannot begin transaction inside a query in "%s"."%s"**

<a id="8f80a333764e9470"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>아래와 같이 SELECT 에서 사용하는 stored function 내에서<br>SELECT FOR UPDATE 수행으로 인해 transaction 이 시작하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT id INTO v1 FROM t2 WHERE id = a1 FOR UPDATE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN v1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT FUNC1( id ) FROM t2 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1;<br><br>ERR-2F003(17074): cannot begin transaction inside a query in "PUBLIC"."FUNC1" :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT id INTO v1 FROM t2 WHERE id = a1 FOR UPDATE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 11:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>SELECT FUNC1( id ) FROM t2 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 FOR UPDATE 를 제거하여 stored function 내에서 transaction 이 발생하지 않도록 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT id INTO v1 FROM t2 WHERE id = a1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN v1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT FUNC1( id ) FROM t2 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1;<br><br>FUNC1( ID )<br>-----------<br>&nbsp;101<br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17075 (SQLSTATE: 2F003): cannot commit or rollback transaction inside a query or DML in "%s"."%s"**

<a id="031fbd0bc84d057c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DML 에서 사용하는 stored function 내에 COMMIT 또는 ROLLBACK 이 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DELETE FROM t2 WHERE id = a1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COMMIT;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN a1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t2(id, name) VALUES ( func1(102), 'abcd' );<br><br>ERR-2F003(17075): cannot commit or rollback transaction inside a query or DML in "PUBLIC"."FUNC1" :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COMMIT;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 11:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>INSERT INTO t2(id, name) VALUES ( func1(102), 'abcd' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 stored function 내의 COMMIT 구문을 제거한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DELETE FROM t2 WHERE id = a1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;--# COMMIT;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN a1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t2(id, name) VALUES ( func1(102), 'abcd' );<br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17076 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): application error "%s"**

<a id="d2ce4614cb1d9ce0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR 사용이 잘못되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR( -10000, 'user-defined error' );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17076): application error "Invalid Error Code" :<br>&nbsp;RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR( -10000, 'user-defined error' );<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 적절한 에러 코드 사용 시 원하는 동작을 확인할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR( -20100, 'user-defined error' );<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-2F000(20100): user-defined error</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17079 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): a nested function not allowed in executing SQL**

<a id="d70267a5ccf21eed"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>nested function 은 SELECT 구문 등에서 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION f1 RETURN INTEGER<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br><br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT f1() INTO v1 FROM dual;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (11:12): ERR-2F000(17079): a nested function not allowed in executing SQL</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>필요 시 stored function 을 생성하여 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION f1 RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT f1() INTO v1 FROM dual;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="ded2222665750a7e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SELECT query 에서 사용하는 stored function 은 DML 을 수행할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1 RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t2(id, name) VALUES ( 102, 'leekmo' );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT func1() FROM t2;<br><br>ERR-2F002(17080): cannot execute DML jobs inside a query :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t2(id, name) VALUES ( 102, 'leekmo' );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 7:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>SELECT func1() FROM t2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>DML 을 포함하지 않는 stored function 을 사용한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17094 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): IN cursor cannot be opened**

<a id="33d6037e68ee0a3a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>IN parameter 로 사용한 cursor 는 OPEN 할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE cursor_type IS REF CURSOR RETURN t1%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_cur cursor_type;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_row t1%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1( a_cur IN cursor_type )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN a_cur FOR SELECT * FROM t1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( v_cur );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH v_cur INTO v_row;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE v_cur;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17094): IN cursor cannot be opened :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN a_cur FOR SELECT * FROM t1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 9:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>OPEN 구문을 위한 cursor parameter 는 아래와 같이 OUT parameter 로 정의해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE cursor_type IS REF CURSOR RETURN t1%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_cur cursor_type;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_row t1%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1( a_cur OUT cursor_type )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN a_cur FOR SELECT * FROM t1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( v_cur );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH v_cur INTO v_row;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE v_cur;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17095 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): mismatch parameter count of routine(%s)**

<a id="977f587ab65264df"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>routine 실행 중에 procedure 의 parameter 개수가 변경되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1( a1 OUT INTEGER )<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;a1 := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( v1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1( ) ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'AS '&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'BEGIN '&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL; ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'END; ';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( v1 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17095): mismatch parameter count of routine(PROC1) :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( v1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 11:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("PROC1")</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>routine 실행 중에 procedure 의 정의를 변경하지 않는다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17096 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): mismatch parameter type of routine(%s)**

<a id="8620550e5dbc1216"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>routine 실행 중에 routine 의 parameter type 이 변경되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1( p1 OUT SYS_REFCURSOR ) AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN p1 FOR SELECT 1 FROM DUAL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ref1 SYS_REFCURSOR;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1(p1 OUT INTEGER) AS BEGIN p1 := 1; END;';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1(ref1);<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17096): mismatch parameter type of routine(PROC1) :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1(ref1);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 6:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("PROC1")</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>routine 실행 중에 routine 의 정의를 변경하지 않는다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17097 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): mismatch return type of function(%s)**

<a id="3830e701d5427537"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>routine 실행 중에 stored function 의 return type 이 변경되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func3<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 0;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc3<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 VARCHAR(1024);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 := 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func3 ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'RETURN TABLE( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER ) ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'AS ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'BEGIN ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'RETURN TABLE( SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1 ); ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'END;';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v2;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := func3;<br>end;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; call proc3;<br><br>ERR-2F000(17097): mismatch return type of function(FUNC3) :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := func3;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 14:<br><br>call proc3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("PROC3")</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>routine 실행 중에 stored function 의 정의를 변경하지 않는다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17098 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): mismatch record field count of routine(%s)**

<a id="733e3d7c9232f08f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>routine 실행 중에 record 타입의 field 개수가 변경되었다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 t1%ROWTYPE ) RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN a1.c1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 t1%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT * INTO v2 FROM t1 LIMIT 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := func1(v2);<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN ( c3 VARCHAR(10) )';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := func1(v2);<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17098): mismatch record field count of routine(FUNC1) : ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := func1(v2);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 10:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>routine 실행 중에 record type 의 정의를 변경하지 않는다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17099 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): cycle detected when initialize package instance(%s)**

<a id="8cb8cd965d81b956"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">패키지의 공용 변수 간에 상호 참조가 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x INTEGER := pkg2.y + 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(PKG1) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (3:18): ERR-42000(16036): 'PKG2.Y': invalid identifier<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg2<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;y INTEGER := pkg1.x + 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(PKG2) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (3:14): ERR-42000(16036): 'PKG2.Y': invalid identifier<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x INTEGER := pkg2.y + 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(PKG1) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (3:14): ERR-2F000(17099): cycle detected when initialize package instance(PKG1)<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">패키지 공용 변수 초기화 시 상호 참조로 인한 순환 의존성이 발생하지 않도록 주의해야 한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17102 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): PACKAGE(%s) Body has compilation errors**

<a id="c5be52efc7639681"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>package body 에 compile error 가 존재한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pkg1.invalid := 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17102): PACKAGE(PKG1) Body has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (6:12): ERR-42000(16036): 'INVALID': invalid identifier<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>관련 compile error 를 수정한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pkg1.v1 := 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Package created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17103 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): cannot use function in the same package**

<a id="be814311855e728f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>package specification 에서 변수 초기화 시 동일한 package 의 function 을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg3<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION func1 RETURN INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := func1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(PKG3) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (4:19): ERR-2F000(17103): cannot use function in the same package<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>package specification 에서 변수 초기화 시 상수나 다른 function 을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg3<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION func1 RETURN INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 0;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Package created.</td></tr></tbody></table>
