> **17105 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid REFCURSOR binding**

<a id="805ff98a9eea2134"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>REFCURSOR parameter 를 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE PROC1( A1 IN OUT SYS_REFCURSOR )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var V1 INTEGER;<br><br>gSQL&gt; CALL PROC1( :v1 );<br><br>ERR-2F000(17105): invalid REFCURSOR binding :<br>CALL PROC1( :v1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Host variable 이 REFCURSOR 인지 확인한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v_cur REFCURSOR<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN :v_cur FOR SELECT * FROM t1 ORDER BY c1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CALL proc1( :v_cur );<br><br>Procedure Call complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17106 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): unknown field name (%s)**

<a id="603b153f24fba08a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>존재하지 않는 record field 이름을 사용하였다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t1%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.c1 := 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.invalid := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (5:8): ERR-2F000(17106): unknown field name (INVALID)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>존재하는 field 이름을 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t1%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.c1 := 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.c2 := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17107 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): only cursor variable allowed**

<a id="61726cdb6db7d16b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT 함수의 인자로 host variable 을 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v_refcur refcursor;<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN :v_refcur FOR SELECT id FROM t2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT( :v_refcur );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17107): only cursor variable allowed :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT( :v_refcur );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT( :v_refcur );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("RETURN_RESULT")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 cursor variable 을 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_refcur SYS_REFCURSOR;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN v_refcur FOR SELECT id FROM t2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT( v_refcur );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.<br><br>ResultSet #1<br><br>&nbsp;ID<br>---<br>101<br>102</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17108 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): Implicit result cannot be returned through this statement**

<a id="6b95a8c461725a0c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT 를 포함한 stored function 은 SELECT 등의 구문에서 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1 RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_cur SYS_REFCURSOR;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN v_cur FOR SELECT id FROM t2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT( v_cur );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; select func1 from dual;<br><br>ERR-2F000(17108): Implicit result cannot be returned through this statement :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT( v_cur );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 6:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("RETURN_RESULT")<br><br>select func1 from dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 REFCURSOR 를 client 에 전달하기 위한 용도로 사용한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; var v1 INTEGER;<br>gSQL&gt; CALL func1() INTO :v1;<br><br>Procedure Call complete.<br><br>ResultSet #1<br><br>&nbsp;ID<br>---<br>101<br>102</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17109 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): table function need return table statement**

<a id="fad0c3e16446c710"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>table function 은 RETURN TABLE 구문을 포함해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE( id INTEGER )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM TABLE( func1() );<br><br>ERR-2F000(17109): table function need return table statement :<br>SELECT * FROM TABLE( func1() )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>SELECT * FROM TABLE( func1() )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 RETURN TABLE 구문을 사용해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE( id INTEGER )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( SELECT id FROM t2 );<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM TABLE( func1() );<br>&nbsp;ID<br>---<br>101<br>102<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17110 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): return table statement not allowed**

<a id="76623eb5a3dabbde"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>RETURN TABLE 구문을 기술할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( SELECT id, name FROM t2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (2:5): ERR-2F000(17110): return table statement not allowed</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>RETURN TABLE 구문은 아래와 같이 table function 생성 시 기술해야 한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE ( a1 INTEGER, a2 VARCHAR(32) )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE( SELECT id, name FROM t2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17111 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): only select statement allowed**

<a id="f5e1cdd0bcdf4138"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>RETURN TABLE 절에는 SELECT FOR UPDATE 구문을 기술할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( SELECT id, name FROM t2 FOR UPDATE );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(FUNC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (5:18): ERR-2F000(17111): only select statement allowed<br>Function created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 FOR UPDATE 가 없는 SELECT 구문만 기술할 수 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( SELECT id, name FROM t2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17112 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): mismatch field count of function table(%s)**

<a id="b41817e93e6b1ae6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>RETURN TABLE 절의 field 개수와 SELECT 구문의 field 개수가 다르다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32), value INTEGER )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( SELECT id, name FROM t2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(FUNC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (5:20): ERR-2F000(17112): mismatch field count of function table(FUNC1)<br>Function created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 RETURN TABLE 절의 field 개수와 SELECT 구문의 field 개수를 일치시킨다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( SELECT id, name FROM t2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17113 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): cursor that have never fetched is allowed**

<a id="196dfe86cd6f3a4c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>fetch 중인 cursor 를 RETURN TABLE 의 인자로 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE ( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) )<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cur1 SYS_REFCURSOR;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t2%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1 FOR SELECT * FROM t2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( cur1 );<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM TABLE ( func1() );<br><br>ERR-2F000(17113): only cursor that have never fetched is allowed :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( cur1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 8:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>SELECT * FROM TABLE ( func1() )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>아래와 같이 FETCH 절을 제거한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE ( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) )<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cur1 SYS_REFCURSOR;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t2%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1 FOR SELECT * FROM t2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;-- FETCH cur1 INTO v1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( cur1 );<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM TABLE ( func1() );<br><br>&nbsp;ID NAME<br>--- ----------<br>101 SUNJESOFT<br>102 GOLDILOCKS<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17114(SQLSTATE: 39000) function symbol not found for built-in package routine \"%s\".\"%s\"**

<a id="7c270f2793000ff7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>지원하는 built-in package routine을 찾을 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BUILTIN_PACKAGE_SCHEMA.DBMS_LOCK<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AUTHID CURRENT_USER<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION CONVERT( id IN INTEGER, lockhandle in varchar, lockmode in integer, timeout in number )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN INTEGER<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NOT DETERMINISTIC<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MODIFIES SQL DATA<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LANGUAGE C<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LIBRARY INTERNAL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(DBMS_LOCK) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) : ERR-39000(17114): function symbol not found for built-in package routine "DBMS_LOCK"."CONVERT"<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>사용하고자 하는 built-in package routine의 정의를 확인하고 올바르게 입력한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17115(SQLSTATE: 38000) mismatch parameter for built-in package routine \"%s\".\"%s\"**

<a id="1ea67bed20502afe"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>built-in package routine의 parameter 정보와 사용자가 재생성한 parameter 정보가 일치하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BUILTIN_PACKAGE_SCHEMA.DBMS_LOCK<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AUTHID CURRENT_USER<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE SLEEP( seconds IN NATIVE_SMALLINT )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NOT DETERMINISTIC<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MODIFIES SQL DATA<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LANGUAGE C<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LIBRARY INTERNAL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP(1);<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-38000(17115): mismatch parameter for built-in package routine "DBMS_LOCK"."SLEEP" :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP(1);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP(1);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("SLEEP")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>사용하고자 하는 built-in package routine의 parameter 정보를 확인하고 올바르게 입력한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17116(SQLSTATE: 38000) built-in package routine is not allowed**

<a id="db742da517e9b04c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>built-in package routine 정의를 package specification 이외의 block에서는 허용하지 않는다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BUILTIN_PACKAGE_SCHEMA.DBMS_LOCK<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AUTHID CURRENT_USER<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE SLEEP( seconds IN NATIVE_INTEGER );<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY BUILTIN_PACKAGE_SCHEMA.DBMS_LOCK<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE SLEEP( seconds IN NATIVE_INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NOT DETERMINISTIC<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MODIFIES SQL DATA<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LANGUAGE C<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LIBRARY INTERNAL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17102): PACKAGE(DBMS_LOCK) Body has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (3:15): ERR-38000(17116): built-in package routine is not allowed<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>built-in package routine 정의를 package specification 에 정의한다.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="0d7ca1a8fd814153"></a>

> **17127(SQLSTATE: 39000) fetched column value is NULL**

<a id="0772782a0511b8a2"></a>

INSERT INTO t1( c1, c2 ) values ( 100, null );<br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT func1( c1 , c2 ) FROM t1 where c1 = 100;<br><br>ERR-39000(17127): fetched column value is NULL :<br>SELECT func1( c1 , c2 ) FROM t1 where c1 = 100<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>INDICATOR 속성을 추가하거나, NVL 함수를 사용하여 NULL을 0이나 공백과 같은 다른 값으로 치환한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( p1 NATIVE_INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;p2 NATIVE_INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN NATIVE_INTEGER AS<br>LANGUAGE C<br>LIBRARY lib NAME "addFunc"<br>PARAMETERS( p1 INT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;p1 INDICATOR SHORT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;p2 INT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;p2 INDICATOR SHORT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN INDICATOR SHORT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN INT );<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT func1( c1 , c2 ) FROM t1 where c1 = 100;<br>FUNC1( C1 , C2 )<br>----------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17131(SQLSTATE: 2F000) no choices may appear with choice OTHERS in an exception handler**

<a id="83ac3ae14ee4dba0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>EXCEPTION WHEN 절에서 OTHERS handler와 다른 exception handler를 같이 묶어 사용할 수 없다.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;e1 EXCEPTION;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE e1;<br>EXCEPTION WHEN e1 OR OTHERS THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'exception variable OR others' );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (5:22): ERR-2F000(17131): no choices may appear with choice OTHERS in an exception handler</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>OTHERS handler와 같이 사용한 exception handler를 제외하거나, 별도의 exception handler로 구성해야 한다.<br><br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;e1 EXCEPTION;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE e1;<br>EXCEPTION WHEN e1 THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'exception variable' );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHEN OTHERS THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'OR others' );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17132 (SQLSTATE: OW000): cannot execute in a trigger (%s)**

<a id="63c4bfdcfa9e9fdd"></a>

> **17133 (SQLSTATE: OW000): cannot insert into a generated always identity column (%s.%s)**

<a id="b4eaef36b1dfb5d4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">트리거 바디에 IDENTITY 속성을 가진 column이 기술되어 있다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri3<br>BEFORE UPDATE ON t3<br>REFERENCING NEW ROW AS n_row<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;n_row.c1 := 100;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-01000(16659): Warning: trigger "PUBLIC"."TRI1" has compilation errors :<br>(1) : ERR-0W000(17133): cannot insert into a generated always identity column (N_ROW.C1)<br>Trigger created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">해당 column의 IDENTITY 속성을 삭제하여 트리거를 활성화한다.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t3 ALTER COlUMN c1 DROP IDENTITY;<br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri3<br>BEFORE UPDATE ON t3<br>REFERENCING NEW ROW AS n_row<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;n_row.c1 := 100;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>
